jobs.title: Growth Manager, Americas
jobs.excerpt: Who Are We? RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing.
jobs.description:
Who Are We?

RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.

We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.

RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.

Role Overview

As a Growth Manager at RZR, you will drive revenue retention and growth by identifying and executing the highest-impact opportunities across your assigned portfolio of accounts — through growth planning, product adoption, and consultative client partnerships.

At the account level, this means owning a growth plan, maintaining rigorous forecasting and pipeline management, and delivering data-driven recommendations to clients at every organizational level. Internally, it means cultivating strong cross-functional relationships to align teams, remove blockers, and ensure growth strategies are executed with precision.

This is a high-ownership, client-facing role in a fast-moving environment where accountability, analytical rigor, and proactive communication are what move the business forward.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Retention & Growth

  • Drive sustainable revenue by growing accounts, preventing churn, and uncovering upsell and cross-sell opportunities that result in long-term growth across your portfolio
  • Track progress against revenue goals with a portfolio mindset — net gain vs. net loss across your book of business

Client Ownership & Strategy

  • Own end-to-end account strategy with clear growth plans across three areas: relationship mapping and development, upsell and cross-sell execution, and short and long-term revenue retention initiatives
  • Serve as a trusted advisor by delivering data-driven recommendations and fostering product adoption through regular engagement with stakeholders at all organizational levels, including executive leadership
  • Develop strategic relationships that generate marketable client wins and RZR brand advocacy; gather product and market feedback to share with internal stakeholders

Campaign Management & Performance Insights

  • Ensure campaigns operate seamlessly and optimize effectively through collaboration with Analyst and Product teams
  • Deliver insights that tie platform performance to real business outcomes — not just in-platform KPIs

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Align and mobilize internal teams — Analyst, AdOps, Product, Creative — to resolve issues, execute seamlessly, and deliver a consistent, high-value client experience

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain forecast discipline and pipeline accuracy through rigorous Hubspot and Revenue Tracker hygiene
  • Present calendar QBRs and strategic meetings with clear agendas, structured follow-ups, and documented accountability
  • Share regular updates with your manager covering growth opportunities, growth blockers, and net new business

Required Skills and Experience

Must-Have

  • 2–4+ years in digital advertising, mobile-focused tech or consulting, or client-facing sales and account management roles
  • Track record of driving revenue growth and retention across a portfolio of accounts
  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable using performance data (CPA, ROAS, pacing, attribution) to guide client strategy and internal decisions
  • Outstanding communication skills with the ability to build trust and influence at multiple stakeholder levels
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and coordinate across teams to achieve client and business goals
  • Highly organized and disciplined in managing multiple priorities, meeting cadences, and forecasting responsibilities
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, startup-stage environment where adaptability is a requirement

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with the mobile adtech ecosystem: UA, retargeting, attribution, SKAN/MMP, bidding mechanics, or CTV
  • Experience with AI or ML-driven optimization products
  • Prior account management experience at a DSP, MMP, SSP, or mobile marketing platform

Why Join RZR?

  • Revenue ownership from day one — you own a real portfolio of accounts with DRR targets, not a support function within someone else's book of business. Your impact is direct and measurable.
  • Fast-growing Americas team at a company scaling its largest market — you will work alongside a Principal Growth Manager and Senior Growth Manager on a tight, experienced commercial bench, with direct access to the HM.
  • Broad client exposure across some of the most exciting names in mobile advertising — gaming, fintech, consumer apps, and RMG, across both growth-stage and enterprise clients.
  • A hiring process that values how you think — the Presentation round is designed to evaluate structured thinking and commercial judgment, not just interview performance.
  • Path to Senior Growth Manager — high performers are developed and promoted from within the Americas Growth team.
  • Stable, profitable company investing in growth — RZR is EBITDA positive and scaling aggressively. This is a growth hire, not a backfill.

RZR Behaviors

RZR operates by eight core behaviors: Extreme Ownership · Move Fast · Drive for Excellence · Proactive Communication · Courage · Curiosity · Deliver Results · Manage Ambiguity

jobs.description:
About Us

At Cast & Crew, we’ve empowered creativity and supported the global entertainment industry for decades. Together with our family of brands - Backstage, CAPS, Checks & Balances, Final Draft, Media Services, Sargent-Disc, and The TEAM Companies – we operate as a combined entertainment technology and services provider offering industry standard screenwriting accounting software, digital payroll products, data & reporting, and a host of creative tools. The industry continues to move faster than ever, and the need for our expertise, our technology, and our people has never been greater. We are a production’s best ally every step of the way. #OneCastOneCrew

At Cast & Crew, engineers own the systems they build and operate. Our platforms support mission-critical workflows across the entertainment industry, where reliability, scalability, and accountability matter. We hire engineers who take ownership, solve problems end-to-end, automate wherever possible, and continuously raise the bar for engineering excellence.

Summary

Cast & Crew is seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and operate scalable data platforms that power mission-critical applications, analytics, reporting, and AI-driven solutions across the entertainment production ecosystem.

This role focuses on building reliable, cloud-native data pipelines that ingest, transform, secure, and serve operational data for internal engineering teams, business intelligence, and customer-facing applications. You will work across structured and semi-structured data, enabling modern analytics, AI workloads, and real-time event processing.

You will collaborate closely with software engineers, platform engineers, product teams, and data consumers while leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery and improve engineering productivity.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related field

  • 5+ years of experience building production data platforms and pipelines

  • Strong Python development experience

  • Strong SQL development and query optimization skills

  • Experience designing and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines

  • Experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora)

  • Experience working with NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, MongoDB, document databases)

  • Experience building data lakes and cloud-native data architectures

  • Experience with Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar cloud data warehouses

  • Experience with AWS cloud services including S3, Lambda, EventBridge, DynamoDB, ECS/EKS, and IAM

  • Experience building event-driven and streaming data solutions

  • Experience working with Kafka, SNS/SQS, Kinesis, or similar messaging technologies

  • Experience with data orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster

  • Experience with Git and modern CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar)

  • Experience building highly available, scalable production systems

  • Strong understanding of data modeling, partitioning, indexing, and performance optimization

  • Experience monitoring and operating production data platforms

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Apache Spark or distributed processing frameworks

  • Experience with Debezium, CDC, or change data capture architectures

  • Experience with Iceberg, Delta Lake, or modern lakehouse technologies

  • Experience with OpenSearch or Elasticsearch

  • Experience supporting AI and machine learning data platforms

  • Experience building feature stores or vector databases

  • Experience with document processing (OCR, Textract, PDF extraction)

  • Experience in media, payroll, financial systems, or enterprise SaaS platforms

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot

What You Will Build

  • Enterprise-scale data ingestion and transformation pipelines

  • Cloud-native data platforms supporting analytics and operational workloads

  • Real-time event-driven data processing solutions

  • Data models supporting reporting, AI, and customer-facing applications

  • Secure, scalable integrations between enterprise systems

  • Automated monitoring, testing, and deployment pipelines for data infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

  • Highly reliable and scalable production data pipelines

  • High-quality, trusted data powering operational and analytical systems

  • Low-latency, automated data movement across enterprise platforms

  • Engineering best practices including automation, observability, and testing

  • Strong collaboration with software engineering and platform teams

  • Continuous improvement through AI-assisted development and automation

Special Work Conditions

  • Sedentary – Involves sitting most of the time but may involve walking or standing for brief periods of time. Some positions may entail exerting up to 15 lbs. of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force to lift, carry, push, or pull.


What We Offer

Cast & Crew provides a comprehensive package of employee benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, PTO, health and wellness programs, employee discounts, and more! Note: Cast & Crew benefits are subject to eligibility requirements.


Cast & Crew is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals based on job-related qualifications and ability to perform a job, without regard to age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, disability, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship or marital status, and to maintain a non-discriminatory environment free from intimidation, harassment or bias based upon these grounds.

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

Kooth is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming access to digital mental health support across the UK and the US. Listed on the London Stock Exchange (LSE: KOO), our mission is to create welcoming, accessible spaces for personalized mental health care that empower young people to thrive.

In the UK, Kooth works alongside the NHS and is the country’s largest digital mental health platform.

In the US, we bring our mission to life through Soluna, California’s first statewide digital behavioral health service for 13–25-year-olds. Soluna removes barriers to care by providing nearly immediate access to one-to-one coaching, Care Navigation, peer support, and self-guided tools that help young people build resilience and find meaningful support when they need it most.

Our culture is rooted in our values: Alongside You, Flexible, Compassionate, Committed, and Safe. These values guide how we support young people, collaborate with one another, and build solutions that meet individuals and communities where they are.

At Kooth, you will be part of something bigger than yourself—meaningful work with measurable impact.

Role Objective:

Offer digital on counselling and emotional wellbeing support to adults.

Job Overview:
Offering digital counselling and emotional wellbeing support to Adults

  • Providing text-based online counselling or psychotherapy, support and advice to adults within the iRespond clinical and operational model
  • Assessing and management of the risks and needs of each service user you interact with.
  • Appropriately signposting and completion of referrals as required

Clinical administration

Attending management supervision and meetings

The offer contracts of 30 (35 is full time) hours a week, which are available where you are willing to work further evenings up to 10pm and weekends. The service runs from 12pm to 10pm (Mon - Fri) and 6pm - 10pm (Sat - Sun), therefore all rota options will sit within our opening times. We offer a choice of 4 hour and 6 hour shifts.

Requirements

  • A relevant professional qualification in Counselling at level 4 (minimum) recognised by BACP, UKCP, NCS or equivalent.
  • Be registered with the BACP (MBACP reg.) or equivalent level registration with a recognised UK Counselling and Psychotherapy awarding body (NCS, UKCP, COSCA)
  • Accreditation-eligibility in counselling or psychotherapy at diploma level (level 4 minimum) or above.
  • A minimum of 450 supervised clinical practice hours and 3 years post-qualifying experience working as a qualified and clinically supervised Counsellor/Psychotherapist.
  • A minimum of 3 years post-qualifying experience in providing counselling and/or mental health support to adults 18+ in face-to-face or digital settings.
  • Experience in conducting risk and needs assessment, referral, and providing effective short-term and long-term counselling/psychotherapy.
  • Experience in risk management interventions.
  • Experience in adult safeguarding and child protection, and clear knowledge and understanding of safeguarding and child protection policies and legislation.
  • Experience in providing effective engagement and immediate support to help adult service users through challenging experiences and develop skills to make positive changes in their lives.
  • The ability to work remotely with a good broadband connection installed in your home/place of work, a comfortable and safe home working setup, alongside the competent and confident use of technology.
  • Exceptional time management skills and the ability to manage your own clinical caseload and all administrative tasks involved, in addition to having the ability to communicate effectively with teams via online communication platforms
  • You are available for a minimum of 30 hours per week comprising 4 or 6-hour shifts (or split shifts) per day - which are spread across afternoons, evenings, and weekends.

Prioritize your health and well-being with our comprehensive AXA plan and access to an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP). The EAP offers 24/7 telephone mental health support and access to GP consultations, ensuring your mental and physical health are taken care of.

Gain peace of mind knowing that you're covered with life assurance, providing up to four times your annual salary to your loved ones in the unfortunate event of your passing.

Novo, a global Christian ministry with its main office in Anaheim CA, is looking for a Communications Project Specialistto join our Communications Team. The right candidate should be aligned with Novo's Christian beliefs and a proven desire to serve in Christian ministry. To read more about Novo and our global mission, please visit www.Novo.org.

Summary of the Role

The Communications Project Specialist holds primary responsibility to develop and execute strategic projects, identify target audiences, create and analyze campaigns using effective marketing strategies, and evaluate the success of campaigns that support Novo’s mission, goals and objectives. The Specialist plays a crucial role in the success of communications strategies by clearly communicating Novo's voice to diverse audiences - making sure that the campaigns are as effective as possible - and oversees the work of project members, systems, and processes that influence audience growth and engagement efforts.

This position requires exceptional communications, writing, and editing skills, strong donor-engagement experience, and the ability to manage complex communications strategies from planning through execution.

Although this position is remote, the ideal candidate will have close proximity for in-person meetings at or near our office in Anaheim CA.

Responsibilities

  • Work with the Director to create and implement marketing and communication strategies, audience cultivation and segmentation strategies.
  • Provide strategic guidance and recommendations to support communications and marketing objectives, and identify opportunities to strengthen systems and integrations.
  • Develop and execute digital marketing strategies, translate organizational priorities into strategic communication and cultivation initiatives to increase Novo’s influence and audience growth across digital platforms and improve stakeholder engagement.
  • Oversee, write and/or edit, compelling content and messaging for diverse audiences that reflect Novo’s voice and move audiences toward meaningful action, and help translate high-level vision into coordinated execution across the team.
  • Ensure consistency of messaging across marketing and communications platforms and materials to support and strengthen Novo’s brand
  • Lead the selection, design, implementation, and ongoing management of effective processes and systems that improve the team’s effectiveness, collaboration, and ability to deliver excellent work on time.
  • Manage outcomes through project management and workflows, ensuring the completion of projects from strategy through completion.
  • Adhere to established standards, best practices, and processes for content creation, quality control, delivery, and content repurposing.
  • Measure and analyze digital marketing and campaign performance, oversee testing and experimentation, and translate results into strategic recommendations for ongoing improvement.
  • Supervise and provide professional development to Communications Team members as assigned by the Director.

Requirements and Skills:

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to successfully perform each essential duty with a high degree of competence.

  • 2-3 years demonstrated success in digital marketing, communications strategy, audience development, and related fundraising methods, preferably in a ministry-related environment.
  • Significant project management experience with tools like Asana, Monday.com, Slack, etc., with demonstrated ability to bring structure to complex work, manage competing priorities, and drive projects through completion.
  • Strong strategic thinking and organizational judgment; able to understand the larger context, ask thoughtful questions, respectfully challenge assumptions, and identify opportunities or potential problems.
  • Exceptional copywriting and editing skills, with the ability to learn and steward Novo’s voice and develop compelling content that moves people to action.
  • Proficiency with email marketing, digital campaigns, audience segmentation, testing and optimization, marketing technology, and content management systems, as well as experience with communications marketing tools like Mailchimp, hubspot, etc.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret audience and campaign data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent interpersonal, leadership, organizational, and time-management skills, with strong initiative, attention to detail, and follow-through.
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or a related field preferred with equivalent relevant professional experience.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, talk and hear. This job is sedentary, requiring the ability to sit most of the time. The ability to speak clearly and convey detailed or important instructions or ideas accurately, and the ability to hear average or normal conversations and receive ordinary information is necessary. Repetitive motions requiring frequent movement using the wrists, hands, and fingers, and average and ordinary visual acuity is necessary to prepare or inspect documents or operate computers and office equipment.

Required Personal Qualifications

Besides the professional requirements outlined above, the right candidates are those of the Christian faith who are aligned with Novo’s beliefs and values, can demonstrate a desire to work with a Christian ministry that is international and cross-cultural in nature, and have a passion to see movements of the gospel of Christ occur among the nations. It is expected that all Novo employees have a desire to serve God and others and embrace a high biblical Christ-like standard of conduct, both publicly and personally, are personally devoted to their Christian faith and have a high degree of emotional intelligence. Please visit our website, to review Novo's beliefs, mission, and values.

Application Process

Applicants must already have the legal right to work in the U.S. and be able to adequately represent Novo by satisfying the standards and requirements of the position, as outlined in the role description. To ensure we find candidates who meet the personal qualification listed above, please answer the additional questions provided on the application. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

Systems.

jobs.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

The Case Manager Lead is responsible for the day-to-day supervision, coordination, and execution of the pre-litigation case management team within the pod. This role ensures cases are properly investigated, documented, and progressed toward demand preparation and settlement.

The Case Manager Lead acts as the operational leader for the case manager team, ensuring case managers execute consistently, maintain organized files, and follow firm workflows and documentation standards. This role partners closely with the Pre-Litigation Attorney, who provides legal direction and strategy for cases.

What You Will Own

1. Case Manager Team Supervision

  • Supervise 3–5 Pre-Litigation Case Managers within the pod
  • Assign and balance workloads across the team
  • Provide guidance on case handling procedures and documentation standards
  • Ensure case managers understand priorities and case progression expectations
  • Provide coaching and day-to-day support to help case managers execute effectively
  • Serve as the primary operational liaison between the case manager team and the Pre-Litigation Attorney
  • Handle escalations from clients and providers, resolving issues before they reach the attorney or Ops Manager
  • Escalate friction points between case managers and the attorney to the Pre-Lit Case Manager Ops Manager

2. Medical Management & Case Value Ownership

  • Own MRI rates, advanced treatment rates, and ensure diagnostics are properly tracked and attended
  • Monitor and drive case velocity — ensuring cases move efficiently through each pre-litigation phase
  • Ensure settlements meet expected value targets relative to policy limits
  • Identify roadblocks to case progression and proactively clear them
  • Flag systemic medical management issues to the Pre-Lit Case Manager Ops Manager

3. Case Investigation & Documentation Oversight

  • Monitor progress of medical record collection and documentation gathering
  • Ensure case files contain required documentation and supporting evidence
  • Confirm liability and damages documentation is organized and complete
  • Review case files for completeness prior to escalation to the attorney
  • Maintain strong case file organization and documentation discipline

4. Data, Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Actively use dashboards and reporting tools to evaluate team KPIs and identify underperformance
  • Identify process changes and efficiency improvements through direct case experience and data analysis
  • Surface operational gaps and improvement ideas to the Pre-Lit Case Manager Ops Manager
  • Be comfortable building or pulling reports independently — data literacy is a core expectation of this role, not optional

5. Team Support & Development

  • Lead onboarding and training for new case managers joining the pod
  • Provide informal coaching and identify skill gaps requiring additional training
  • Promote consistency in case handling practices and ownership mentality across the team
  • Model best practices in case management, documentation, client communication, and ownership through personal caseload performance

6. Personal Caseload Management

  • Manage approximately 50 active pre-litigation cases, with an emphasis on higher-value matters
  • Be held to a higher performance standard than case managers given the complexity and value of the assigned caseload
  • Balance personal case execution responsibilities alongside team supervision duties
  • Demonstrate full ownership over cases — regardless of what other departments (medical records, CV specialists, settlement, etc.) have or haven't done, the Case Manager Lead is accountable for outcomes on their cases
  • Identify workflow challenges or process gaps through direct case experience and escalate operational improvements when needed

What You Bring

Required:

  • 6-8 years of experience supporting Personal Injury pre-litigation matters on cases in multiple states or the state of New York
  • Proven experience managing and leading a team of case managers, directing case strategy and workflow to efficiently drive files through each phase and toward timely settlement
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to manage a high-volume caseload in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience requesting, reviewing, and summarizing medical records and bills
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and work independently while collaborating with a team

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Bachelor’s degree or Paralegal Certificate (not required)

  • Experience in high-volume or fast-growing law firms
  • Familiarity with Personal Injury claims processes and insurance procedures
  • Experience with case management software (e.g., Filevine, Clio, SmartAdvocate)
  • Comfort working in evolving systems and processes

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

jobs.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Clinical Data Analyst III

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Clinical Data Analyst III (CDA III) to independently lead clinical data validation and data management activities across clinical studies. The role requires expertise in clinical data review, reconciliation, database quality control, risk identification, study start-up support, and cross-functional collaboration. The successful candidate will act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME), mentor junior team members, and contribute to process improvements while ensuring compliance with ICH-GCP guidelines and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently perform and lead clinical data validation, cleaning, review, and reconciliation activities throughout study conduct and database lock.
  • Manage data queries and conduct manual and SAS-generated listing reviews.
  • Perform reconciliation of external vendor data and ensure data integrity across systems.
  • Identify project risks, highlight delivery concerns, and support mitigation planning.
  • Support the preparation and maintenance of Data Management documentation and Trial Master File records.
  • Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities for clinical database setups.
  • Review study protocols, EDC screens, and database configurations.
  • Provide input into data management timelines and coordinate operational activities during study start-up.
  • Track and review CRFs and support data entry activities as required.
  • Perform quality control reviews and ensure compliance with SOPs, ICH-GCP guidelines, and regulatory requirements.
  • Act as a mentor and provide on-the-job training to Clinical Data Analysts.
  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for data management tools, systems, and processes.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives and implementation of project-specific tools and efficiencies.
  • Provide operational metric analysis and support scope change assessments and resource planning.
  • Act as backup to the Data Management Lead when required.

Required Skills

  • Strong leadership and collaboration skills with the ability to coordinate global and virtual teams.
  • Ability to independently interact with sponsors and stakeholders regarding data issues and study requirements.
  • Strong negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Advanced problem-solving and root cause analysis capabilities.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to first-time quality.
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Effective presentation and knowledge-sharing abilities.
  • Adaptability and ability to work in dynamic, fast-paced environments.
  • Strong mentoring and coaching skills.

Technical Requirements

  • Strong experience with Clinical Data Management Systems such as Medidata Rave, Oracle InForm, Veeva, DataLabs, or ClinBase.
  • Advanced understanding of clinical data management processes, including data cleaning, reconciliation, and database lock activities.
  • Expertise in database setup activities and data validation specifications.
  • Knowledge of MedDRA and WHODrug coding dictionaries.
  • Understanding of CDISC standards.
  • Basic knowledge of SAS and programmed listings.
  • Strong knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines, clinical research regulations, and industry best practices.
  • Experience leading virtual data management teams across global studies.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Nursing, or a related healthcare discipline.
  • Relevant experience in Clinical Data Management within the clinical research or CRO industry.

This role focuses on the people, process, technology, and data aspects of adoption, ensuring that users are not only equipped but also motivated to embrace new tools as part of their daily workflows. Experience in manufacturing or process industry environments, where adoption impacts standard business process cycles, shop floor workspace, supply chain collaboration, and compliance workflows is highly desirable.

Original Composites & Fiberglass is a business unit of the Praana Group. Original Composites & Fiberglass was recently acquired by the Praana Group. The path ahead will be dynamic, full of change, and expected to be fast paced. The business operates from twenty (20+) locations across the
globe. The information technology environment supporting our new company is being built
from the ground up in terms of IT infrastructure and applications with the opportunity to
leverage new technologies and new ways of thinking as we look to end a transition services

Executive Vice President (EVP) Finance – Insurance & Investments

About the Role

The Executive Vice President (EVP) Finance is a senior enterprise-level finance executive responsible for providing strategic and operational financial leadership across the Group's insurance, investment, asset management, and related financial services businesses.

The EVP Finance will work closely with the Group CFO, CEO, Board, business-unit CEOs, investment leadership, and senior executives to strengthen financial performance, capital efficiency, profitability, governance, risk management, and long-term enterprise value.

Key Responsibilities

Lead enterprise-wide financial strategy, planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management.

Provide executive oversight of financial performance across subsidiaries, business units, and investment platforms.

Drive Group-wide FP&A, management reporting, financial modelling, and commercial finance.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, margins, cash flow, ROE, ROIC, and return on capital.

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, reinsurance, underwriting performance, and profitability.

Provide financial leadership for investment and asset management businesses, including portfolio reporting, valuation, investment income, performance analysis, and cost management.

Lead strategic capital planning, capital allocation, solvency, liquidity, and balance-sheet optimization.

Provide executive oversight of treasury, funding, cash management, and liquidity planning.

Establish and strengthen Group-wide financial governance, internal controls, accounting policies, and risk-management frameworks.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, insurance regulations, investment regulations, and statutory reporting requirements.

Lead financial evaluation and due diligence for M&A, acquisitions, joint ventures, strategic investments, restructuring, and market expansion.

Partner with the Investment, Actuarial, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Treasury, and Operations functions on major strategic and financial decisions.

Drive enterprise-wide cost optimization, operational efficiency, and profitability improvement.

Lead finance transformation, including ERP modernization, automation, AI/data analytics, dashboards, and digital finance initiatives.

Maintain senior relationships with regulators, auditors, investors, lenders, rating agencies, and other financial stakeholders.

Provide high-level financial advice to the CEO, Group CFO, Board, and Executive Committee.

Build a strong succession pipeline and lead senior finance executives across the organization.

Support the development and execution of the Group's long-term growth and value-creation strategy.

Strategic KPIs

Group revenue and earnings growth

EBITDA / operating profit

ROE, ROIC, and return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Insurance underwriting profitability

Budget and forecast accuracy

Cost-to-income and expense efficiency

Liquidity and treasury performance

Balance-sheet optimization

Cost of capital

M&A and strategic investment returns

Regulatory and audit performance

Finance transformation and automation

Shareholder and enterprise value creation

Candidate Profile

18–25+ years of progressive finance experience, preferably within insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, reinsurance, pensions, or diversified financial services.

Extensive experience in enterprise-level, Group, regional, or multi-entity finance leadership.

Previous experience as EVP Finance, Executive Vice President Finance, Group Finance Director, Group CFO, CFO, SVP Finance, Finance Director, Deputy Group CFO, or equivalent.

Strong understanding of insurance finance, investment finance, capital management, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory requirements.

Demonstrated experience managing complex organizations with multiple subsidiaries, business lines, and jurisdictions.

Strong commercial understanding of investments, financial markets, capital allocation, and enterprise performance.

Proven track record in M&A, capital raising, strategic investments, restructuring, or major transformation initiatives.

Extensive experience engaging with Boards, CEOs, regulators, investors, auditors, and other senior stakeholders.

Proven ability to lead large, geographically dispersed finance organizations.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

Additional qualifications in insurance, investments, risk, actuarial science, or financial management are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Enterprise Finance Strategy | Group Financial Management | FP&A | Financial Reporting | Insurance Finance | Investment Finance | Capital Allocation | Treasury | Solvency | Balance-Sheet Management | M&A | Financial Modelling | Risk Management | Governance | Regulatory Compliance | Cost Optimization | Finance Transformation | Executive Leadership

Leadership Characteristics

Exceptional strategic and commercial judgment

Strong executive presence

Enterprise-wide perspective

High integrity and governance orientation

Strong analytical and decision-making capability

Excellent Board and stakeholder communication

Results-driven and financially disciplined

Transformational and innovation-oriented

Strong talent-development and succession-planning capability

Comfortable operating in complex, regulated, multinational environments

The Senior Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is responsible for managing and executing field medical activities within a specific geographic territory and contributing to company-wide initiatives that support Servier’s strategy. The MSL will serve as a critical link between Servier and external healthcare providers (HCPs) establishing strong professional collaborations with investigators and other HCPs within the designated territory. Focusing on neuromuscular disease, the MSL will provide credible scientific expertise within Servier and share scientific insights that will impact the strategies of U.S and Global Medical teams, Servier’s Leadership Team, and other internal stakeholders. The MSL’s actions and collaborations with HCP’s are on the forefront of advancing science and medicine on behalf of patients.

Scientific Exchange with HCPs

  • Utilize internal platforms to identify and qualify key opinion leaders (KOLs) within your geographic territory.
  • Prepare and maintain a territory management plan that will be shared with Medical leadership and other internal stakeholders.

If you have experience in luxury sales, private aviation, high-ticket services, hospitality, travel, real estate, financial services, or other relationship-driven sales environments, this could be an excellent fit.

Charter Sales & Closing

  • Track opportunities, follow-ups, bookings, and sales activity
  • Manage multiple active opportunities simultaneously
  • Ensure no qualified leads or follow-ups fall through the cracks
  • Maintain accurate pipeline visibility
  • Support forecasting and sales performance reporting

Client Retention & Revenue Growth

  • Develop relationships that generate repeat charter business
  • Identify opportunities to deepen existing client relationships
  • Maintain consistent follow-up with high-value prospects and clients
  • Deliver a level of service that encourages referrals and long-term loyalty
  • Contribute directly to revenue and booking growth

On-Call Client Coverage

  • Participate in a rotating coverage schedule when required
  • Respond to time-sensitive client inquiries outside standard business hours
  • Maintain professionalism and urgency in a client-first environment

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’re polished, confident, and highly professional with clients
  • You understand how to sell high-ticket products or services
  • You build trust naturally rather than relying on aggressive sales tactics
  • You’re comfortable communicating with executives and affluent clientele
  • You respond quickly and understand that speed can determine whether a deal closes
  • You stay organized while managing multiple high-value opportunities
  • You understand the importance of discretion and confidentiality

  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, performance-driven sales environment

  • Concierge services
  • Executive services
  • Luxury real estate
  • Financial services

  • Knowledge of private aircraft categories and cabin configurations
  • Understanding of charter operations
  • Experience serving high-net-worth or ultra-high-net-worth clients
  • Familiarity with cryptocurrency transactions

You may start by reviewing active charter inquiries and following up with clients considering flight options.

Throughout the day, you’ll speak with prospective and existing clients, understand their travel requirements, recommend appropriate solutions, coordinate with operations, manage bookings, and follow up on active opportunities.

You’ll keep the CRM current, maintain visibility across your pipeline, and ensure clients receive prompt communication throughout their journey.

The Senior Analyst, Lifecycle & Loyalty Analytics will help scale the analytics practice supporting Shake Shack’s owned media channels, with a focus on email, push communications, loyalty program performance, and third-party delivery promotions. The role will integrate guest, channel, campaign, offer, and transaction data to assess performance, uncover growth opportunities, and inform strategic decision making. In partnership with Lifecycle Marketing, Product, MarTech, IT, Finance, and external partners, the analyst will develop data-driven reporting, prepare and analyze data, design and evaluate tests, and translate insights into actionable channel strategies and recommendations.   • Loyalty Program Analytics: Evaluate member acquisition, activation, engagement, reward behavior, retention, frequency, spend, and movement through the loyalty lifecycle

  • 3PD/Aggregator Analytics: Evaluate third-party delivery promotion performance, including offer redemption, incrementality, order behavior, sales trends, and repeat purchase impact

  • Test Design and Evaluation: Help design controlled tests and measurement approaches, including hypotheses, success metrics, audience rules, holdouts, sample requirements, quality checks, and post-test readouts

  • Dashboarding and Self-Service Reporting: Develop and maintain actionable dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reports that give channel leads a consistent view of performance and business outcomes

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Lifecycle, Loyalty, Guest Insights, Data, Finance, Operations, and external partners to align questions, methods, definitions, and decision needs

  • Analytics Practice Development: Help establish repeatable ways of working for intake, prioritization, analysis, testing, reporting, documentation, and knowledge sharing across Lifecycle & Loyalty Analytics

4-6 years

A work environment where you can come as you are, share your ideas, have fun, and work collaboratively:

Beginning as a hot dog cart in New York City’s Madison Square Park, Shake Shack was created by Danny Meyer, Founder and CEO of Union Square Hospitality Group and best-selling author of Setting the Table. Provides support for Energy Management Systems (EMS) power systems applications portfolio such as Power Flow, State Estimator, Contingency Analysis, Load Frequency Control, Dynamic Stability Analysis, Load Forecasting, Operator Training Simulator (OTS) etc. Actively involved in the design, development, testing, validation and implementation of modifications and enhancements to EMS applications. This position will report to the Supervisor/Manager of Grid & Market Solutions (GMS) Applications Engineering - Grid.

Requirements

JOB DUTIES

  • Understands and applies principles, theories and concepts related to the profession and company’s culture.
  • Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action.
  • Impact is generally limited to specific assignments or projects.
  • May respond to inquiries and/or provide assistance and/or guidance to lower level workers.

ADDITIONAL JOB DUTIES

  • Works under the direction of a senior level engineer or supervisor/manager to complete departmental goals and assignments
  • Performs all work according to applicable rules and regulations including regulatory requirements and organization policies and procedures
  • Assists in the proactive enhancements, improvements and issue remediation for OTS and Real Time Power System Applications which includes State Estimator, Contingency Analysis, and Dispatcher Load Flow, Load Forecast, Load Frequency Control for both Energy Management System (EMS) and Real Time Nodal (RTN) Market
    Coordinate application set up and testing with/for Market Participants as appropriate
  • Performs model load testing in Energy and Market Management System on a periodic basis and updates the model data in real-time based on the procedures
  • Design and Test Energy and Market Management System and Interfaces and Web & Client/Server applications changes
  • Verify and support Energy and Market Management applications during Energy and Market Management System site failovers
  • Validate Energy and Market Management applications during any server/system/database upgrades and patching
  • Supports the execution of EMS Disaster Recovery Drills and Company EMS business continuity procedures
  • Maintain, troubleshoot and repair EMS and OTS applications and interfaces, and escalate as appropriate
  • May provide on the job training or help oversee the work of other engineers/analysts
  • Act as a consultant, representative and subject matter expert in project and activities that affect the EMS and OTS environments and applications as appropriate
  • Participates in multifunctional teams to obtain input, address comments and provide application support
  • Represents the GMS Grid Engineering Team at interdepartmental and Stakeholder meetings
  • Provides on the job training or help oversee the work of other engineers/analysts
  • May act as mentor and advisor to less experienced engineers/analysts
  • Works independently on assignments and projects
  • Participates in multifunctional teams to perform studies
  • Assists in developing tools, processes and procedures that enhance system reliability and departmental/organizational efficiencies
  • Participates with other Company departments to select and implement system changes as needed
  • Serves as the technical Subject Matter Expert for the department
  • Makes independent decisions except in instances of unusually complex application scenarios
  • Works on the most complex application issues where analysis of situations requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors
  • Works with database administrators and infrastructure teams on complex Energy Management System application issues triggered from server/network/storage/database components
  • Tests Non-Functional requirements of Energy Management System application changes and coordinates with database/infrastructure teams to performs the tests
  • Fosters and leverages strong working relationships with other internal departments
  • Lends professional expertise to guide projects and help teammates assigned by manager
  • Demonstrates skills as an expert user of power system software applications and tools, spreadsheet programs, and database programs
  • Maintains knowledge of emerging trends and industry best practices

EXPERIENCE

  • Requires minimum 5 years related work experience in excess of degree requirements

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor's Degree : Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related field (Required)
  • Master's Degree : Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related field (Preferred)
  • or a combination of education and experience that provides equivalent knowledge to a major in such fields is required

Benefits

The base pay range for this role is $67.25 - $77.25 per Hour.

MWResource offers medical, dental and vision coverage through Florida Blue, short- and long-term disability coverage, employer paid life insurance, and participation in the MWResource 401K plan for US based consultants.

Applications accepted on a rolling basis until filled.

MWResource does not discriminate based on race, gender, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or anything else that makes you part of any group.

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States.

Candidates will be required to pass a background check and drug screening.

Please note we are not open to outsourcing our recruitment needs.

jobs.description:
Crow Holdings Renewables (CHR) is a subsidiary of Crow Holdings, a leading real estate investment and development firm founded in 1948 and based in Dallas, Texas. CHR aims to apply the real estate company’s development expertise and local presence in several of the fastest-growing solar markets across the U.S. to develop community- and utility-scale solar energy and battery storage projects across the country. With 18 offices across the U.S., Crow Holdings’ local, on-the-ground presence amplifies its hands-on capabilities across a broad range of investment strategies, product types, and ventures in partnership with institutional investors. Crow Holdings has $35 billion in assets under management, one of the largest multifamily and industrial development platforms in the nation, and a diversified investment portfolio, pursuing compelling investment opportunities to capitalize on evolving, secular growth potential. For over 75 years, Crow Holdings’ success has been rooted in its founding principles of partnership, collaboration, and alignment of interests. For more information, please visit: .

Position Summary

Crow Holdings Renewables is seeking an Associate - Development, Distributed Generation. Illinois-based candidates are preferred, though qualified candidates in other states will be considered.

The Associate will take the lead on permitting, interconnection, and related development activities for distributed generation solar and energy storage projects, primarily in Illinois, and may contribute to projects in other target markets. This position will execute project-level development schedules, contribute to market strategy, independently manage assigned workflows, and collaborate with senior team members on significant commercial and project decisions.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead day-to-day development of assigned projects, coordinating with real estate, permitting, interconnection, engineering, construction, legal, finance, and operations teams to achieve key milestones
  • Manage utility interconnection applications and studies, including milestones, deliverables, deadlines, fees, deposits, and upgrade requirements
  • Manage local, regional, and state permitting processes by coordinating consultants, preparing application materials, facilitating public meetings, and tracking approvals and permit conditions
  • Maintain project schedules, development budgets, risk registers, and action items from early development through NTP or project sale
  • Cultivate positive relationships with landowners, utilities, municipalities, project neighbors, and other key stakeholders
  • Monitor legislation, regulations, incentive programs, and other market developments affecting assigned projects
  • Prepare project budgets, expense requests, and related materials for internal review and approval
  • Represent CHR at industry events, conferences, community meetings, and other stakeholder engagements

Desired Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum of two years of experience in community-scale or utility-scale solar or energy storage development, with responsibility for advancing projects through key milestones
  • Experience advancing at least one project to NTP, portfolio sale, or a comparable late-stage milestone strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with Illinois community solar programs, permitting, and utility interconnection processes strongly preferred
  • Experience managing project schedules, budgets, risk registers, and development trackers
  • Ability to interpret zoning ordinances, utility requirements, technical reports, contracts, and permit conditions
  • Experience coordinating external consultants, including civil engineers, environmental consultants, land-use counsel, and interconnection specialists
  • Ability to work independently, communicate proactively, and collaborate effectively in a fully remote environment
  • Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to resolve complex issues and recognize when escalation or collaboration is appropriate
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build relationships and consensus among diverse stakeholders
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project-management software; experience with Smartsheet or similar platforms preferred
  • Ability and willingness to travel to project sites, municipal and community meetings, and utility meetings

jobs.title: Senior Meta Paid Social Executive
jobs.excerpt: About Vintage. comAt Vintage. com, we’re building the most trusted platform for pre-loved items.
jobs.description:
About Vintage.com

At Vintage.com, we’re building the most trusted platform for pre-loved items. We help people give valuable things a new life, making the experience simple, transparent and rewarding.
We bring together specialist knowledge, thoughtful technology and genuine care for our customers. By helping more items stay in circulation, we create value for people and make a positive impact at the same time.

About the Team

Our Growth Team helps more people discover Vintage.com and turn that discovery into customers. We bring together performance marketing, creative, data and experimentation to understand what works, reach the right audiences and grow our customer base across the UK and international markets.

Paid Social plays an important part in that growth. The team combines data, creative thinking and continuous testing to run campaigns that reach new audiences, generate high-quality leads and help us understand how we can grow efficiently.

Why This Role Matters

Why the role exists

As a Senior Paid Social Executive, you’ll play a hands-on role in managing, optimising and scaling Paid Social activity across Vintage.com. Meta is at the core of this position.

We’re looking for someone with strong practical experience who can step into an established Meta account, understand how it is structured and performing, and start making informed decisions quickly.

You’ll be comfortable working directly in Meta Ads Manager every day: building campaigns, diagnosing performance changes, making optimisation and scaling decisions, testing creative and audiences, and understanding how tracking and attribution affect the decisions we make.

This role is for someone who has moved beyond learning the fundamentals. You’ll still work collaboratively with the wider Performance Marketing team, but you’ll be expected to operate with a high degree of independence and bring your own judgement and experience to the accounts.

What success looks like

  • You quickly develop a strong understanding of our Meta account, campaign structure, customer acquisition model and performance drivers.
  • You confidently manage significant areas of Meta activity with limited day-to-day supervision.
  • Campaign performance is actively optimised rather than simply monitored.
  • You can diagnose why performance has changed and determine the appropriate action.
  • Scaling decisions balance volume, efficiency and lead quality.
  • Creative testing is structured, purposeful and translates into actionable learning.
  • Tracking, conversion and attribution issues are identified, investigated and resolved quickly.
  • You bring ideas and experience into the team rather than relying solely on an established playbook.
  • Paid Social activity becomes faster, more effective and easier to scale.
  • You support less experienced colleagues in developing stronger Paid Social judgement and technical capability.

What You’ll Do

Meta Campaign Ownership & Optimisation

  • Take hands-on responsibility for building, launching, managing and optimising campaigns within Meta Ads Manager.
  • Quickly understand existing account structures, campaigns, audiences, budgets, tracking and performance patterns.
  • Make informed decisions around campaign structure, budgets, audiences, placements, optimisation and scaling.
  • Diagnose underperformance and identify whether issues relate to audience, creative, campaign setup, tracking, conversion or wider customer behaviour.
  • Identify opportunities to scale successful activity while protecting efficiency and lead quality.
  • Maintain strong standards of account structure, campaign accuracy and quality assurance.
  • Challenge existing approaches where performance data suggests there is a better way.
  • Support strategic testing and expansion into other Paid Social platforms.

Creative Performance & Testing

  • Own structured creative testing across formats, concepts, hooks, messaging and audiences.
  • Identify what is driving creative performance rather than relying solely on topline metrics.
  • Translate performance data into clear and actionable briefs for Creative teams.
  • Work collaboratively with Creative colleagues to develop new hypotheses and testing priorities.
  • Build a strong understanding of creative fatigue, iteration and winning characteristics.
  • Ensure testing generates usable learning rather than isolated campaign results.
  • Use approved AI tools where appropriate to accelerate ideation, analysis and creative workflows.

Data, Tracking & Technical Understanding

  • Confidently work with Meta pixels, events, conversions and campaign tracking.
  • Identify and investigate discrepancies between platform and internal performance data.
  • Work closely with Data colleagues on tracking, attribution and reporting issues.
  • Understand how tracking quality affects optimisation and campaign decision-making.
  • Analyse performance across metrics including CPL, conversion rate, lead quality and acquisition efficiency.
  • Turn complex campaign data into clear commercial recommendations.
  • Contribute to daily, weekly and monthly performance reporting.

Paid Social Development

  • Bring practical experience from previous Paid Social environments into the team.
  • Support the testing and development of channels including TikTok, Pinterest and other emerging opportunities.
  • Evaluate whether learnings from Meta can be transferred effectively into other platforms.
  • Stay close to platform changes and understand how they may affect campaign structure, targeting, measurement or creative.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the way we work, test and report.

Collaboration & Team Contribution

  • Work closely with Performance Marketing, Creative, CRM, Data and wider Growth colleagues.
  • Provide clear recommendations rather than simply reporting what has happened.
  • Share knowledge and practical Paid Social expertise with less experienced colleagues.
  • Support the development of Paid Social Executives through day-to-day guidance and knowledge sharing.
  • Raise issues early and take ownership of getting them resolved.
  • Balance immediate performance decisions with longer-term learning and testing.

What You’ll Bring

Essential

  • Strong, recent and hands-on experience optimising campaigns directly within Meta Ads Manager.
  • Demonstrable experience independently building, launching, optimising and scaling Meta campaigns.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why South Africa

South Africa has one of the strongest engineering communities anywhere in the world, and we are deliberately growing our technology organisation in the country. We already have several team members based here. The work is fully remote, and the mission we are working on is a good deal closer to home than it is for our teams elsewhere.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Payment Gateway to join us in South Africa.

About The Role

Monnify is Moniepoint's online payment acceptance platform: the gateway layer connecting merchants to card networks, banks and payment aggregators, and the tools that let businesses and developers accept and send money digitally. The division owns transaction reliability, routing and throughput at scale, together with the developer experience that sits on top of it - APIs, SDKs, documentation and ease of integration. Built first for Nigerian businesses and developers, the platform is now scaling internationally and moving towards multi-currency, multi-market support.

The Head of Engineering owns the technical direction and architecture of that platform, ensuring scalability, security and developer experience for both technical and non-technical users. The role involves leading multiple engineering teams through their managers, setting strategic architecture, and ensuring platform reliability, security and scalability across Payment In, Payout, Commerce Tools and developer-facing features. As the Head of Engineering, Payment Gateway, your responsibilities will include:

  • Own the full technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Monnify platform across all capability areas.
  • Lead multiple engineering teams through engineering managers, setting quality standards and building organisational capability.
  • Own the developer experience end-to-end, including APIs, documentation, SDKs and integration ease.
  • Drive platform evolution towards multi-currency and international scalability.
  • Ensure platform reliability, scalability and security within a regulated environment.
  • Partner with product, commercial and operations teams to align technical investments with business goals.
  • Hire, mentor and develop engineering managers and senior engineers to support growth.

Who You Are

  • Over 10 years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in engineering leadership roles.
  • 5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not only years spent overseeing teams who write it.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers - leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
  • Experience in payments, fintech or financial services products, with a working understanding of payment flows and compliance.
  • Deep knowledge of API-first products, developer platforms and API integration.
  • Proven leadership of multiple engineering teams via managers in a scaling organisation.
  • Strong backend engineering skills in high-throughput, distributed transactional systems.
  • Experience building or operating a payment gateway or multi-currency payment platform is a strong plus.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What To Expect In The Hiring Process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter
  • A Panel interview session with two of our VPs of Engineering
  • A Technical Assessment with our Group CTO / Co-founder
  • A Behavioral and technical interview with our Group CEO / Founder
  • Technical Workshop with our Group CTO / Co-founder

Some of the technologies you’ll get to work with

  • Java (latest versions)
  • Spring and Spring Boot
  • Docker and Kubernetes
  • PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Elastic search
  • Microservices architecture on AWS

What we can offer you

  • Own the payments infrastructure that thousands of businesses and developers build on, at a company processing hundreds of billions of dollars in transaction volume annually.
  • Work in a fast-paced, technically demanding environment at the core of how money moves in high-growth markets.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $50/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.

Would you like to work with high-quality Spirometry products and build new business in Sweden? We are looking for a medtech sales professional who likes to work independently and who would like to be able to influence product development!

Sales Manager in Sweden - Spirometry

About the Company - Spirometry simplified

At Medikro, we develop, manufacture, and market spirometry systems for pulmonary diagnostics and monitoring. We combine decades of engineering expertise and exceptional customer support with a dedicated focus on quality and ease of use to create state-of-the-art spirometers and comprehensive solutions that allow respiratory health professionals to focus on what matters most, their patients.

Since our founding in 1977 we are ultimately driven by the same goal of any health care professional – to ensure better health outcomes – and we exist to deliver on this promise. Medikro works with distributers in 25 countries and with direct sales in Finland, Sweden and Denmark.

From Finland to the world

Medikro, headquartered in Kuopio, Finland, is a global company with a strong presence in spirometry market. Our distributor network for Medikro products currently spans over 25 countries, ensuring widespread availability and accessibility. With our trusted OEM partners, Medikro pulmonary technology is actively utilized and recognized on every continent. Our team of dedicated employees is committed to providing high-quality respiratory solutions worldwide.

Quality above all

Medikro is the technology leader in computer-based spirometers and we are actively introducing innovative solutions for better and more efficient asthma and COPD treatment. A new generation of Medikro spirometers with disposable flow transducers represents a number of technological innovations in pulmonary diagnostics.

Our key products include mobile and desktop, spirometers that are sold globally under the Medikro brand as well as through our OEM partners. Our end customers include world-class hospitals, clinics, and occupational health centers. Each year, over three million spirometry tests are accomplished with Medikro pulmonary technology.

All Medikro spirometry products meet or exceed the EN ISO 26782 and the ATS/ERS standards for accuracy and precision. Medikro is an ISO 13485:2016 certified company.

Medikro has received certification under the EU Medical Device Regulation (MDR 2017/745) for its devices and quality management system. The certification was granted following a comprehensive audit and technical documentation review.

Trusted OEM partner

We offer our complete line of spirometers and accessories as OEM products, so you can integrate our reliable and high-quality devices seamlessly into your own brand.

About you:

We are looking for someone with experience in sales in medtech, who is self-directed and takes full sales responsibility in Sweden for the product portfolio. A background in spirometry is an advantage, but not a requirement.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.

  • Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native iOS experience using Swift.

  • Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in China. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in China.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
