jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Rewards
jobs.excerpt: Who we areMoniepoint Inc.  is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why Kenya

Kenya is where our next chapter begins. Following our acquisition of Sumac Microfinance Bank, we're preparing to go live — which means the people we hire here help build a business from its first day, not inherit one. How we execute in Kenya will shape how we approach every market we enter after it, making this one of the most consequential engineering mandates in the business right now. This is the natural extension of our mission: to drive financial inclusion, and help millions of business owners and individuals across the African continent achieve financial happiness and success.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Rewards to join us in Kenya.

About The Role

Rewards is one of the most strategically important platforms at Moniepoint, and it is being built into a dedicated charter with its own engineering and product leadership. The platform sits at the centre of our retention strategy across a user base of approximately 23 million people.

Today the platform does one thing: cashback. It works, but it has barely scratched the surface of what rewards can be, and the cashback product itself is not yet built to the depth it deserves. The ambition is to evolve it into a full rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform — and to do that across the full 360 degrees of our network. That means rewards for our business customers, rewards for our consumer customers, and rewards for the sales agents who drive our distribution. Very few companies get to design this from close to a blank page at this scale.

The Head of Engineering owns that platform end to end. You will inherit a team of nine engineers, including an Engineering Manager, and build the organisation out from there — the current expectation is a minimum of three product units and upwards of 25 people, though the eventual shape is genuinely yours to define. Your first objective is to get the best possible performance out of the cashback product we already have. From there, you will work with Growth, Sales and Marketing to determine what we build for acquisition and retention, and roll it out across every customer we serve.

This is a consumer-facing product engineering role, and that is the most important thing to understand about it. Rewards is won or lost on experimentation, personalisation, and the quality of the experience in a customer's hands. We are looking for a leader who has built and shipped direct-to-consumer products at scale, who is fluent in experimentation and A/B testing, and who has real depth in front-end and mobile engineering — not a purely backend platform leader.

Moniepoint runs a Domain CTO model. We view our Heads of Engineering as the CTO of their domain: you own the technical roadmap, the architecture, the delivery, and the organisation beneath you. You will have full autonomy over engineering strategy, architecture, hiring, operating cadence and roadmap trade-offs.

You will report functionally to our Group CTO, with a dual reporting line into the Product leader for Rewards. That second line is a delivery relationship rather than a seniority one — engineering and product are peers here, and you will build the team to full capacity together. Your responsibilities as Head of Engineering, Rewards includes:

  • Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Rewards Platform end to end.
  • Improving the performance, reliability and depth of the existing cashback product as an immediate first priority.
  • Evolving cashback into a broader rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform serving business customers, consumer customers and sales agents.
  • Building the engineering organisation from its current base - structuring product units, hiring engineers and Engineering Managers, and leading through those managers as the team scales.
  • Establishing a strong experimentation culture: A/B testing, cohort analysis, and measurement that lets the team learn quickly what actually changes customer behaviour.
  • Working closely with Growth, Sales and Marketing to translate acquisition and retention objectives into product and engineering initiatives.
  • Owning the customer-facing experience of rewards across mobile and web, including how quickly and reliably customers receive what they have earned.
  • Define architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and own the engineering health of the domain — incidents, production defects, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and developer experience.
  • Build the platform to serve customers across multiple geographies as Moniepoint expands.
  • Partner with Product to define the rewards-specific metrics and OKRs that do not yet exist, and hold the team to them.

Who You Are

  • Direct-to-consumer product engineering at scale. You have built and shipped products used directly by large consumer audiences, and you understand what moves engagement and retention. This is the defining requirement of the role.
  • Genuine front-end and mobile depth. You have led or personally built consumer-facing mobile and web experiences. A backend-only background, however strong, is not what this role needs.
  • Experimentation and growth engineering. Hands-on experience running A/B tests, feature flagging, and measurement frameworks, and using the results to drive product decisions rather than to justify them.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, not a single team.
  • Hands-on technical leadership. You are still close to the code. We expect a meaningful proportion of hands-on engineering time and technical credibility with the engineers you lead.
  • 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
  • Comfort with our backend environment — Java and Spring Boot — and the ability to lead backend engineers credibly, even if it is not where your own depth sits.
  • Experience building and scaling an engineering organisation from a small base, including hiring and developing Engineering Managers.
  • Strong collaboration with commercial stakeholders — growth, marketing and sales — and the ability to translate business objectives into engineering work.
  • Rewards, loyalty, gamification, personalisation or growth platform experience is a strong advantage but is not required.
  • Fintech or payments experience is an advantage, not a requirement.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like In The Role

  • The existing cashback product performing measurably better — faster, more reliable, and more compelling to customers.
  • A credible rewards platform roadmap defined with Product, and the first initiatives beyond cashback shipped.
  • A functioning experimentation practice, where the team ships, measures and learns on a short cycle.
  • An engineering organisation built out from its current base, with a strong bench of Engineering Managers and senior engineers.
  • Rewards established as a measurable contributor to retention and engagement across the customer base.
  • Clear architecture standards and engineering processes in place across the product units.

Why Join Us

  • A rare blank page. The platform exists, but almost everything it could become is still ahead of it, and you will define what that is.
  • Direct influence on retention across a base of roughly 23 million users, at one of the largest and fastest-growing digital banks in Africa.
  • Full autonomy as the CTO of your domain, with the backing to build the organisation you think the problem needs.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.

What To Expect In The Hiring Process

  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Zelh is seeking a dependable, detail-oriented Track & Trace Coordinator to support our freight brokerage operations. This position is responsible for monitoring active shipments from pickup through final delivery, maintaining accurate load information, communicating with carriers and drivers, and quickly identifying potential service issues. The Track & Trace Coordinator plays an important role in providing excellent customer service by ensuring our team always knows where each shipment is and whether it is operating according to schedule. This is a fast-paced position requiring strong communication, organization, follow-through, and the ability to manage multiple shipments simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities

•Monitor active shipments from dispatch through final delivery.

•Contact carriers and drivers to obtain accurate pickup, transit, and delivery updates.

•Confirm drivers are on schedule for pickup and delivery appointments.

•Verify arrival and departure times at shippers and receivers.

•Update shipment status, notes, ETA information, and appointment details in the TMS.

•Identify late trucks, missed appointments, breakdowns, detention, rejected product, temperature issues, and other potential service failures.

•Immediately escalate significant service issues to the appropriate operations or sales team member.

•Proactively communicate delays rather than waiting for customers or internal team members to discover an issue.

•Maintain consistent communication with carriers until problems are resolved.

•Obtain and upload Bills of Lading, Proofs of Delivery, lumper receipts, and other required shipment documentation.

•Assist with scheduling and confirming pickup and delivery appointments as needed.

•Ensure completed loads contain the information and documentation necessary for billing.

•Maintain clear, professional, and accurate notes so another team member can quickly understand the status of any shipment.

•Assist Customer Sales and Carrier Sales representatives with operational support as needed.

  • Competitive Salary in USD

  • Remote mode of work

  • 10+ business days of paid time off

  • Team building and corporate events

  • Equipment provided

  • A supportive team

Requirements

  • Extremely dependable with strong follow-through.

  • Detail-oriented and organized.

  • Comfortable making frequent phone calls, sending emails, and communicating by text.

  • Able to manage a high volume of shipments without losing track of details.

  • Strong sense of urgency when something is going wrong.

  • Able to recognize potential problems before they become customer service failures.

  • Comfortable working independently and making decisions within established procedures.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

  • A successful Track & Trace Coordinator doesn't simply enter updates into the system. They own shipment visibility.

This is a global role. Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer (COO), the Counsel, IP Litigation & Enforcement serves as a core legal resource to IP House’s investigations, enforcement, and compliance response functions worldwide.

The role is built for breadth. In a given week, Counsel may advise an enforcement team on whether a matter is properly actionable, help assemble a criminal referral package alongside investigators and a client, work with outside counsel on a client’s filed civil action, and advise on legal process routed through our Compliance Response Solutions team. Matters span multiple jurisdictions and legal traditions, so the role suits a self-starter who manages many concurrent matters with precision, holds firm to deadlines across time zones, and can render a complex legal position into plain language that non-lawyers can act on immediately.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

IP Investigation & Enforcement Counseling

  • Serve as the day-to-day “go-to” legal resource for the IP investigation and enforcement teams, both online and offline.
  • Establish, document, and maintain investigation and enforcement legal standards, decision criteria, and escalation thresholds that work across jurisdictions, and provide the training and written guidance that lets teams resolve routine questions on their own.
  • Advise on evidence sufficiency, collection methodology, documentation, and chain-of-custody so that work product withstands scrutiny in civil, criminal, administrative, and customs forums.
  • Identify where local law materially changes the analysis and instruct local counsel to close the gap; escalate elevated legal, regulatory, or reputational risk to the COO with a decision-ready recommendation.

IP Litigation, Escalation & Referrals

  • Partner with the investigations and enforcement teams and with clients to assess matters for escalation to civil litigation, criminal referral, private prosecution where available, or administrative and customs action.
  • Support client’s civil IP litigation through its lifecycle alongside their designated outside and local counsel — including pre-suit assessment, review of pleadings and submissions as it relates to IP House involvement, discovery and disclosure support, and instances where IP House employees or affiliates act as an expert witness.
  • Support preparation of referral packages for law enforcement agencies and prosecuting authorities, including factual chronologies, legal theories, loss framing, and evidentiary indices.
  • Act as a legal point of coordination with law enforcement, prosecuting authorities, customs and border agencies, regulators, and platform partners, and advise on cross-border evidence gathering and third-party disclosure tools.
  • Track escalated matters through disposition, manage instructed counsel on scope, budget, and timeline, and counsel client-facing teams on realistic outcomes and timelines.

Revenue Recovery

  • Act as the primary legal liaison for the Revenue Recovery team.
  • Work with the Revenue Recovery team to ensure processes, evidentiary standards, and declarations confirm with legal requirements.
  • In consultation with outside counsel, advise internally on claim and evidence viability, limitation periods, jurisdiction and governing law, and collectability, and help standardize internal revenue recovery templates and workflows to ensure legal sufficiency.

Compliance Response Solutions

  • Act as the primary legal liaison for the Compliance Response Solutions team.
  • Provide the legal layer over the Compliance Response Solutions team’s review, triage, and fulfillment of Emergency Disclosure Requests, exigent requests, subpoenas, search warrants, court orders, and other notices.
  • Serve as the legal escalation point for out-of-compliance, ambiguous, or novel requests — advising on scope, validity, and jurisdictional reach, and on preservation, disclosure, and rejection decisions — in coordination with client legal, trust and safety, and law enforcement response teams.
  • Help maintain playbooks, escalation paths, and recordkeeping that satisfy multiple regulatory regimes and support client Service Level Agreements.

Compliance with IP House Standards & Applicable Law

  • Ensure that investigative and enforcement activity is conducted in compliance with IP House’s policies, procedures, and protocols, and with applicable law in every jurisdiction in which the company operates.
  • Advise on the lawfulness of investigative methods and enforcement tactics — evidence collection and handling, online investigation and monitoring techniques, test purchases, engagement with third parties and subjects, investigator licensing, and personal data handling — and set clear boundaries where the law or company protocol requires them.
  • Working with the COO and the Counsel, Contracts & Compliance, execute upon and enforce IP House’s legal compliance requirements and standards; monitor adherence across global enforcement and investigations operations, investigate deviations, and confirm remediation.
  • Deliver and administer legal compliance education for investigations, enforcement, and compliance response personnel, and maintain the guidance, templates, and knowledge resources the business relies on.

What You’ll Bring:

Required

  • Qualified lawyer in good standing, admitted or otherwise entitled to practice in the United Kingdom, an EU member state, or a United States jurisdiction — for example a solicitor or barrister of England & Wales, Scotland, or Northern Ireland; an equivalently qualified lawyer in an EU member state; or a JD holder admitted to a US state bar.
  • 3–5 years of post-qualification experience (PQE) gained in private practice, an in-house legal department, a government agency, or a prosecuting authority.
  • Based in, and holding the unrestricted right to work in, the United Kingdom or the United States.
  • Proven ability to carry a high volume of concurrent matters against firm deadlines with extreme attention to detail, working comfortably across time zones and jurisdictions.
  • Ability to translate complex legal concepts into clear, plain-language guidance that non-lawyer operations, investigations, and client-facing teams can act on, with excellent written and verbal communication in English.
  • Self-starter with sound judgment: sets priorities, drives matters to closure, makes defensible recommendations on incomplete information, and exercises discretion with confidential, privileged, and sensitive material relating to active investigations and legal matters.

Highly Desired

Substantive background in IP enforcement — anti-counterfeiting, anti-piracy, trademark and copyright enforcement, marketplace and digital takedowns, illicit trade, or brand protection.

Desired

  • Prior work with law enforcement agencies and prosecutors, including developing or supporting criminal referrals, or prior service in a prosecutorial, police, customs, agency, or task-force role.
  • Experience in a fast-paced, multi-jurisdictional services environment; additional language capability beyond English is welcome.

Location, Travel & Working Pattern

This globally scoped role is open to candidates based anywhere in the United Kingdom or the United States, working fully remotely or on a hybrid basis from one of our UK or US offices. Some flexibility in working hours is expected to accommodate colleagues, clients, and agencies in other time zones, together with availability for urgent escalations outside standard business hours. Occasional domestic or international travel may be required.

Why IP House:

Global Mission — help the world’s top brands protect their most valuable assets across every major market.

Genuinely Global Work — a single remit spanning US, UK, EU, and wider international enforcement, rather than one country’s docket.

Real Scope, Early — own enforceability calls and escalation decisions that move matters, with direct access to the COO and the executive team.

Senior Mentorship — learn directly from a COO who is a qualified lawyer with 25+ years of law firm and in-house experience, alongside seasoned law enforcement professionals and online and field investigators.

High Growth — join a fast-scaling organization with a strong reputation for results, and room to grow with it.

Compensation

Salary Range: US: $110k -140k USD (depending on experience and qualifications), plus bonus;

UK: £70k-90k GBP (depending on experience and qualifications), plus bonus;

Classification: Full-time, permanent (exempt where applicable)

Base salary is benchmarked to the market in which the successful candidate is based and reflects their experience, qualifications, and location. Base salary and bonus are supplemented by a comprehensive local benefits package.

Equal Opportunity

IP House seeks excellence through diversity in its staff. We prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are happy to discuss reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process.

The Professional Services Engineer is responsible for the engineering and technical disciplines of ongoing projects and will establish inspection criteria for the proper implementation of all the elements of a project.

ABOUT FIT SOLUTIONS

FIT Solutions is an innovative national IT Services firm, and we are growing every day. We are focused on creating a culture of elite raving fans for our employees that solves business problems for our clients. We are on a mission to impact the lives touched by technology. We teach and promote individuals to set and achieve their personal, professional, and financial goals through the work we do together. Measuring results against best-in-class businesses, we are focused on hitting targets. We are a humble and adaptable group of people who continue to train, and role play daily in pursuit of our goals. We are a great fit for team members that are aligned and thrive in a fast-paced, results driven environment.

PRIMARY OBJECTIVES

  • Define project requirements, scopes, and deliverables.
  • Design, develop, and implement IT infrastructure, systems, and software solutions based on project requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex IT issues that arise during the project lifecycle.
  • Ensure compliance with security policies, regulatory requirements, and best practices.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including system architecture diagrams, configuration guides, and user manuals.

SECONDARY OBJECTIVES

  • Collaborates with project staff to create a strategic action plan and cost estimates of materials, time, labor, and other resources required to complete the project.
  • Facilitates and contributes to the development of project plans and designs.
  • Recommends and/or analyzes materials, equipment, and practices used in the project.
  • Assesses the competence, capabilities, resources, and financial status of vendors.
  • Oversees the progress of the development project.
  • Compares the actual cost of a development project to estimates.
  • Collaborates with the design group to change plans if problems arise.
  • Collaborates with other engineers to share problems and solutions.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

COMPETENCIES

  • Self-starter and able to work independently.
  • Must have excellent high-level engineering skills.
  • Customer oriented, solid business acumen and excellent communication skills.
  • Proven track record of performance against goals year over year.

  • Ability to effectively communicate both orally and in writing, with all levels of internal and external professionals, especially professionals with non-technical understanding.
  • Adaptability in various business cultures and environments.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Excellent verbal and written communication
  • Excellent budgeting and cost containment skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong supervisory and leadership skills.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.

BENEFITS

  • Retirement plan (401K)

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Rewards
jobs.excerpt: Who we areMoniepoint Inc.  is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why Spain

Some of our most mission-critical team members are based in Spain, having joined us from companies like Wise and Glovo. Moniepoint is one of the largest and fastest-growing digital banks in Africa, and this is an opportunity to work on genuinely impactful problems: disrupting financial services at scale in emerging markets, and building systems and products that process hundreds of billions of dollars in transaction volume annually for tens of millions of people.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Rewards to join us in Spain.

About The Role

Rewards is one of the most strategically important platforms at Moniepoint, and it is being built into a dedicated charter with its own engineering and product leadership. The platform sits at the centre of our retention strategy across a user base of approximately 23 million people.

Today the platform does one thing: cashback. It works, but it has barely scratched the surface of what rewards can be, and the cashback product itself is not yet built to the depth it deserves. The ambition is to evolve it into a full rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform — and to do that across the full 360 degrees of our network. That means rewards for our business customers, rewards for our consumer customers, and rewards for the sales agents who drive our distribution. Very few companies get to design this from close to a blank page at this scale.

The Head of Engineering owns that platform end to end. You will inherit a team of nine engineers, including an Engineering Manager, and build the organisation out from there — the current expectation is a minimum of three product units and upwards of 25 people, though the eventual shape is genuinely yours to define. Your first objective is to get the best possible performance out of the cashback product we already have. From there, you will work with Growth, Sales and Marketing to determine what we build for acquisition and retention, and roll it out across every customer we serve.

This is a consumer-facing product engineering role, and that is the most important thing to understand about it. Rewards is won or lost on experimentation, personalisation, and the quality of the experience in a customer's hands. We are looking for a leader who has built and shipped direct-to-consumer products at scale, who is fluent in experimentation and A/B testing, and who has real depth in front-end and mobile engineering — not a purely backend platform leader.

Moniepoint runs a Domain CTO model. We view our Heads of Engineering as the CTO of their domain: you own the technical roadmap, the architecture, the delivery, and the organisation beneath you. You will have full autonomy over engineering strategy, architecture, hiring, operating cadence and roadmap trade-offs.

You will report functionally to our Group CTO, with a dual reporting line into the Product leader for Rewards. That second line is a delivery relationship rather than a seniority one — engineering and product are peers here, and you will build the team to full capacity together. Your responsibilities as Head of Engineering, Rewards includes:

  • Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Rewards Platform end to end.
  • Improving the performance, reliability and depth of the existing cashback product as an immediate first priority.
  • Evolving cashback into a broader rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform serving business customers, consumer customers and sales agents.
  • Building the engineering organisation from its current base - structuring product units, hiring engineers and Engineering Managers, and leading through those managers as the team scales.
  • Establishing a strong experimentation culture: A/B testing, cohort analysis, and measurement that lets the team learn quickly what actually changes customer behaviour.
  • Working closely with Growth, Sales and Marketing to translate acquisition and retention objectives into product and engineering initiatives.
  • Owning the customer-facing experience of rewards across mobile and web, including how quickly and reliably customers receive what they have earned.
  • Define architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and own the engineering health of the domain — incidents, production defects, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and developer experience.
  • Build the platform to serve customers across multiple geographies as Moniepoint expands.
  • Partner with Product to define the rewards-specific metrics and OKRs that do not yet exist, and hold the team to them.

Who You Are

  • Direct-to-consumer product engineering at scale. You have built and shipped products used directly by large consumer audiences, and you understand what moves engagement and retention. This is the defining requirement of the role.
  • Genuine front-end and mobile depth. You have led or personally built consumer-facing mobile and web experiences. A backend-only background, however strong, is not what this role needs.
  • Experimentation and growth engineering. Hands-on experience running A/B tests, feature flagging, and measurement frameworks, and using the results to drive product decisions rather than to justify them.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, not a single team.
  • Hands-on technical leadership. You are still close to the code. We expect a meaningful proportion of hands-on engineering time and technical credibility with the engineers you lead.
  • 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
  • Comfort with our backend environment — Java and Spring Boot — and the ability to lead backend engineers credibly, even if it is not where your own depth sits.
  • Experience building and scaling an engineering organisation from a small base, including hiring and developing Engineering Managers.
  • Strong collaboration with commercial stakeholders — growth, marketing and sales — and the ability to translate business objectives into engineering work.
  • Rewards, loyalty, gamification, personalisation or growth platform experience is a strong advantage but is not required.
  • Fintech or payments experience is an advantage, not a requirement.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like In The Role

  • The existing cashback product performing measurably better — faster, more reliable, and more compelling to customers.
  • A credible rewards platform roadmap defined with Product, and the first initiatives beyond cashback shipped.
  • A functioning experimentation practice, where the team ships, measures and learns on a short cycle.
  • An engineering organisation built out from its current base, with a strong bench of Engineering Managers and senior engineers.
  • Rewards established as a measurable contributor to retention and engagement across the customer base.
  • Clear architecture standards and engineering processes in place across the product units.

Why Join Us

  • A rare blank page. The platform exists, but almost everything it could become is still ahead of it, and you will define what that is.
  • Direct influence on retention across a base of roughly 23 million users, at one of the largest and fastest-growing digital banks in Africa.
  • Full autonomy as the CTO of your domain, with the backing to build the organisation you think the problem needs.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.

What To Expect In The Hiring Process

  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

•Leads the clear and accurate completion of medical writing deliverables, ensuring scientific information is presented clearly and accurately. Manages medical writing activities associated with individual studies, coordinating medical writing activities within and across departments with minimal supervision. Leads the resolution of comments from the client.

•Completes a variety of documents that may include clinical study protocols and clinical study protocol amendments; clinical study reports; patient narratives; annual reports; investigator brochures; informed consents; annual reports; plain language summaries; periodic safety update reports, clinical development plans; IND submissions; integrated summary reports; NDA and eCTD submissions; journal manuscripts; and abstracts, posters, and presentations for scientific meetings.

•Adheres to established regulatory standards, including, but not limited to, ICH E3 guidelines, as well as company standard operating procedures, client standards, and company and/or client approved-templates, authorship requirements, and style and formatting guides, when completing medical writing projects, on time and on budget.

You will turn in-game content, screenshots, 3D assets, and ideas into high-quality promotional visuals, while also actively helping define what our marketing materials should look like, how they should be structured, and where the visual quality can be pushed further.

You will work across a wide range of marketing and promotional materials - from key visuals, store assets and campaign graphics to screenshots, banners, logos, splash screens, social media content, and other 2D artwork.

This is not a purely execution-focused role. We are looking for someone who can identify opportunities independently, challenge existing approaches when needed, propose stronger visual solutions, and help establish and evolve a consistent marketing art direction for Space Engineers.

You should combine a strong artistic eye with speed, versatility, and practical execution - someone who can explore multiple directions quickly, make sound visual decisions, work with feedback, understand the purpose behind each asset, and consistently deliver polished results.

We expect you to act as a proactive visual partner to the team, not simply wait for briefs - spotting what is missing, proposing what should be created, and helping raise the overall standard of our marketing presentation.

While our studio is based in Prague, we offer the flexibility to work remotely (CET +/- 2 hour)

If you enjoy challenging work, seek autonomy, thrive on impact and responsibility, and want to work in a friendly environment with an inspiring international team, then come and join us!

  • 6+ years of professional experience as a Marketing Artist, 2D Artist, or Graphic Designer in the video game industry, specifically working on PC and/or console games.

  • Strong photo manipulation, image editing and post-processing skills
  • Ability to take existing in-game content and transform it into compelling promotional visuals
  • Ability to adapt to an established visual identity while also proposing new creative directions
  • Ability to receive feedback, make changes quickly and iterate efficiently
  • Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to balance quality and delivery speed
  • Proactive, self-driven mindset and ability to work independently
  • Fluent English, spoken and written

  • Experience with motion graphics or video editing
  • Familiarity with Figma

jobs.description:
Afresh, the AI platform for grocery, began by tackling the most complex problem in the industry: fresh, and has evolved into the core AI platform for grocers.

By leveraging proprietary AI designed for high-volatility environments, we empower partners like Albertsons, Meijer, and Wakefern to drive smarter decisions across their entire enterprise.

Following record-breaking 70% revenue growth in 2025, we have scaled to 6 enterprise-grade solutions, with solutions live in over 10% of the U.S. grocery market. Our platform now orchestrates billions of decisions from the store floor to the distribution center and prevented over 200 million pounds of food waste last year alone.

If you're looking for a role where your work directly translates into massive scale and social good, and you want to be part of the team that defines how the world eats, there is no better time to join us.

About the role:

At Afresh, we’re building data products to define the future of retail grocery analytics. The nerve center of those products is our analytics platform, and as a Staff Data Engineer on the Data Science and Analytics team, you’ll be the technical leader of that platform.

Our growing suite of data products range from standardized reports to AI-driven insight engines and agentic analytics tools. They let our customers understand what’s happening in their stores and empower them to reduce food waste. All of these products require a reliable platform of well-modeled data, clearly-defined metrics, and extensive metadata and context.

This platform is also used by teams across the company to ensure customer success and improve our core products. The Data Science and Analytics team collaborates closely with every team in the company, helping them build products and make decisions with data. You will regularly interact with data engineers, product engineers, product managers, data scientists, and operations specialists.

What You'll Do:

As a Staff Data Engineer on the Data Science team, you will own the development of our analytics platform. You’ll evolve our data models, solidify our pipelines, and establish data governance patterns to serve our internal- and customer-facing analytics needs. Some of your responsibilities will include:

  • Improving, extending, and optimizing our data analytics architecture to provide reliable and accessible data for our suite of data products;
  • Collaborating with stakeholders across the company to understand their data needs, and then build extensible dimensional models, semantic layer metrics, and agentic context and tooling that will allow for consistent and reliable AI-assisted insights;
  • Evolving our existing data quality and data governance processes; and
  • Mentoring and up-skilling other engineers

This is a high-impact role with ownership of highly visible projects and a lot of room to grow in your scope.

Skills and experience:

  • 6+ years of experience as a data engineer, analytics engineer, or similar role.
  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a proven ability to facilitate cross-team and cross-functional collaboration and information-sharing.
  • A drive to learn new skills and dive into unfamiliar domains.
  • A strong sense of ownership and agency — taking initiative to spot problems and solve them without waiting to be told.
  • Fluency in advanced concepts in SQL, dimensional modeling, and data warehouse design; experience with Cloud Data Warehouse platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, etc.)
  • Proficiency in dbt
  • Experience with orchestration tools (Airflow/Astronomer, Dagster, or similar)
  • Experience with modern semantic layers: LookML, Cube.dev, Databricks Metrics Views, dbt MetricFlow, etc.).
  • Experience designing and optimizing pipelines of billion+ row datasets
  • Experience working with and extending AI models to produce high quality code and reliable analytics. Experience working on
Why You’ll Love Working at Afresh
At Afresh, our mission to eliminate food waste starts with investing in our people. We provide a comprehensive support system designed to help you do your best work while maintaining a healthy, balanced life.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, with the majority of premiums covered by Afresh. We also provide dedicated mental health support and counseling services.
  • Invested in Your Future: Competitive base salary, meaningful equity (U.S. employees), and a 401(k) program with a generous company match.
  • Flexible & Modern Workspace: Whether you work from home or a local office, we support your setup with a home office stipend and "Coworking Wallets" for flexible workspace access.
  • Growth-Obsessed Culture: We believe in continuous learning. Every employee receives an annual professional development budget to master new skills and grow their career at Afresh.
  • Holistic Monthly Stipends: Beyond your paycheck, we provide monthly stipends for "Betterment" (wellness/lifestyle) and telecommunications to ensure you have what you need to thrive.
  • Time to Recharge: Flexible paid time off to take the time you need to recharge.
*Full-time U.S. employees are eligible for these benefits

About Afresh

Founded in 2017, Afresh is using AI to tackle the #1 solution to curb climate change: reducing food waste. By building AI specifically for the intricacies of grocery—from the fresh perimeter to the center store—we help grocers minimize waste and maximize sales.

Afresh sits at an incredible intersection of positive social impact, rocket ship financial growth, and cutting-edge technology. Our best-in-class AI research has been published in top journals, including ICML, and our investors include Al Gore’s Just Climate, former Whole Foods Market CEO Walter Robb, and Eric Schmidt's Innovation Endeavors.

Grocery is the past, present, and future of our food system – the waste we create today will impact our planet for years to come. Join us as we continue to build a vibrant, diverse, and inclusive team that embodies our company’s values of proactivity, kindness, candor, and humility.

Afresh provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areMoniepoint Inc.  is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why South Africa

South Africa has one of the strongest engineering communities anywhere in the world, and we are deliberately growing our technology organisation in the country. We already have several team members based here. The work is fully remote, and the mission we are working on is a good deal closer to home than it is for our teams elsewhere.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Sales & Marketing Tools, to join us in South Africa.

About The Role

Sales and Marketing Tools owns MonieCRM, the operating system for Moniepoint's 50,000-strong sales network. This is not a CRM we bought — it is a workforce operations platform built entirely in-house for a multi-level field sales hierarchy, and it is how those teams run their day to day: the portfolio of businesses they manage, their own teams, their goals and performance, the physical and digital resources they need in the field, and an emerging AI-assisted support layer. Sixteen capabilities span onboarding and network management, pipeline and portfolio, performance and goals, compensation, and sales experience and support.

A significant part of the domain moves money. The platform owns wallets, commission calculation and attribution, cashout and welfare funds for a network that drives the overwhelming majority of company revenue — which makes financial correctness, not just availability, a core engineering requirement of the role.

Alongside that, the domain covers partner management, a rewards and retention platform serving tens of millions of users, and our marketing technology stack, including the engineering and customisation of Braze, the platform we use for customer engagement. The mandate is modernisation and reliability: re-architecting systems that have grown very quickly and making them dependable at a scale of more than 20 million users. This is a platform engineering and legacy modernisation challenge first and foremost, and prior CRM or SalesTech experience is genuinely not required.

Who You Are

  • You have 10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
  • 5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not years spent overseeing teams who write it.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
  • You have proven platform engineering experience at scale — building and running complex distributed systems, not feature delivery alone.
  • You have navigated legacy migrations and re-architecture projects at 20M+ user scale.
  • You have strong backend engineering skills in high-throughput, data-intensive distributed systems, and are proficient in Java and Spring Boot.
  • You have managed and developed large engineering teams of 20 or more members.
  • Experience building systems where financial correctness matters — commissions, payouts, wallets, ledgers or equivalent — is a strong advantage.
  • A fintech or payments background is strongly preferred. CRM or SalesTech domain experience is nice to have and explicitly not required.
  • Exposure to customer engagement or marketing automation platforms such as Braze is a plus, but not a requirement.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like In The Role

  • Legacy systems modernised and re-architected, with measurable improvement in reliability and performance.
  • Commissions and earnings calculated, attributed and paid accurately and on time, at network scale.
  • A sales and marketing platform that scales with a rapidly growing agent network across multiple markets.
  • Commercial teams able to move faster because the tooling beneath them is dependable.
  • A high-performing engineering team with a strong bench of managers and senior engineers.

Why Join Us

  • Own the platform behind the commercial engine of one of Africa's largest digital banks — the system 50,000 people rely on to do their jobs and to get paid.
  • A genuine platform modernisation mandate with the autonomy and backing to see it through.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company impacting millions of businesses and individuals across Africa and beyond.

What To Expect In The Hiring Process

  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Due to continued growth, we are seeking an experienced Project or Senior Hydraulic Modeller to join our established Flood Risk and Water Environment team, delivering high-profile projects across the UK for public and private sector clients.

You'll join a friendly, collaborative group of Hydraulic Modellers, Hydrologists, Hydrogeologists, Water Resources Planners and Water Quality Scientists.

We would be keen to hire into an office with an existing modelling/hydrology team presence, including Manchester, London and Edinburgh. However, we would be happy to consider other office locations or remote working for the right candidate.

You'll work across a diverse portfolio of projects for both public and private sector clients, including developers, Local Flood Authorities, water companies and environmental regulators. As a member of the team, you'll combine technical excellence with project delivery, helping to shape and grow our hydraulic modelling capability and be able the shape the work you do.

The role includes:

  • Delivering hydraulic modelling and flood risk projects from inception through to completion.
  • Building, interrogating and self-checking 1D and 2D hydraulic models using industry-standard software including Flood Modeller and TUFLOW.
  • Preparing technical reports, model documentation and supporting calculations to a high technical standard ready for senior review and submission.
  • Producing and contributing to Flood Risk Assessments (FRAs) for developments and infrastructure projects primarily across England and Scotland.
  • Undertaking site visits and catchment walkovers to inform hydraulic model development, flood risk assessments and project delivery.
  • Liaising with clients, regulators (e.g., EA, SEPA, NRW, OPW), Local Lead Flood Authorities and other key stakeholders throughout project delivery.
  • Working collaboratively with hydrologists, water environment specialists and other technical disciplines to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Supporting project planning, programme management and technical quality assurance processes.
  • Contributing to the continued development and growth of our flood risk and hydraulic modelling capability.

You'll collaborate with colleagues across Environmental and Earth Sciences, Planning, ESIA and Engineering, along with Global Advisory, on complex and impactful projects that improve resilience, manage flood risk and support sustainable development.

Rewards & Benefits

SLR's 'One Team' culture is at the heart of our business, providing a collaborative and supportive environment where people can develop and grow. Through a structured career framework, regular performance reviews, and support towards chartership, professional qualifications and licences, we offer excellent opportunities for long-term career progression.

  • Competitive salary with discretionary bonus
  • Company pension
  • Private medical insurance
  • Life, income and travel insurance
  • Salary sacrifice car lease and cycle-to-work schemes
  • Flexible, hybrid and agile working
  • 25 days' annual leave plus flexible public holidays
  • Buy or sell leave options
  • Core working hours
  • Cross-border remote working and sabbatical opportunities
  • Enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption leave pay
  • Workplace Nursery benefit
  • Volunteering and Community Giving
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Specialist support for mental health, stress and menopause, supporting our people both professionally and personally

About You

As a Hydraulic Modeller with proven consultancy or similar commercially based experience, we would envisage that:

  • You hold a degree in Civil Engineering, Engineering Sciences, Geography, Environmental Science or a related discipline.
  • You are Chartered or working towards Chartership through ICE, CIWEM or a similar professional institution.
  • You will be able to demonstrate:
    • Strong experience developing, operating and interrogating hydraulic models using Flood Modeller and TUFLOW.
    • Experience delivering hydraulic modelling studies to support flood risk management, planning and infrastructure projects.
    • Experience preparing and self-checking technically robust reports (model build reports, model verification reports) and hydraulic modelling outputs and flood mapping deliverables.
    • Experience preparing Flood Risk Assessments (FRAs) in England and Scotland.
    • Good knowledge of relevant flood risk policy, guidance and regulatory requirements, including those of the Environment Agency, SEPA and Local Lead Flood Authorities.
    • Experience undertaking site visits and using site observations to inform hydraulic model development and flood risk assessments.
    • Experience liaising with clients, regulators and stakeholders throughout project delivery.
    • Experience using GIS software such as ArcGIS Pro or QGIS.
    • The ability to work independently with appropriate supervision managing their own time / resource and working to project scope / budgets / programme and to effectively manage competing priorities across multiple projects.
    • Experience working on both public and private sector projects.
    • Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.
    • The ability to contribute positively within multidisciplinary project teams.

Desirable

  • Experience using additional hydraulic modelling software such as InfoWorks ICM and HEC-RAS.
  • Experience deriving hydrological inputs for hydraulic models using methodologies and software including FEH, ReFH2, WINFAP and LowFlows.
  • Coding experience using Python, R or similar package and an interest is building tools to maximise efficiencies.
  • Experience supporting catchment-scale flood risk studies and strategic flood risk assessments.
  • Understanding of river restoration, natural flood management, drainage or wider water environment projects.

Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why United Kingdom

The UK is home to our headquarters where more than 70 team members are based. Our London office is located at Sea Containers, just by London Bridge - this is also where a significant number of our most senior leaders sit, which makes it a natural base for a Head of Engineering.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Supply Chain to join us in the UK.

About The Role

POS Hardware and Device Platforms owns the software behind the physical side of Moniepoint's business: the systems that track, move, maintain and account for millions of POS terminals in the field. That covers inventory and warehouse management, logistics and distribution, repair and maintenance workflows, and the operational tooling the business runs on day to day. It is a backend and distributed systems challenge at real scale - making operational data about millions of physical devices visible, trustworthy and consistent across every market we operate in. It is not a hardware engineering role.

The Head of Engineering, POS Supply Chain, oversees that software estate and is vital as Moniepoint expands internationally and scales device operations globally. The position involves leading the technical strategy for the domain and managing a large engineering organisation in a remote, distributed environment. As Head of Engineering, Supply Chain, your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the technical strategy and architecture for inventory and logistics tools and repair management software.
  • Leading an engineering organisation of approximately 25 engineers, including managers, QA, SRE and Data Engineering.
  • Driving platformisation of inventory and supply chain systems so operational data is visible, trustworthy and consistent across millions of terminals.
  • Bridging the gap between operational practice and software systems by building operationally disciplined solutions.
  • Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics across squads to ensure reliability and data integrity.
  • Collaborating with business and operational stakeholders to translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
  • Hiring, mentoring and developing engineering managers and senior engineers to support team growth up to 30+ members.

Who You Are

  • 10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
  • 5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not years spent overseeing teams who write it.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers - leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
  • Deep hands-on experience in supply chain, inventory, warehouse or logistics software at scale.
  • Fintech or regulated-industry experience, with an understanding of the operational stakes of device management in a payments environment.
  • Strong backend engineering skills for data-intensive, distributed, operational systems.
  • Proven system design ability at large scale, managing hundreds of thousands of devices or more.
  • Experience managing and developing large engineering teams of 20 or more members.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, translating complex technical concepts for non-technical leaders.
  • A product-minded approach to solving operational problems with engineering solutions.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like In The Role

  • Scalable inventory and logistics systems delivered, supporting millions of devices across multiple countries.
  • A high-performing, motivated engineering team aligned with company growth.
  • Operational data visibility and trust established across multiple global markets.
  • Robust architecture standards enabling reliability and data integrity.
  • Effective collaboration with business and operational teams to meet rapid expansion needs.

What we can offer you

  • Lead engineering for one of Africa's largest POS networks and directly influence our global expansion.
  • Work in a fast-paced, innovative environment at the intersection of fintech and hardware operations.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company impacting millions of businesses and individuals across Africa and beyond.

What to expect in the hiring process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders, 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project/system you built in the past. 30 minutes will be focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management, collaboration skills with product/business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

Job Title

Project Designer

Job Description Summary

Project Designer will develop documents, drawings, and diagrams to meet the requirements and goals of the client.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Formulate preliminary space plans and sketches that integrate the client’s needs
  • Confirm preliminary space plans and design concepts are safe, functional, aesthetically appropriate, and meet all public health, safety and welfare requirements.
  • Compile selection of colors, materials and finishes to appropriately convey the concept and to meet socio-psychological, functional, maintenance, lifecycle performance, environmental, and safety requirements.
  • Compile selection and specification of furniture, fixtures, equipment and millwork, including layout drawings and detailed product description; and provision of contract documentation to facilitate pricing, procurement and installation of furniture
  • Coordinate and collaborate with other allied design professionals who may be retained to provide consulting services
  • Confirm construction documents for non-structural and/or non-seismic construction are signed and sealed by the responsible interior designer, as applicable to jurisdictional requirements for filing with code enforcement officials
  • Assist with administration of contract documents, bids and negotiations as the client’s agent
  • Provide reporting on the implementation of projects while in progress and upon completion

Requirements

  • Bachelor Degree in Architecture or Interior Design from a FIDER accredited institution (NCIDQ a plus)
  • Minimum of 1+ years of relevant work experience
  • Or any similar combination of education and experience
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD or REVIT and Architectural Desktop
  • Ability to read and review construction documents; provide technical sign-off/approval
  • Understanding of the technical aspects of design/construction such as low voltage, construction materials, design concepts/budgets, constructability, electrical and HVAC systems
  • Versed in the five phases of an interior/architectural project
  • Excellent internal and external customer service skills
  • Effective interpersonal skills and problem solving ability
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to multi-task and manage several projects simultaneously
  • The qualified candidate will be detail oriented, able to handle multiple projects simultaneously, extremely professional, and customer service oriented

Physical Requirements

  • Involves work of a general office nature; typically includes extended periods of sitting and/or operation of a computer for up to 8 hours a day
  • May involve periods of standing, such as operating at a copier/fax/scanner
  • Regularly required to talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to write and type
  • Ability to speak clearly so others can understand you
  • Ability to read and understand information and ideas presented orally and in writing
  • Ability to communicate information and ideas in writing and orally so others will understand
  • Regularly required to utilize vision abilities, allowing reading of printed material, graphics, and computer displays

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreSolera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.

The Role

As Sr. Manager, Professional Services Consulting (Dealer Variable & Fixed Operations), you will lead a team of customer-facing consultants focused on measuring, managing, and improving outcomes inside automotive dealerships. Your team will help dealers implement and maximize the value of Solera SaaS products and consulting programs by turning data into a clear operating rhythm — diagnose performance, take action, and solidify improvements month after month.

This role blends people leadership, operational execution, and KPI ownership, with a primary focus on managing consultants responsible for helping dealers drive Variable and Fixed Operationsperformance —including lead-to-appointment effectiveness, appointment-to-sale conversion, pipeline discipline, SaaS product adoption, inventory acquisition workflows, executive visibility into sales performance— including performance management frameworks for General Managers, General Sales Managers, Used Car Managers, New Car Managers, Group Operations Directors, c-suite executives, etc.; accountability systems that improve customer pay and warranty workflows, service lane effectiveness, technician productivity—including performance management frameworks for Service Advisors, BDC, and Parts teams, etc.

What You’ll Do

Lead and Develop a High-Performing Consulting Team

Manage, coach, and develop a team of consultants to consistently deliver high-quality engagements that improve dealership sales performance and outcomes.

Set clear expectations, reinforce “One Team” behaviors, and model the professionalism and ethical conduct required for customer-facing leadership.

Support hiring, onboarding, training, and ongoing enablement to build deep product expertise and strong consulting fundamentals across the team.

Measure and Manage Variable and Fixed Ops Outcomes

  • Establish a KPI-based execution cadence with each dealership that ties consulting activity to measurable improvements in variable and fixed operations performance.
  • Drive accountability systems that improve areas such as: lead handling performance, appointment performance, manager enforcement playbooks, etc.Lead the team in strengthening pipeline discipline, coaching opportunities, and cross-department handoffs tied to KPIs that influence sales conversion and profitability.
  • Lead the team in strengthening operational discipline across the service lifecycle—from appointment scheduling and write-up quality to repair order (RO) management, parts availability, and post-service customer follow-up—ensuring consistency and profitability at every stage.

Examples of outcome areas (Variable Ops): sales funnel response quality, lead response speed, appointment set/show rates, close-rate trends, pipeline management, sales/BDC accountability, marketing spend ROI, trade and purchase appraisal close rates, etc.

Examples of outcome areas (Fixed Ops):service appointment utilization, show rates, effective labor rate (ELR), hours per RO, technician efficiency and proficiency, service drive conversion rates, parts gross profit, inventory obsolescence, and customer retention/service revisit rates.

Operational Excellence and Delivery Quality

Own team planning and execution—ensuring the right coverage, prioritization, and consistency across consulting engagements (virtual and onsite as needed).

Build and refine playbooks, templates, and standard methodologies that help consultants deliver repeatable performance improvements while still tailoring to dealership needs.

Monitor and improve delivery quality through structured inspections (e.g., ride-alongs, call reviews, engagement retrospectives) and targeted coaching plans.

Data-Driven Leadership and KPI Ownership

Track and manage team KPIs and dealership performance outcomes; use trends to coach improvements and provide leadership updates.

Ensure consultants translate dealership and platform data into practical actions—such as CRM data integrity and user behavior audits, executive dashboards, custom KPI tracking, and trend analysis frameworks.

Drive consulting programs that influence sales and inventory economics, including inventory aging strategy, appraisal win-rate accountability, and trade acquisition workflows (as applicable to dealership objectives and Solera solutions).

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Stakeholder Influence

Partner closely with Sales, Account Management / Customer Success, Support, and Product teams to align priorities, share learnings from the field, and improve the customer journey.

Lead execution of departmental and company initiatives, ensuring timely delivery and clear communication across stakeholders.

What You’ll Bring

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Industry Expertise: Strong automotive dealership experience highly preferred; ability to “speak the dealership language” and coach others to care about what our dealers care about.
  • Performance Consulting Leadership: Experience leading teams that drive adoption, ROI, and measurable outcomes through structured KPI management and execution cadence.
  • People Leadership: Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, and develop high-performing teams through clear expectations and consistent accountability.
  • Communication + Presence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills; confident presenting, training, and influencing across frontline to executive stakeholders.
  • Execution + Ownership: Strong personal accountability, operational rigor, and proactive problem-solving.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; comfort using data to tell a story and drive action.
  • Travel: Willingness to travel up to 80% to support onsite delivery, key account outcomes, and team development in the field.

Why Join Us?

At Solera, you’ll lead a team that directly impacts dealership success by turning software and data into measurable Variable Ops performance improvements. You’ll help standardize an operating rhythm that converts insight into consistent execution—driving sales outcomes while shaping how Professional Services scales across Vehicle Solutions.

It is impossible to list every requirement for, or responsibility of, any position. Similarly, we cannot identify all the skills a position may require since job responsibilities and the Company’s needs may change over time. Therefore, this job description is not comprehensive or exhaustive. The Company reserves the right to adjust, add to or eliminate any aspect of the above description, and to require employees to undertake additional or different responsibilities when necessary to meet business needs.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
The Solera group is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.
