jobs.excerpt: Privacy is the virtual card platform giving consumers and small businesses complete control over their online payments.
jobs.description:
Privacy is the virtual card platform giving consumers and small businesses complete control over their online payments.

Our virtual cards protect 250,000+ users across the U.S., processing over $3 billion in transactions with bank-level security and encryption. From merchant-locked cards that can't be used anywhere else if stolen, to spending limits that block unauthorized charges, to one-click pausing that stops subscriptions instantly, Privacy puts financial control back in users' hands.

We're building a future where every online payment is secure by default, free from data breaches, unauthorized charges, and hidden fees. We're proud to have been named one of Forbes' "Top 100 Most Customer-Centric Companies" and featured in The Wall Street Journal, TechCrunch, and Wirecutter.

Privacy is the product that started it all. What began as Privacy.com grew into Lithic, now a Series C company backed by world-class investors including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. Our dedicated team of 35 sits at the heart of Lithic's 170+ person organization, spanning 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.

What we do:

  • Generate virtual payment cards backed by debit cards or bank accounts
  • Enable users to set spending limits, pause cards, and close them instantly
  • Protect users from merchant data breaches and unauthorized recurring charges
  • Help users organize their spending with merchant-locked cards

Why it matters:
With data breaches becoming increasingly common and subscription traps everywhere, consumers need better tools to protect their financial information. Privacy.com processes millions of transactions and serves hundreds of thousands of users who trust us to keep their payment information secure.

The technical challenge:
Building a secure, reliable payments product requires solving complex problems at the intersection of fintech infrastructure, security, user experience, and regulatory compliance. You'll work with real-time transaction processing, fraud detection, payment network integrations, and systems that need to be both fast and bulletproof.

The opportunity:
We're experiencing significant growth from strong product-market fit. We are at the transition point which require scaling the stack, team, and processes.

You'll have the chance to work on features that directly impact over 100K users, with a modern tech stack and a team that values ownership, collaboration, and moving fast.

Job Description

Privacy.com is hiring a Staff Software Engineer to scale to meet the needs of our growth. You will split your time between being hands on coding as well as demonstrate technical leadership in evolving the platform for scale.

You'll become an expert in card payments, solve distributed systems problems at scale, make architectural and product decisions, and mentor other engineers. The team is distributed across the US and Europe. The stack is predominantly NodeJS, DocumentDB and hosted in AWS.

Job responsibilities:

  • Ensure high reliability and correctness for Privacy.com card processing
  • Understand the challenges of the current system and propose step function changes to future architecture
  • Drive large multi-month initiatives and roadmap.
  • Ensure that the team is delivering reliable, secure, and scalable code.
  • Lead efforts to improve system and processes within the team and across engineering
  • Help drive strategic planning in collaboration with engineering, product, and cross-functional leaders.
  • Make tradeoffs between long term investment and delivering on immediate product value
  • Participate in team on-call rotations

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience shipping code in a fast paced production environment
  • Experience building event-based and advanced distributed systems.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability for your work
  • Technical lead for a small team
  • Driven large multi-month migration/re-architecturing projects
  • Experience mentoring and coaching other engineers on distributed systems patterns and best practices
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (designers, PMs, operations)
  • Excellent communication skills and enthusiasm for learning

The annual US salary range for this role is $200,000 - $220,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.

This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

jobs.title: Lead QA Engineer, Automation
jobs.excerpt: Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic.
jobs.description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

Best Life

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

Growth Mindset

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

One Team

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

As our Lead QA Engineer (SDET / QA Automation), you'll build comprehensive, scalable technology and software designed to manage and grow fitness businesses of all sizes. We are looking for a visionary quality engineering technical leader to design and implement advanced test automation frameworks, embed artificial intelligence throughout the QA lifecycle, drive UI visual regression testing capabilities, champion DORA metrics adoption, and elevate overall release confidence — all while growing and mentoring the QA practice through standards, tooling, and cross-functional partnership.

You will lead through test strategy, automation architecture, AI-augmented quality practices, quality standards, mentoring, and cross-functional partnership — not through people management.

If that vision excites you, this is where it gets built. You will spend your days on the test automation and quality systems that protect fitness experiences for millions, in an environment where AI agents are part of how you think, build, test, and review. Every framework you build, every AI-assisted insight you surface, and every standard you set helps prove that AI-native engineering is not a side project here — it is how we build.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

QA Technical Leadership & Agile Execution

  • Be an active participant and lead day-to-day Scrum activities of the team as needed, including planning, daily standups, reviews, and retrospectives.

  • Review and evaluate business requirements in the form of user stories; lead work breakdown and estimation of tasks based on requirements; provide alternative solutions and negotiate with Product Management.

  • Own small to mid-sized engineering/QA projects or product areas.

  • Lead technical projects; define and oversee test automation and quality delivery for your squad.

  • Review teammates' work to ensure quality and adherence to system architecture and best practices; identify where new designs will require architectural or testability changes.

  • Troubleshoot and reproduce customer-found issues in a timely manner.

  • May supervise the work of QA vendor resources.

AI-Augmented QA & Generative AI

  • Lead the integration of AI and Generative AI (Gen AI) tooling into the QA process, including AI-assisted test generation, intelligent defect triage, and predictive quality analysis.

  • Apply hands-on experience with Gen AI platforms (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to accelerate test case creation, test data generation, and documentation.

  • Evaluate, adopt, and champion AI-native QA tools and agentic IDE development practices, including agent-based QA tooling and intelligent test maintenance.

  • Partner with engineering and product teams to identify opportunities where AI can reduce manual testing burden and increase test coverage and precision.

  • Stay current on advancements in AI/ML as applied to software quality and advocate for their adoption within the QA practice.

UI Visual Comparison & Regression Testing

  • Architect and implement UI visual regression testing capabilities to detect unintended visual changes across application releases and platform updates.

  • Select, configure, and maintain visual comparison tooling (e.g., Applitools, Percy, Playwright visual comparisons, or similar) integrated into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Define baseline management standards, screenshot comparison strategies, and tolerance thresholds for visual diffs across browsers and device viewports.

  • Partner with frontend engineers and designers to ensure visual test coverage aligns with design system standards and accessibility requirements.

  • Drive adoption of visual testing as a first-class quality gate within the software delivery lifecycle.

DORA Metrics & Engineering Excellence

  • Lead the organization's DORA metrics (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate, and Mean Time to Restore) measurement and improvement initiative across engineering teams.

  • Establish baseline DORA metric reporting, define targets, and build dashboards that provide actionable visibility to engineering leadership and squads.

  • Identify quality and process bottlenecks that negatively impact DORA metrics and drive initiatives to address them through automation, improved test coverage, and CI/CD optimization.

  • Champion a continuous improvement culture by connecting QA practices directly to DORA outcomes, including reducing change failure rates through shift-left testing and faster test feedback loops.

  • Collaborate with DevOps, SRE, and platform engineering teams to align QA practices with reliability and deployment velocity goals.

Automation Architecture & Frameworks

  • Develop high-quality code; contribute to development standards by setting new patterns and best practices for test automation.

  • Write architecture and design documentation for test frameworks and quality plans as needed.

  • Design reusable test components utilizing standard frameworks; experiment with new technologies that can enhance our QA tech stack.

  • Support and contribute to build, deployment, and monitoring processes with an emphasis on security, performance, and scalability.

  • May participate in build vs. buy analysis and complex decision making for test tooling.

  • Conduct regular, self-guided study to stay current on new and existing technologies; evaluate emerging technologies and practices for suitability at ABC Fitness

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software QA Engineering, or related field (or equivalent industry experience).

  • 6+ years of software development or SDET experience with a strong automation focus.

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript for test automation, tooling, and framework development.

  • Strong understanding of unit testing, integration testing, load testing, and related tools.

  • Significant experience in full life cycle system development including design, building, testing, deployment, upgrade, and support.

  • Experience with application lifecycle management tools (e.g., JIRA) and concepts for version control, work item tracking, and continuous integration.

  • Hands-on experience with REST API testing.

  • Strong knowledge of BDD/TDD methodologies.

  • Familiarity with SQL databases and queries for test data validation.

  • Experience with exploratory testing.

  • Experience with CI/CD tools.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or equivalent) applied to software engineering or QA workflows.

  • Experience implementing UI visual regression and comparison testing frameworks (e.g., Applitools, Percy, Playwright, or similar) in a CI/CD pipeline.

  • Proven experience leading or contributing to DORA metrics measurement and improvement efforts across engineering teams.

  • Experience in applying different techniques, tools, and approaches based on context.

  • Experience testing technically complex systems including microservice-oriented and distributed systems with fail-safe requirements.

  • Experience with shift-left testing (early in development) and shift-right testing (in production environments) techniques.

  • Strong problem-solving skills; critical thinking and attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills for collaborating with developers, product managers, and stakeholders.

  • Knowledgeable about performance tuning, scalability, security, reliability, and other non-functional testing concepts.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience building or evaluating AI-powered test generation and intelligent test maintenance pipelines.

  • Familiarity with LLM prompt engineering as applied to QA automation and test case design.

  • Experience with agentic-IDE development and testing practices.

  • Hands-on experience with security testing and performance testing.

  • Experience establishing or owning an engineering metrics program including DORA and other delivery health indicators.

  • Prior exposure to fitness/wellness products and multi-tenant SaaS products.

Compensation for this role will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, qualifications, skills, geographic location, and market considerations. The anticipated compensation range for this position is -

$95,000 - $100,000 CAD and $110,000 - $115,000 USD- annually. In addition to base compensation, eligible employees may be offered other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, commissions, equity, or other incentive programs, where applicable. Compensation and benefits may vary by location and are subject to applicable legal, business, and market requirements.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:

  • Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
  • Time Off – with our open PTO policy, we offer flexibility in how and when you take PTO!
  • Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
  • Parental & Pawternity Leave – we offer leave for when your family grows by two feet or four paws!
  • Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
  • Medical/Dental/Vision coverage
  • EAP – we get you help when you need it. Period.
  • Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
  • And more! – so many benefits we couldn’t even fit them all here!

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.


ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION: 

ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at abcfitness.com.


About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.excerpt: About ARKANCE US Company:At ARKANCE US, we empower design, engineering, construction, and manufacturing teams to work smarter, deliver stronger outcomes, and build a better world.
jobs.description:
About ARKANCE US Company:

At ARKANCE US, we empower design, engineering, construction, and manufacturing teams to work smarter, deliver stronger outcomes, and build a better world. As part of the global ARKANCE Group - a trusted partner with deep industry expertise, innovative technology solutions, and high-performing teams across 19 countries - we bring together technology, consulting, and services that help organizations transform how they design, build, and operate.

Our culture is built on our people and our values - guided by integrity, innovation, customer success, education, financial responsibility, and an employee-first mindset. We believe that when great people come together around a shared purpose and set of values, we create lasting value for our customers, our communities, and each other.

Job Description Summary

Position Overview:
The Business Analyst, Advisory Services is the entry point into ARKANCE's advisory practice and the analytical engine beneath its engagements. This role does the hands-on work that advisory engagements are built on: gathering and organizing information, scoring maturity assessments, capturing current-state detail, supporting the business case, and producing the clean, well-structured deliverables clients expect.
Working under the direction of consultants and the Senior Consultant, the Business Analyst spends the majority of their time on client project work. They sit in discovery interviews and capture what is said, turn raw inputs into structured findings, build the analysis behind the recommendations, and keep the engagement's evidence organized and traceable. It is a role designed to build advisory capability from the ground up, with a clear path to grow into a consultant as skills and client exposure develop.
The Business Analyst also supports the practice itself, contributing to the reusable templates, benchmarks, and assets that make each engagement faster and more consistent than the last.

Job Description

Essential Functions

Engagement Support & Analysis

  • Gather, organize, and structure information from client interviews, documents, and systems into clear, usable findings.
  • Support maturity assessments by scoring against the rubric, capturing evidence, and flagging where inputs conflict or are thin.
  • Build the analysis behind the recommendations, including gap analysis, opportunity sizing support, and benchmarking inputs.
  • Capture discovery interviews accurately, working against the deliverable tracks so one conversation feeds everything it should.
  • Support the business case with data gathering, modeling support, and the client's own numbers wherever available.

DeliverableProduction

  • Produce clean, well-structured, board-ready deliverables under the direction of consultants and the Senior Consultant.
  • Maintain the quality and consistency of engagement documentation, ensuring findings are evidenced and traceable.
  • Keep the engagement's evidence base organized so any deliverable track can be assembled without rework.
  • Help ensure deliverables meet the practice's standard and definition of done before review.

Practice Contribution & Growth

  • Contribute to reusable templates, benchmarks, and assets that make future engagements faster and more consistent.
  • Build advisory capability through exposure to live engagements, developing toward a consultant role over time.
  • Stay curious about the AECO industry, the client's world, and the digital transformation landscape.
  • Take on increasing ownership of workstreams as skills and client exposure develop.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Perform all other duties as assigned.
  • Duties and responsibilities are subject to change based on business needs.

Decision-Making & Autonomy

Operates under the direction of consultants and the Senior Consultant, with growing autonomy over individual workstreams as capability develops. Owns the accuracy, structure, and quality of the analytical and documentation work assigned, and escalates questions of interpretation, client interaction, and engagement direction to the consultant or Senior Consultant leading the engagement.

Qualifications

  • Early-career experience in analysis, consulting support, professional services, or a related analytical role, or a strong academic record with relevant internship experience.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn raw and unstructured information into clear, structured findings.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a high standard for the quality and consistency of written deliverables.
  • Comfort with data: gathering it, organizing it, and supporting quantitative analysis and modeling.
  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to produce clear, professional documentation.
  • Curiosity and a desire to grow into an advisory consultant role, with a willingness to learn on live client engagements.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, Data, or a related field.
  • Interest in or familiarity with the AECO industry and the Autodesk ecosystem a plus.

jobs.excerpt: At Significance, we believe the best results come from investing in great people.
jobs.description:
At Significance, we believe the best results come from investing in great people. As a woman-owned consulting firm supporting federal civilian and Department of Defense customers, we bring together talented professionals who are passionate about solving complex challenges and making a meaningful impact.

We're proud of the culture we've built - one rooted in trust, collaboration, respect, and genuine relationships. Our people are empowered to share ideas, grow their careers, and deliver exceptional results while supporting missions that matter. It's a culture we're proud of, and one that has earned us recognition as a Washington Business Journal Best Place to Work for seven consecutive years.

Significance Inc. is seeking an Oracle EBS - System/Solution Architect to support an upcoming federal program (contingent upon award). This role will be remote.
This role will be supporting The Department of Labor (DOL) requires Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Services for its centralized financial management system, New Core Financial Management System (NCFMS). In addition to core O&M functions, the team will support the continuous improvement of financial management services, ensuring system performance, security, and availability meet the evolving needs of DOL stakeholders. All services will be performed in compliance with the applicable standards, policies, and performance expectations.
As a mission-critical enterprise system, NCFMS underpins DOL’s finance and accounting operations, including invoicing and payments, budget execution, fixed asset management, general ledger oversight, and project accounting. NCFMS was upgraded from Oracle EBS v12.1.3 to Oracle EBS v12.2.9 in February 2022. Subsequent notable upgrades include Replacing DUNS with Unique Entity Identifier (UEI); Single Sign On Implementation (PIV card integration with Azure); Implementation of REST APIs for custom developed screens; Deployment of Oracle Analytics Server for all NCFMS reporting needs; Upgrade to Tungsten Markview 2025.3 (10.6),Capture 11.2; Webservice updates to ETA OJC UMS; Integration with GrantSolutions managed by HHS; Implementation of NCFMS Data-in-Transit and Data-at-Rest Encryption; Integration of NCFMS and Treasury G-Invoicing, including migration to U.S. Treasury’s G-Invoicing system for Interagency Agreements (IAA) (7600A) and Orders (7600B); Modernization of the custom developed User Interface framework from legacy Enterprise Java Beans/OC4J code to ReactJS framework.

Required Skills:

    System Solution Architect designs, maintains, and modernizes enterprise financial systems for the Department of Labor's (DOL) New Core Financial Management System (NCFMS).
    Key Responsibilities
    • System Design: Create scalable architecture blueprints for NCFMS modules, ensuring alignment with federal financial standards.
    • Integration & Modernization: Oversee the integration of financial databases, cloud services, and web applications.
    • Compliance & Security: Enforce federal security controls like NIST 800-53 and FedRAMP compliance requirements.
    • Stakeholder Collaboration: Coordinate with agency program managers, financial analysts, and cybersecurity teams to resolve system bottlenecks.

    Core Requirements

    • Experience: 12+ years in enterprise-scale solution architecture, specifically with federal financial or large-scale Oracle ERP systems.
    • Education: Minimum bachelor’s degree from an accredited university, preferably majoring in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related engineering field.
    • Technical Stack: Deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), database administration (Oracle/SQL), and modern API microservices.

Desired Skills:

    DOL is committed to achieving a cutting-edge, adaptable, and sustainable financial management system that meets the evolving needs of the department and its stakeholders that conform to all government regulatory and cybersecurity requirements.

    • Experience with DOL NCFMS or large federal Oracle eBS implementation
    • Agile delivery experience
    • AI focused
    • Team and Client-focused
    • Good communications skills

Additional Information:

    Must be able to obtain a Public Trust Level 5 or 6 clearance

    The work to be performed under this contract action is not anticipated at a gov’t owned/controlled site, however all performance must occur within the continental United States. Accessing Department of Labor (DOL) Government Furnished Equipment (GFE) or logging into the DOL network from outside of the United States is strictly prohibited without proper authorization.

    May be requested to attend meetings in-person at DOL HQ in Washington, DC.

At Significance, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package and is determined within a range. Our pay ranges are based on the local cost of labor benchmarks for each specific role, level, and geographic location.
We carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including but not limited to experience; job-related skill sets; relevant education or training; and other business and organizational needs. The salary range listed is for the level at which this job has been scoped. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for a comprehensive and generous benefits package.

jobs.description:

In this role, you’ll report to the Data Science Manager and work closely with our Data Scientists and Product developers. You’ll architect storage and compute, harden training/inference pipelines, and make our ML code, data workflows, and services reliable, reproducible, observable, and cost-efficient. You’ll also set best practices and help scale our platform as Nift grows.

Our Mission:

Nift’s mission is to reshape how people discover and try new brands by introducing them to new products and services through thoughtful "thank-you" gifts. Our customer-first approach ensures businesses acquire new customers efficiently while making customers feel valued and rewarded. We are a data-driven, cash-flow-positive company that has experienced 731% growth over the last three years. Now, we’re scaling to become one of the largest sources for new customer acquisition worldwide.

Backed by Spark Capital & Foundry who also invested in Slack, Snap, SeatGeek, Fitbit, Warby Parker, Wayfair and Twitter, we are poised for exponential growth and ready to demonstrate impact on a global scale. Read more about our growth here.

What you will do:

  • Feature & model lifecycle: Centralize feature generation (e.g., feature store patterns), manage model registry/metadata, and streamline deployment workflows
  • Observability & quality: Implement monitoring for data quality, drift, model performance/latency, and pipeline health with clear alerting and dashboards

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work with DS/Analytics/Engineers to turn prototypes into production systems, provide mentorship and technical guidance
  • Roadmap & standards: Drive the technical vision for ML platform capabilities and establish architectural patterns that become team standards

What you need:

  • Experience: 5+ years in ML Ops, including ownership of ML infrastructure for large-scale systems

  • Cloud & containers: Production experience on AWS, DataBricks, Docker + Kubernetes (EKS/ECS or equivalent)
  • IaC: Terraform or CloudFormation for managed, reviewable environments
  • ML tooling: MLflow/SageMaker (or similar) with a track record of production ML pipelines
  • Monitoring/observability: ML monitoring (quality, drift, performance) and pipeline alerting
  • Collaboration: Excellent communication, comfortable working with data scientists, analysts, and engineers in a fast-paced startup
  • PySpark/Glue/Dask/Kafka: Experience with large-scale batch/stream processing
  • Analytics platforms: Experience integrating 3rd party data
  • Model serving patterns: Familiarity with real-time endpoints, batch scoring, and feature stores
  • Governance & security: Exposure to model governance/compliance and secure ML operations
  • Be mission-oriented: Proactive and self-driven with a strong sense of initiative; takes ownership, goes beyond expectations, and does what's needed to get the job done

What you get:

  • Competitive compensation, flexible remote work
  • Unlimited Responsible PTO
  • Great opportunity to join a growing, cash-flow-positive company while having a direct impact on Nift's revenue, growth, scale, and future success

jobs.description:
Paid Search Media Analyst (REMOTE) – C-4 Analytics

C-4 Analytics is a fast-growing, private, full-service digital marketing company that excels at helping automotive dealerships increase sales, increase market share, and lower cost per acquisition. C-4 Analytics is committed to developing innovative solutions for every dealer in every market, and to providing the highest levels of accountability and customer service. We are currently hiring for a Paid Search Media Analyst - REMOTE as we look to expand our team and support our growing roster of local and national clients.

If you are unable to complete this application due to a disability, contact this employer to ask for accommodation or an alternative application process.

Who We're Looking For: Paid Search Media Analyst - REMOTE

We’re looking for a data-driven, high-impact Paid Search Media Analyst to take full ownership of campaign success across our client portfolio. This isn’t a hands-off strategy role; it’s a hands-on, conversion-focused, revenue-driving position where you will build, optimize, and scale high-performing paid media campaigns. You’ll be responsible for the full lifecycle of paid search (PPC) execution, from conducting deep keyword research and crafting compelling ad copy to optimizing conversion paths on client websites.

You’ll blend analytical rigor with creative execution, developing visually captivating ads and high-converting copy across search engines, display networks, and paid social platforms like Facebook and Instagram. Reporting to digital marketing leadership, you’ll navigate complex paid media landscapes to consistently hit client KPIs, translate performance metrics into strategic growth, and refine campaign mechanics. If you are a relentless marketer who thrives on connecting search intent to measurable business results, you’ll do well here.

A day in the life of a Paid Search Media Analyst - REMOTE

  • Campaign Strategy & Execution: Build, launch, and optimize paid media campaigns across search, display, and social platforms, adjusting campaign pacing and budget allocation to maximize return on ad spend (ROAS).
  • Performance Analysis & Optimization: Continuously monitor campaign performance, conduct competitive benchmarking, and analyze data to uncover insights, identify trends, and refine targeting strategies.
  • Client Engagement & Strategic Leadership: Act as the subject matter expert by leading client presentations, reporting on key metrics, proposing new growth opportunities, and aligning strategies with overall business goals.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with creative and analytics teams to integrate digital marketing efforts, build compelling ad assets, and streamline campaign execution.
  • Industry Leadership & Partner Relations: Stay ahead of paid search advancements, build relationships with major ad platform partners, and participate in internal knowledge sharing to introduce cutting-edge tactics.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Education & Professional Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience) paired with 2+ years in digital media planning, automotive marketing, account management, or client services.
  • Certifications, Platforms & Data Expertise: Active certifications in Google Analytics and Google Ads (including Advanced Display and Video), with hands-on proficiency in major ad-serving platforms (Google, Bing, Facebook, The Trade Desk) and third-party data providers like Oracle.
  • Campaign & Program Management: Proven capability to plan, implement, manage, measure, and report on programmatic digital media campaigns across diverse channels, with a willingness to continually adapt and learn new channels.
  • Analytical & Technical Proficiency: Strong capability to research industry statistics, analyze performance data, execute detailed record-keeping, and leverage Google Workspace and internal management systems to evaluate and design programs.
  • Communication, Copywriting & Collaboration: Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal skills with the ability to write creative marketing copy across multiple formats, draft professional correspondence, collaborate cross-functionally, and handle sensitive information discretely.
  • Organization & Proactive Execution: Self-starter with organizational agility, strong time management, and a proactive mindset to delegate tasks, navigate shifting priorities, and flag workflow issues early in a fast-paced environment.

Compensation:

We offer a competitive compensation commensurate with experience and qualifications. The salary range for this position is $60,000.00 - $75,000.00. The final salary will be determined based on factors such as skills, knowledge, and demonstrated expertise.

Please note that the stated salary range is flexible and negotiable based on individual qualifications and fit for the role. We encourage candidates to discuss their salary expectations during the interview process.

Flexibility:

The Paid Search Media Analyst may benefit from the flexibility to work in a way that suits them best. We offer the following working options:

  • Office-Based: Our modern and well-equipped office space provides a collaborative environment where you can work closely with your team, engage in face-to-face interactions, and foster a sense of community.
  • Remote: We understand that some individuals thrive in a remote working setup. As such, we support remote work arrangements, allowing you to work from the comfort of your own home or any location that enhances your productivity.
  • Hybrid: For those who prefer a balance between office and remote work, we offer a hybrid model. This allows you to divide your time between working in the office and remotely, providing the best of both worlds.

Working at C-4 Analytics

We provide our employees with a range of benefits, including career development programs, unlimited paid time off, and additional perks. All are welcome to visit our careers and culture page for more details.

More About C-4 Analytics

C-4 Analytics takes the guesswork out of advertising. We don’t over-promise: we over-deliver. We provide real value to our clients because we really value them as partners. We love Google and Facebook, but also love Instagram and Bing. We innovate, educate and instigate. We are forward-thinking, but we learn from the past. We are results-driven and our strategies drive results. We love the practical applications of psychology to marketing, but we aren’t above a good practical joke. We are team players, but we love to crush our competitors. We create an environment of respect and we respect the environment. We are the brains and the good looks. We are very humble. We are nerds, but cool, likable nerds. We are never gonna give you up. Never gonna let you down. We are all work and all play. jobs.description:
Du möchtest ein klar definiertes Produktprojekt übernehmen, komplexe Fachprozesse strukturieren und Anforderungen in konkrete Produktlösungen für eine eigens entwickelte ERP-Software übersetzen? Dann suchen wir Dich für ein freiberufliches Projektmandat als:

Freelance Product Manager (w/m/d) - Abrechnung & ERP - 3 bis 6 MonateDie Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin.

Das Projekt:

Für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Softwarelösung ginisuite suchen wir freiberufliche Unterstützung für ein zeitlich befristetes Produktprojekt. Der Projektstart ist zum 01.10.2026 vorgesehen. Die geplante Projektlaufzeit beträgt zunächst drei bis sechs Monate.

Die ginisuite ist unsere eigens entwickelte ERP-/PVS-Lösung für Arbeitsmedizin und Arbeitssicherheit. Im Fokus des Projekts steht die fachliche und produktseitige Weiterentwicklung ausgewählter Module in den Bereichen Vertragsmanagement, Abrechnung, Zeiterfassung und Buchhaltung.

Zu den Projektinhalten gehören die Analyse bestehender Fachprozesse, die Entwicklung geeigneter Lösungskonzepte sowie die Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in umsetzbare User Stories und Tickets. Darüber hinaus umfasst das Mandat die fachliche Begleitung ausgewählter Themen bis zur Qualitätssicherung, Veröffentlichung, Datenmigration und Einführung.

Die Zusammenarbeit erfolgt grundsätzlich remote innerhalb Deutschlands auf freiberuflicher Basis mit eigenverantwortlicher Zeiteinteilung und klar vereinbarten Projektergebnissen. Bei Bedarf können einzelne projektbezogene Termine innerhalb Deutschlands erforderlich sein, voraussichtlich etwa einmal pro Monat und nach vorheriger Abstimmung.

Dein Projektinhalte:

Fachliche Konzeption und Produktentwicklung

  • Analyse bestehender Prozesse und Systemlandschaften in den Bereichen Vertragsmanagement, Abrechnung, Zeiterfassung und Buchhaltung

  • Identifikation und Priorisierung fachlicher Optimierungspotenziale auf Grundlage der vereinbarten Projektziele

  • Entwicklung geeigneter Lösungsansätze und konkreter Empfehlungen für die Weiterentwicklung ausgewählter ginisuite-Module

  • Erstellung nachvollziehbarer Fachkonzepte, User Stories, Akzeptanzkriterien und Tickets als Grundlage für die technische Umsetzung

  • Übersetzung komplexer fachlicher Anforderungen in klare und umsetzbare Produktentscheidungen

  • Vorbereitung und Durchführung fachlicher Qualitätssicherungen

  • Projektbezogene Unterstützung bei Release-Vorbereitungen, Datenmigrationen und Rollouts

  • Dokumentation der erarbeiteten Konzepte, Entscheidungen und Projektergebnisse

  • Strukturierte Übergabe der vereinbarten Ergebnisse an die zuständigen Ansprechpartner:innen bei Arsipa

Projektbezogene Abstimmung

  • Selbstständige Planung und Umsetzung der eigenen Projektaktivitäten innerhalb des vereinbarten Zeitraums

  • Projektbezogene Abstimmung mit dem Lead Product Manager, dem CTO und weiteren relevanten Ansprechpartner:innen

  • Einbringung eigener methodischer Ansätze und fachlicher Empfehlungen

Dein Profil:

  • Nachweisbare Projekterfahrung in den Bereichen Rechnungswesen, ERP, Abrechnung oder vergleichbaren B2B-Softwarelösungen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit User Stories, Tickets, Akzeptanzkriterien und fachlichen Produktkonzepten

  • Technisches Verständnis in den Bereichen Datenmigration, Datenanalyse und Softwareentwicklung

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise

Hilfreich für das Projekt sind außerdem:

  • Erfahrung in SaaS-, Plattform- oder ERP-nahen Projekten

  • Kenntnisse cloudbasierter Plattformen, APIs, Integrationen oder verteilter Systeme

  • Verständnis für Softwarearchitektur, Microservices oder containerbasierte Systemlandschaften

  • Projekterfahrung in Multi-Entity-, Private-Equity-, Buy-&-Build- oder vergleichbaren Wachstumsumfeldern

  • Interim-, Freelancer- oder Beratungserfahrung im Product-Management-Umfeld

Rahmenbedingungen des Projekts:

  • Projektstart zum 01.10.2026

  • Geplante Projektlaufzeit von zunächst drei bis sechs Monaten

  • Voraussichtlicher Projektumfang von ca. 30 bis 40 Stunden pro Woche

  • Remote innerhalb Deutschlands mit eigenverantwortlicher Zeiteinteilung

  • Einzelne projektbezogene Termine innerhalb Deutschlands können bei Bedarf und nach vorheriger Abstimmung erforderlich sein

Was Dich bei diesem Projekt erwartet:

jobs.excerpt: The AI/ML Data Scientist will work closely with mission stakeholders, business process analysts, data analysts, AI/ML engineers, automation engineers, enterprise architects, data engineers, cybersecurity personnel, and program leadership to identify high-value use cases, assess data readiness, develop predictive and prescriptive analytics solutions, support rapid MVP pilots, and transition successful solutions toward enterprise-scale implementation.
jobs.description:
The AI/ML Data Scientist will work closely with mission stakeholders, business process analysts, data analysts, AI/ML engineers, automation engineers, enterprise architects, data engineers, cybersecurity personnel, and program leadership to identify high-value use cases, assess data readiness, develop predictive and prescriptive analytics solutions, support rapid MVP pilots, and transition successful solutions toward enterprise-scale implementation.

The role will support TRT’s “Start Small, Move Fast” approach by rapidly evaluating whether AI is appropriate for a mission problem, developing and testing prototypes, measuring performance and mission value, and helping mature successful solutions for operational use.

Primary Responsibilities

AI/ML Solution Development

  • Design, develop, test, and evaluate AI/ML solutions supporting Coast Guard mission and business operations.

  • Build predictive, prescriptive, classification, anomaly detection, NLP, generative AI, and other advanced analytical solutions.

  • Develop, train, tune, and validate machine learning models that improve operational decision-making, workforce productivity, and mission effectiveness.

  • Support AI-enabled MVPs, technical demonstrations, automation pilots, and rapid experimentation efforts.

  • Evaluate commercial, Government, and open-source AI/ML models and tools for mission applicability.

Data Science and Analytics

  • Conduct exploratory data analysis, statistical modeling, data mining, and advanced analytics using structured and unstructured data.

  • Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and operational insights to support Coast Guard leadership decisions.

  • Establish model baselines, performance metrics, acceptance criteria, and test methodologies.

  • Assess model accuracy, reliability, false-positive/false-negative rates, bias, limitations, and operational suitability.

  • Develop dashboards, visualizations, analytical products, and performance measures supporting enterprise transformation initiatives.

  • Establish repeatable data science methodologies, analytical standards, and best practices.

Data Readiness, Engineering, and Integration

  • Conduct data readiness assessments covering availability, ownership, quality, completeness, lineage, authoritative sources, and accessibility.

  • Clean, normalize, transform, and prepare structured and unstructured datasets for AI/ML analysis.

  • Diagnose data-quality issues and recommend corrective actions.

  • Support development and optimization of data pipelines, ETL processes, and reusable analytical data models.

  • Support integration of data from multiple Coast Guard systems, repositories, and enterprise data platforms.

  • Collaborate with data engineers and AI/ML engineers to transition successful prototypes into scalable production environments.

Automation and Digital Transformation

  • Support automation opportunity assessments, feasibility analyses, and pilot evaluations.

  • Collaborate with automation engineers to integrate AI/ML capabilities into workflow automation, ServiceNow, Power Platform, Appian, Salesforce, and other approved enterprise platforms.

  • Participate in business process reengineering efforts and identify opportunities to reduce manual effort through AI, automation, and advanced analytics.

  • Support intelligent document processing, classification, entity extraction, summarization, forms digitization, workflow generation, and AI-assisted process automation.

Mission Modeling and Decision Support

  • Support mission modeling and simulation initiatives that evaluate mission execution, staffing models, operational impacts, and technology alternatives.

  • Develop analytical models supporting scenario planning, operational experimentation, forecasting, and trade-space analysis.

  • Translate analytical outputs into actionable recommendations for Coast Guard leadership.

  • Support data-driven decision advantage by connecting operational requirements, mission outcomes, and analytical results.

AI Governance, Security, and Responsible Use

  • Work with ISSO and ISSE personnel to address cybersecurity, data sensitivity, privacy, access control, and authorization requirements.

  • Support responsible AI practices, including human-in-the-loop decision processes, explainability, monitoring, and documentation of model limitations.

  • Document assumptions, methodologies, model risks, test results, and lessons learned.

  • Support ATO/cATO-related reviews and technical security documentation as required.

Agile Development and Collaboration

  • Participate in Agile planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, demonstrations, release activities, and user feedback sessions.

  • Work with product owners, developers, analysts, architects, engineers, and mission stakeholders to translate use cases into AI/ML solutions.

  • Support technical demonstrations and stakeholder briefings.

  • Help measure user adoption, operational impact, workload reduction, and “minutes back to mission.”

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Information Systems, Operations Research, or related technical field and 8 – 12 years of prior relevant experience or Masters with 6 – 10 years of prior relevant experience

  • 8+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, or related disciplines.

  • Experience developing, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models.

  • Strong proficiency with:

    • Python

    • SQL

    • Scikit-Learn

    • TensorFlow and/or PyTorch

    • Hugging Face or similar AI/ML frameworks

  • Experience with predictive analytics, statistical analysis, data mining, and model evaluation.

  • Experience working with large, complex, structured and unstructured datasets.

  • Experience developing Generative AI and Large Language Model solutions.

  • Experience with Retrieval Augmented Generation architectures.

  • Experience with cloud and data platforms such as AWS, Azure, GovCloud, Databricks, Apache Spark, Hadoop, Kafka, Airflow, or AWS Glue.

  • Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities with enterprise applications, workflow platforms, APIs, or data services.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to brief technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • U.S. Citizenship required.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DHS Public Trust.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting DHS, USCG, DoD, or other Federal agencies.

  • Experience with agentic AI, embeddings, vector databases, or AI orchestration frameworks.

  • Experience with ServiceNow, Power Platform, Appian, Salesforce, or similar enterprise workflow environments.

  • Experience with data governance, metadata management, lineage, and authoritative data-source identification.

  • Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, NIST 800-53, Zero Trust, ATO/cATO, and Federal AI governance requirements.

  • Experience supporting CUI, PII/SPII, or other sensitive Government data.

  • Experience supporting Agile, rapid prototyping, or 12-week MVP delivery environments.

Desired Certifications

  • AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer

  • AWS Certified Data Engineer or Solutions Architect

  • Microsoft Azure AI Engineer

  • Databricks Data Engineer / Machine Learning certification

  • Relevant AI/ML, cloud, or data science certification

Who We Are

Yellow Card is the largest licensed Stablecoin-based infrastructure provider operating across over 60 countries. From Stablecoin payment infrastructure to fiat settlement rails, wallet services, and custom local Stablecoin issuance, Yellow Card provides the complete infrastructure businesses need to manage Stablecoins, payments, and operations across 50 emerging markets.

Yellow Card operates with a substantial global team spanning 24 countries. This workforce is characterized by its linguistic diversity, with collective speaking of over 25 languages, underscoring the company's extensive international reach.

As our Payroll Specialist, you'll make sure people across our African markets get paid accurately and on time. Reporting to the Payroll Manager, you'll sit between HR and our external payroll providers, catching errors before they reach a payslip and keeping every cycle compliant with local legislation. It's detail-heavy work with a direct, immediate impact on every employee's paycheck.

What You'll Do

  • Support end-to-end payroll processing across multiple African countries, from input validation through to disbursement under the supervision of the Payroll Manager.
  • Review payroll inputs received from HR for completeness and accuracy, and chase down anything missing or inconsistent before cut-off.
  • Process approved payroll changes — new hires, terminations, salary adjustments, bonuses, commissions, leave, and benefits.
  • Coordinate submissions with external payroll providers, track processing timelines, and investigate discrepancies before approval.
  • Prepare payroll journals and reconcile payroll-related balance sheet accounts.
  • Generate recurring and ad hoc payroll reports, and support month-end and year-end reporting and audits.
  • Respond to employee payroll queries professionally
  • Stay current on payroll legislation, statutory deductions, and labour law across our African markets, and keep internal controls, policies, and process documentation compliant and audit-ready.

What You'll Bring (Must-Have)

  • Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience in payroll using payroll software.
  • Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills, with the discretion to handle confidential payroll data with integrity.

What Would Make You Stand Out (Nice-to-Have)

  • Experience supporting payroll across multiple African countries, in a high-growth, multi-entity organization.
  • Experience working with outsourced payroll providers, including preparing payroll journals and reconciliations.

  • Working knowledge of payroll tax, statutory deductions, and labour legislation across African jurisdictions.

  • Global Impact: You'll be part of a team shaping the future of global FinTech and stablecoin accessibility.

Our hiring process is virtual and is designed to be fast, fair, and respectful of your time.

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Chercheur(e) principal(e) et concepteur(trice) UX (Senior UX Researcher & Designer)

À propos d’IQVIA

IQVIA est un chef de file mondial dans les domaines de l’analytique avancée, des solutions technologiques et des services de recherche clinique destinés aux secteurs des sciences de la vie et des soins de santé. En combinant les données de santé, l’expertise sectorielle, les technologies de pointe et l’innovation alimentée par l’intelligence artificielle, IQVIA aide ses clients à accélérer le développement et la commercialisation de traitements médicaux, à améliorer les résultats pour les patients et à faire progresser les soins de santé à l’échelle mondiale.

Au sein du Centre des sciences des données appliquées (Applied Data Science Center) d’IQVIA, des équipes multidisciplinaires travaillent à l’intersection de l’intelligence artificielle, de la recherche clinique, de la science des données et du développement de produits afin de concevoir des solutions innovantes qui optimisent la prise de décision, l’efficacité opérationnelle et l’expérience des utilisateurs à travers l’écosystème de la santé.

Sommaire du poste

IQVIA est à la recherche d’un(e) chercheur(e) principal(e) et concepteur(trice) UX pour diriger les initiatives de recherche et de conception de l’expérience utilisateur de bout en bout pour des solutions technologiques cliniques alimentées par l’intelligence artificielle au sein du Centre des sciences des données appliquées.

Il s’agit d’un poste de niveau senior en contribution individuelle qui exige une personne capable de travailler de façon autonome, de naviguer efficacement dans des contextes ambigus et de collaborer avec des équipes multidisciplinaires en gestion de produits, ingénierie, science des données, recherche clinique et opérations commerciales. La personne retenue favorisera l’adoption de pratiques de conception centrées sur l’utilisateur et fondées sur des données probantes afin de créer des expériences intuitives, fiables et évolutives.

Le rôle contribuera également à l’évolution des Tiny Teams opérant selon le Modèle opérationnel agentique d’IQVIA (IQVIA Agentic Operating Model), une dérivation du processus Delta-Echo/FDE. La personne sélectionnée jouera un rôle clé dans la transformation de flux de travail cliniques, opérationnels et assistés par l’IA en expériences numériques significatives favorisant l’adoption, l’efficacité et une meilleure prise de décision.

Principales responsabilités

  • Diriger les activités de recherche UX et de conception tout au long du cycle de vie des produits, y compris la découverte, la définition des problèmes, la planification de la recherche, la synthèse des résultats, l’idéation, le prototypage, la validation, le déploiement et l’amélioration continue.
  • Planifier et mener des recherches qualitatives et quantitatives afin de comprendre les besoins, les comportements, les flux de travail, les irritants et les contextes décisionnels des utilisateurs.
  • Traduire les résultats de recherche en recommandations concrètes, orientations de conception et exigences produit alignées sur les objectifs d’affaires, techniques et utilisateurs.
  • Concevoir et évaluer des expériences utilisateur pour des produits alimentés par l’IA, notamment des applications basées sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), des systèmes agentiques, des flux d’automatisation intelligents et des solutions d’aide à la décision intégrant l’intervention humaine.
  • Créer et maintenir divers artéfacts UX, notamment des personas, cartes de parcours utilisateur, plans de services, modèles de flux de travail, maquettes, prototypes, rapports d’utilisabilité et spécifications de conception.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les gestionnaires de produits, les ingénieurs, les scientifiques de données, les cliniciens et les parties prenantes afin d’aligner les priorités et de favoriser une prise de décision centrée sur l’utilisateur.
  • Contribuer efficacement au sein de petites équipes agiles en participant aux cycles rapides d’expérimentation, d’itération, de mesure et d’apprentissage continu.
  • Fournir un leadership dans des environnements complexes et ambigus en facilitant les discussions, en apportant de la clarté et en influençant l’orientation des produits grâce à des données probantes et à la recherche.
  • Encadrer les professionnels UX et les partenaires interfonctionnels en promouvant les meilleures pratiques en matière de recherche, de conception, d’utilisabilité, de validation et de collaboration.
  • Défendre les principes d’accessibilité, d’utilisabilité, d’éthique en intelligence artificielle et de conception centrée sur l’humain tout au long du processus de développement des produits.

Qualifications requises

  • Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en interaction humain-machine (IHM), psychologie, design, sciences cognitives, facteurs humains ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Plus de 10 années d’expérience en recherche UX, conception de produits, évaluation de l’utilisabilité et conception centrée sur l’utilisateur pour des produits numériques complexes.
  • Expérience démontrée dans la direction autonome d’initiatives UX de bout en bout, de la découverte à l’implantation et à l’optimisation continue.
  • Solide expertise des méthodologies de recherche qualitatives et quantitatives, y compris les entrevues, l’enquête contextuelle, les tests d’utilisabilité, les sondages, l’analyse des flux de travail et la synthèse des résultats.
  • Excellente maîtrise de la conception d’interaction, de l’architecture de l’information, du maquettage, du prototypage, de la communication visuelle et des systèmes de conception.
  • Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes multidisciplinaires en gestion de produits, ingénierie logicielle, science des données, opérations cliniques et fonctions d’affaires.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, gestion des parties prenantes, animation d’ateliers et narration stratégique, avec une capacité démontrée à influencer les décisions grâce à des recommandations fondées sur des données probantes.
  • Maîtrise des outils modernes de recherche UX, de conception et de productivité alimentés par l’IA, notamment Figma, FigJam, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor et d’autres plateformes de synthèse assistée par IA.
  • Solides compétences analytiques et en résolution de problèmes ainsi qu’une véritable passion pour la compréhension des comportements utilisateurs et l’amélioration des résultats produits.

Qualifications souhaitées

  • Expérience dans la conception, la recherche ou l’évaluation de produits alimentés par l’IA, de flux de travail basés sur des LLM, de systèmes agentiques, de solutions d’automatisation intelligente ou d’outils d’aide à la décision.
  • Expérience dans les secteurs des soins de santé, des sciences de la vie, de la recherche clinique, des biotechnologies, de l’industrie pharmaceutique ou dans d’autres environnements hautement réglementés.
  • Connaissance des modèles opérationnels agentiques, des approches d’expérimentation rapide, de la pensée systémique et des pratiques de développement de produits assistés par l’IA.
  • Expérience de conception de logiciels d’entreprise, de plateformes analytiques, d’outils de visualisation de données ou d’applications de gestion des opérations.
  • Expérience dans l’encadrement de professionnels UX et dans le développement des capacités de recherche, de conception et de validation au sein des équipes interfonctionnelles.
  • Formation avancée, certification ou spécialisation en recherche UX, facteurs humains, conception de produits, développement de produits IA, conception de services ou domaine connexe.
  • Expérience dans des environnements dynamiques de type startup ou au sein de petites équipes multidisciplinaires.

Compétences clés

  • Leadership UX de bout en bout
  • Recherche et conception centrées sur l’utilisateur
  • Définition stratégique des problématiques
  • Jugement professionnel et prise de décision autonome
  • Gestion de l’ambiguïté
  • Réflexion produit fondée sur des données probantes
  • Maîtrise de l’intelligence artificielle et approche responsable de l’IA
  • Collaboration et influence interfonctionnelles
  • Communication et narration stratégique de niveau exécutif
  • Apprentissage continu et innovation
  • Mentorat et développement des équipes
  • Exécution orientée vers les résultats
  • Design thinking et pensée systémique
  • Adaptabilité dans des environnements en évolution rapide

Senior UX Researcher & Designer

About IQVIA

IQVIA is a leading global provider of advanced analytics, technology solutions, and clinical research services to the life sciences and healthcare industries. Through the integration of healthcare data, domain expertise, transformative technology, and AI-driven innovation, IQVIA helps customers accelerate the development and commercialization of medical treatments, improve patient outcomes, and drive healthcare forward.

Within IQVIA's Applied Data Science Center, multidisciplinary teams work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, clinical research, data science, and product development to create innovative solutions that improve decision-making, operational efficiency, and patient experiences across the healthcare ecosystem.

Role Summary

IQVIA is seeking a Senior UX Researcher & Designer to lead end-to-end user experience research and design initiatives for AI-enabled clinical technology solutions within the Applied Data Science Center.

This is a senior-level individual contributor role requiring a practitioner who can operate independently, navigate ambiguity, and collaborate effectively across product, engineering, data science, clinical, and business teams. The successful candidate will drive evidence-based, user-centered design practices that enable the delivery of intuitive, trusted, and scalable product experiences.

The role will contribute to emerging Tiny Teams operating within the IQVIA Agentic Operating Model, a derivation of the Delta-Echo/FDE process. The successful candidate will help translate complex clinical, operational, and AI-assisted workflows into meaningful digital experiences that improve user adoption, efficiency, and decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead UX research and design activities throughout the product lifecycle, including discovery, problem framing, research planning, synthesis, ideation, prototyping, validation, delivery, and continuous improvement.
  • Plan and conduct qualitative and quantitative research to understand user needs, behaviors, workflows, pain points, and decision-making contexts.
  • Translate research findings into actionable insights, product recommendations, design direction, and requirements that support business, technical, and user objectives.
  • Design and evaluate user experiences for AI-enabled products, including Large Language Model (LLM)-based applications, agentic systems, intelligent automation workflows, and human-in-the-loop decision-support solutions.
  • Create and maintain UX artifacts, including personas, journey maps, service blueprints, workflow models, wireframes, prototypes, usability reports, and design specifications.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, clinicians, and business stakeholders to align priorities and drive user-centered decision-making.
  • Operate effectively within small, agile Tiny Teams, contributing to rapid experimentation, iterative delivery, measurement, and continuous learning.
  • Provide leadership in ambiguous environments by facilitating discussions, driving clarity, and influencing product direction through data and research-driven insights.
  • Mentor UX professionals and cross-functional team members by promoting best practices in research, design thinking, usability, validation, and collaboration.
  • Advocate for accessibility, usability, ethical AI principles, and human-centered design across all stages of product development.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Psychology, Design, Cognitive Science, Human Factors, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in UX research, product design, usability evaluation, and user-centered design for complex digital products.
  • Proven ability to independently lead end-to-end UX initiatives from discovery through implementation and ongoing optimization.
  • Strong expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, including interviews, contextual inquiry, usability testing, surveys, workflow analysis, and research synthesis.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in interaction design, information architecture, wireframing, prototyping, visual communication, and design systems.
  • Experience partnering with multidisciplinary teams across product management, software engineering, data science, clinical operations, and business functions.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, and storytelling capabilities with the ability to influence decisions through evidence-based recommendations.
  • Proficiency with modern UX and AI-enabled productivity tools, including Figma, FigJam, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor, AI-assisted research synthesis platforms, and related technologies.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities with a passion for understanding user behavior and improving product outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing, researching, or evaluating AI-enabled products, LLM-powered workflows, agentic systems, intelligent automation solutions, or decision-support applications.
  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, clinical research, biotech, pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated environments.
  • Familiarity with agentic operating models, rapid experimentation frameworks, systems thinking, and AI-assisted product development practices.
  • Experience designing enterprise software, analytics platforms, data visualization products, or operational workflow applications.
  • Experience mentoring UX practitioners and helping cross-functional teams mature research, design, and validation capabilities.
  • Advanced training, certification, or specialization in UX research, human factors, product design, AI product development, service design, or related disciplines.
  • Experience working in fast-paced startup-like environments or small cross-functional teams.

Key Competencies

  • End-to-End UX Leadership
  • Human-Centered Research & Design
  • Strategic Problem Framing
  • Independent Judgment & Decision-Making
  • Ambiguity Management
  • Evidence-Based Product Thinking
  • AI Fluency & Responsible AI Mindset
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence
  • Executive-Level Communication & Storytelling
  • Continuous Learning & Innovation
  • Mentorship & Team Development
  • Outcome-Oriented Execution
  • Design Thinking & Systems Thinking
  • Adaptability in Rapidly Evolving Environments

We are looking for Senior Full-Stack Developer (React / Node.js) AI-First. You will own features end-to-end: React on the front-end, Node.js on the back-end, deployed with Docker and Kubernetes on AWS. Small team, hands-on senior role — you ship, you deploy, you support what you build.

The team develops AI-first. AI coding tools are the default way work gets done, not an experiment. On the front-end in particular, we expect you to generate most of the UI with AI — screens, components, state, tests — and spend your time on architecture, review and product quality, not on hand-typing JSX. We expect you to already work this way.

What you will do:

  • Build and ship full-stack features: React front-end + Node.js services and APIs
  • Build the front-end AI-first: turn designs, specs or screenshots into working React screens using AI coding agents; generate components, forms, tables, state logic and tests; then review, harden and integrate
  • Set up and maintain the AI workflow for front-end work: project rules/context files, component conventions, design-system references and prompt patterns so AI output matches the codebase
  • Containerize services with Docker, deploy and operate them on Kubernetes and AWS
  • Maintain CI/CD, monitoring and logging for what you own
  • Review code (human- and AI-written) and work directly with the product and management team

Requirements

Must have:

  • 5+ years of professional software development
  • True full-stack: 3+ years where you regularly delivered both the React front-end and the Node.js back-end of the same features yourself, in production. This role requires equal depth on both sides; profiles weighted to one side only will not fit.
  • Strong React: hooks, state management, performance, TypeScript
  • Strong Node.js: API design, async patterns, auth, testing
  • Hands-on production experience with Kubernetes, Docker and AWS
  • AI-first front-end development, proven in production:
  • Daily use of AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot or similar) to build React UI end-to-end
  • Can show real examples of screens or features built mostly with AI and explain what was kept, what was rewritten and why
  • Knows how to give the agent the right context (design files, component library, existing patterns, API contracts) to get code that fits the codebase, not generic output
  • Knows where AI breaks on front-end work — state bugs, accessibility, performance, inconsistent styling — and how to catch it
  • AI-first across the stack: uses AI for back-end code, tests, refactoring, debugging and reviews as well; can explain how prompts, context and agent workflows are structured, and how output is verified
  • Git, CI/CD, automated testing as a habit
  • Independent, communicates clearly, owns a feature from idea to production

Huge bonus:

  • React Native — shipped mobile apps to App Store / Google Play (OTOFusion has a React Native mobile app)
  • Experience with AI design-to-code tools (Figma-to-code, v0, Lovable, Bolt or similar) as part of a real delivery flow

jobs.excerpt: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) — AI-Driven Testing We operate a regulated digital asset exchange, broker, and custodian serving institutional and professional investors.
jobs.description:
Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) — AI-Driven Testing

We operate a regulated digital asset exchange, broker, and custodian serving institutional and professional investors. Our QA practice has been rebuilt around agentic AI: test planning, test code, failure triage, and even code review happens in partnership with AI coding agents, with the engineer as the human in the loop. We're looking for an SDET to join that team. Judgment, curiosity, and clear writing matter more to us than a perfect CV — if you're strong, we're flexible on the rest.

What the role actually is

You won't spend your days hand-writing boilerplate test scripts. You'll direct AI agents to do the mechanical work, and your job is everything the machine can't be trusted with deciding what's worth testing, checking that a generated test can genuinely fail, spotting when a "passing" suite is lying, and judging whether a red run is a product bug, an environment problem, or a broken test.

What you'll do

  • Author and maintain automated UI and API tests (Playwright, TypeScript) covering the trading, custody, and customer-portal surfaces of the platform.
  • Work with agentic AI tools daily — planning tests, generating code, triaging failures, reviewing PRs — and critically verify everything an agent produces before it ships.
  • Triage nightly regression and smoke runs: separate genuine product bugs from environment noise and test-side defects, and file clear, well-evidenced bug reports that a developer outside your domain can act on.
  • Keep the suite honest: link failing tests to known bugs, release them when fixes land, and never let a silent skip or a warning-instead-of-failure hide a real defect.
  • Run and maintain suites in CI (GitHub Actions) and help keep the pipelines green, fast, and trustworthy.
  • Keep test cases traceable in our test-case-management tooling.
  • Occasionally cross the test boundary and fix what you find: QA works in the same monorepo as the product, so small bug fixes and improvements to the application itself are yours to ship, through the same PR and review process the developers use.
  • Review teammates' test PRs — and respond to review findings on your own, including findings raised by AI reviewers — with evidence, not opinion.
  • Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, and product owners across a globally distributed team.

What we're looking for

  • Hands-on experience in software testing, QA automation, or software development — typically 3–6 years, though we're flexible for the right person.
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, or clear evidence you can pick a language up quickly.
  • A solid grasp of how web applications and HTTP APIs work: requests and responses, status codes, JSON, authentication.
  • Genuine interest in AI-assisted engineering. You should be comfortable making AI tools do real work — and sceptical enough to check the output. If you already use AI assistants for real tasks, we'll want to hear how.
  • Excellent written English. In an agentic workflow, writing is the work: prompts, bug reports, test plans, and review comments all succeed or fail on clarity.
  • Attention to detail and honest reporting. A failing test you explain truthfully is worth more to us than a green one you can't.
  • Strong candidates usually bring several of the following — you don't need them all:
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright (or Cypress/Selenium).
  • Experience building or maintaining a shared test framework — fixtures, page objects, helpers, CI wiring — rather than only writing specs inside one.
  • Exposure to financial services, trading, or capital markets — order lifecycles, settlement, custody concepts.
  • WebSockets / real-time data, SQL/PostgreSQL, CI pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar).
  • Familiarity with digital assets or blockchain.

Nice to have

  • Performance or load testing (k6, JMeter, or similar).

jobs.description:
Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting-edge technology, we’re enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?

We're looking for a Principal Business Analyst to shape how we manage credit for our existing customers, reporting to the Senior Director, Portfolio Management.

The impact you'll make:

For a lot of our customers, getting their Mission Lane credit card is the first step toward building their credit. But what comes next is where the real progress happens: earning a higher credit line or a better rate, or qualifying for a second card.

As a Principal Business Analyst, you design the strategy that decides who's ready for that next step, and what it should look like. The skill is building criteria that read how someone's managed what they already have, then account for how a change like that would ripple through the rest of their account. Get that right, and more people keep moving forward toward their goals.

Mission Lane is still young, but we've landed in an exciting, stable stretch of maturation. We're still building but we've already got a solid foundation. There's never been a better time to learn and grow right along with us.

As Principal Business Analyst, you will:

  • Lead efforts to decide who qualifies for more credit, a second card, or better terms, and how we make those calls
  • Use AI-driven tools to speed up and sharpen your analysis
  • Adjust our approach as customer behavior and the market change
  • Turn financial data into clear recommendations that grow the business while managing risk responsibly
  • Run small tests in market, then use what you learn to decide where we invest next
  • Work with product, data science, engineering, and capital markets to bring your ideas to life
  • Share your strategy and results directly with senior leadership

You'll thrive in this role if:

  • You understand the whole card business system, from acquisition to risk to engagement, and you can trace how a change in one part ripples through the rest.
  • You're curious enough to dig into the reasoning behind your own analysis, down to the assumptions it's built on, so you understand it at an elemental level
  • You take ownership of your work end to end, catching your own mistakes before they compound.
  • You can explain a business problem clearly enough that someone outside your immediate team could follow your thinking.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience in a highly analytical role
  • A bachelor's or master's degree in economics, finance, engineering, mathematics, or a similarly quantitative field, with a strong academic record
  • A track record of solving open-ended business problems: framing the question, forming a hypothesis, working through the data, and defending your recommendation to stakeholders
  • Comfort working in SQL, Python, or similar tools for data analysis
  • Ability to travel ~4-6+ times per year for high quality in-person collaboration

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience working with credit cards or other consumer lending products
  • Experience helping scale a business in a fast-moving startup environment
  • Strong SQL or Python skills
