Founded in December 2018, Mission Lane is a purpose-driven fintech company based in the U.S., with headquarters in Richmond, Virginia.

It all started with a realization: nearly fifty percent of the adult population in the U.S. doesn’t have access to a clear line of credit. Most traditional credit card companies either overlook or overcharge this group because they have less-than-perfect credit scores or no scores at all. We decided this just wouldn’t do.

In partnership with our sponsor banks, we offer credit cards under the Mission Lane brand name, with better, clearer terms, and a more refined customer experience than the alternatives available to people working hard to improve their credit. To date, over four million consumers have chosen Mission Lane, earning high customer ratings on Credit Karma for its market segment and industry leading Net Promoter scores.

Mission Lane has cumulatively raised over $600 million of equity from leading investors, including Invus Opportunities, QED Investors, LL Funds, funds affiliated with Oaktree Capital Management, and other leading investors.

Our commitment to a workplace built on respect and dignity is guided by our core value of Unity. We believe that everyone plays a vital role in our shared purpose, and we actively cultivate an environment where all individuals have the opportunity to do their best work. By fostering a culture of empathy and collaboration, we create a strong sense of belonging and support for every team member.

At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Make your actuarial expertise visible where it matters most.

Nationwide Financial is seeking an Actuary to help shape life insurance assumptions that inform pricing, product strategy, risk management, and business decisions. In this high-impact role, you’ll own meaningful experience-study work from data through recommendation, partner with actuarial leaders and the assumption council, and translate complex analysis into clear actions.

This is an opportunity to combine rigorous actuarial analysis with business influence, modern data practices, and practical innovation. You’ll join a collaborative team that values sound judgment, continuous improvement, and a healthy balance between established processes and new ideas.

What you’ll own

  • Lead life insurance experience studies and assumption-setting activities, including data analysis, controls, documentation, interpretation, and recommendations.

  • Take ownership of a major life assumption through the annual assumption unlock cycle, with support and oversight from experienced team members.

  • Present recommendations to the assumption council and communicate insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Investigate experience trends and help identify opportunities to support pricing, product decisions, risk analysis, and business growth.

  • Build, maintain, and improve actuarial models, testing tools, data processes, and reporting solutions.

  • Partner with actuarial, finance, product, technology, and other business teams to develop new processes and strengthen existing ones.

  • Help advance responsible AI use in actuarial work, including data transformation, documentation, control testing, quality checks, and analysis support.

What makes this opportunity different

  • Business impact: Your recommendations will help shape assumptions and decisions across Nationwide Financial’s life insurance business.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Safety AI builds the ML and computer vision systems behind Samsara's AI dash cameras which enable real-time driver alerts, risk signals, and coaching insights running on millions of edge devices and the cloud.

This role owns what happens after training: building the resilient, low-latency ML backend systems that turn static model artifacts into high-throughput, cloud-scale safety features.

You will partner closely with applied scientists, firmware and full-stack engineers, and product managers and you will build the ML APIs, data pipelines, and evaluation infrastructure that let Safety AI models run efficiently at fleet scale, closing the loop from initial integration through rollout monitoring and iteration to a trustworthy, customer-facing signal.

This is ML engineering where the stakes are real: rare, high-consequence events, millions of vehicles, and a product where "it works" means someone got home safely. Kindly refer to this video.

This is a remote role open to candidates residing in the US or Canada.

Technical Charter and Impact:

  • Own the cloud-side path from model artifact to production system for Safety AI's ML applications.
  • Establish practical standards for productionizing models — how they're served, evaluated, versioned, and monitored once they leave applied science.
  • Set a high bar for reliability: rigorous evaluation, measurable rollout health, and systems that degrade predictably rather than silently.
  • Act as a technical partner to applied scientists, helping translate research outputs into systems that are debuggable, scalable, and cost-efficient in production.

In this role, you will:

  • Design Production ML APIs: Architect and maintain reliable, low-latency APIs to integrate Safety AI model outputs directly into cloud applications.
  • Build Data Flywheels: Construct scalable pipelines to power continuous model iteration, backtesting, shadow and online evaluation, enabling fast and safe deployments.
  • Optimize & Serve Artifacts: Productionize model artifacts handed off by applied scientists, optimizing serving logic and fine-tuning models for platform-specific workloads.
  • Petabyte-Scale Operations: Process high-volume camera and sensor telematics data to support model execution, backtesting, and automated dataset curation.
  • Monitor & Maintain Rollout Health: Build systems to track model drift, precision/recall, and latency regressions in production, ensuring predictable failure modes and closed-loop data feedback.
  • Cross-Functional System Integration: Partner with firmware and platform teams to optimize edge-to-cloud model execution, balancing latency, throughput, and infrastructure cost.
  • Product Collaboration: Work with product managers to translate safety requirements into scalable technical architectures.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 6+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or similar role, with a track record of shipping models in production.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more common languages (e.g., C++, Golang, Java, Python, Scala).
  • Proficiency with common ML tools (e.g. Ray/Ray Serve, MLflow, Grafana, Pytorch, Spark, etc).
  • Experience deploying and iteratively refining models using real customer feedback loops.
  • Comfort with full-stack/backend development — you understand the data structures and dependencies underneath your models.
  • BS or MS in Computer Science or a related quantitative field.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Ph.D. in Computer Science or a quantitative discipline (e.g., Applied Math, Physics, Statistics).
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code frameworks.
  • Experience deploying and managing ML applications in cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure), including cloud-based storage, processing, and inference.
  • Experience shipping end-to-end ML applications from artifact to production, ideally in safety-critical or high-scale domains.
  • Expertise optimizing distributed model training with GPUs.

jobs.title: Account Manager, ACOs & Medicare Supplement (MediGap) Health Plans
jobs.excerpt: About Ceresti Health Ceresti Health exists because dementia doesn’t just happen to a person — it happens to a family.
jobs.description:
About Ceresti Health

Ceresti Health exists because dementia doesn’t just happen to a person — it happens to a family. We’ve built the first national, technology-enabled program that puts family caregivers at the center of dementia care, and we’re one of a small number of organizations selected by CMS to participate in the GUIDE Model. That’s not a credential. It’s a mandate. We’re building the infrastructure to transform how this country cares for people living with dementia — and the Account Manager position for ACOs & Med Supp plans is one of the most important roles in making that real.

Ceresti Health is a tech-enabled dementia care provider pioneering a differentiated model of care to activates family caregivers by giving them the knowledge, skills, and confident to detect an early change in their loved one’s condition. As one of the organizations selected by CMS to participatein the GUIDE Model and almost a decade of experience working in Medicare Advantage populations, we’re at the forefront of transforming dementia care nationwide.

Position Overview

The Account Manager, ACOs & MediGap is a high-ownership, relationship-intensive role at the intersection of performance management, physician awareness and education, carrier relationship development, and organizational change. You will serve as the primary partner for ACOs and Medicare Supplement carriers partnering with Ceresti — helping both ACOs and MediGap carriers strategically leverage the GUIDE Model to impact one of the costliest, most unmanaged cohorts in their populations. The Account Manager is responsible not just for account health, but for building the kind of trust that allows Ceresti to proactively enroll eligible beneficiaries on behalf of partner ACOs and MediGap plans.

This is not a reactive account management role. ACOs are complex organizations with physician stakeholders who are protective of their patient relationships, operational teams managing competing priorities, and leadership who need to see ROI in shared savings and operational relief. MediGapcarriers bring a different but equally complex dynamic — product and actuarial teams evaluating clinical value, compliance teams navigating CMS requirements, and member services teams that need seamless integration with GUIDE Model workflows. Your job is to earn and maintain trust across both channels — and to translate that trust into enrollment performance, program adoption, and measurable outcomes.

You’ll succeed here if you’re energized by complexity, comfortable navigating physician skepticism and carrier procurement cycles, and deeply motivated by what it means to get this right for families living with dementia.

Key Responsibilities

ACO & MediGap Carrier Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary account owner for assigned ACO and MediGap carrier partners from post-implementation through steady state.
  • Build strong, trusted relationships with ACO leadership, operations teams, clinical leaders, and care management staff, as well as MediGap carrier product, compliance, and member services teams.
  • Understand all components of the GUIDE Model and communicate GUIDE workflows to ACO care teams. For MediGap partners, understand how the GUIDE Model applies within the MediGap context and help carriers operationalize Ceresti's program for their member populations.
  • Act as an internal liaison at Ceresti for each partner (ACO or MediGap carrier), ensuring the partner’s needs, constraints, and priorities are clearly understood, communicated, and appropriately addressed.
  • Support contract adherence, shared savings alignment (ACOs), GUIDE Model performance targets (MediGap carriers), and ongoing partnership health.

Program Performance & Growth

  • Own enrollment performance for assigned ACOs and MediGap carriers, including monitoring physician/care team referral flow (ACOs), member outreach and program utilization (MediGap), outreach effectiveness, and caregiver activation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve uptake through provider education, workflow refinement, targeted engagement strategies, and — for MediGap partners — carrier marketing integration and member communications.
  • Partner with internal teams to troubleshoot enrollment barriers and optimize operational processes.
  • Support discussions around performance results, savings, and opportunities for expansion.

Provider, Care Team & Carrier Enablement

  • Drive physician awareness and buy-in across assigned ACO networks — including direct engagement with PCPs, care managers, and practice staff to establish Ceresti’s model as a trusted complement to existing care teams, not a competing intervention. For MediGap partners, enable carrier member services teams to support GUIDE Model enrollment and workflows for their members.
  • Coordinate patient-facing, provider-facing, and carrier-facing materials, training, and communications in collaboration with Marketing & Engagement teams.
  • Ensure providers understand Ceresti’s caregiver-centric approach and how it complements—not replaces—existing care management teams and efforts.

Proactive Enrollment Stewardship

  • Build and maintain the trust and governance alignment required for Ceresti to conduct proactive outreach to eligible beneficiaries on behalf of partner ACOs and MediGap carriers. For ACOs, this means physician-level alignment; for MediGap carriers, this means carrier-approved member outreach and GUIDE Model enrollment workflows. Own the internal and external approvals, workflows, and communication protocols that make proactive enrollment operationally viable and clinically credible across both channels.

Operational Coordination

  • Coordinate closely with Implementation, GUIDE Coordinators, Coaching, and Operations teams to ensure smooth ongoing operations across ACO and MediGap accounts.
  • Support data-sharing workflows, CCLF data file refreshes (ACOs), carrier eligibility file exchanges (MediGap), and outreach approvals in alignment with ACO governance and carrier compliance requirements.
  • Monitor operational SLAs, outreach cadence, and member experience to ensure a high-quality, compliant program.

Reporting & Communication

  • Lead recurring partner check-ins and business reviews with assigned ACOs and MediGap carriers.
  • Deliver clear, data-driven updates on enrollment, engagement, outcomes, and operational performance.
  • Translate complex data into concise, executive-ready insights for ACO and MediGap carrier stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in account management, client success, provider relations, carrier/payer relations, or partnership management within healthcare.
  • Experience working with ACOs, Medicare Advantage plans, Medicare Supplement (MediGap) carriers, or value-based care organizations. Direct experience with MediGap carriers, CMS care model delivery, or carrier product and operations teams is strongly valued.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare operations, provider workflows, and population health models.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder relationships.
  • Exceptional communication, organization, and follow-through skills.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting CMS models (e.g. GUIDE, MSSP, ACO REACH, or other value-based programs).
  • Familiarity with caregiver support, dementia care, home care, or care management models.
  • Experience managing carrier or health plan accounts, including CMS model implementation, member engagement, or GUIDE-adjacent program delivery.
  • Experience presenting performance data and outcomes to executive audiences.
  • Comfort working in a high-growth, fast-moving startup environment.
  • Experience with HubSpot is a plus

What You’re Walking Into

  • A role with real ownership — you’ll have named ACO and National MediGap carrier accounts, clear performance metrics, and direct visibility to senior leadership
  • A CMS GUIDE Model that is early-stage nationally, and a MediGap channel that is greenfield — which means your work shapes how this program scales across both channels nationwide
  • A team that’s deeply mission-aligned and operationally serious — we move fast, but we don’t cut corners on compliance or quality
  • Competitive compensation, full benefits, and a remote-first environment built for people who deliver without being managed

Why Ceresti?

Ceresti Health is redefining how caregivers of people living with dementia are supported—at scale. Our national, tech-enabled, caregiver-centric, and risk-bearing model delivers meaningful cost savings while dramatically improving caregiver and patient outcomes. Joining Ceresti means playing a direct role in expanding access to high-impact support for families who need it most.

Salary: $100,000 – $110,000 / year

  • AI-Native Infrastructure: Architect and implement the core engineering infrastructure required to run AI workloads reliably, moving client architectures from static data lakes to dynamic Vector Databases and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
  • Agentic Development: Build production-grade Agentic Workflows and custom AI agents, utilising advanced toolsets to bridge the widening market implementation gap.
  • Setting Development Best Practices: Define, promote, and establish best practice tools, security approaches, and common service patterns across the entire CreateFuture organisation. Ensure Infrastructure as Code (IaC) is the organisational default and challenge inefficient legacy processes.
  • FinOps & Governance: Enforce strict automated security and cost controls, real-time cost-anomaly detection, and cost estimation into the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) as a standard. Understanding of OpenTelemetry or other telemetry approaches.
  • Internal Platform Support: Assist the Capability Lead and architects in defining and delivering an internal collection of reusable components, reference architectures, and Proof of Concepts (PoCs). Supporting the internal IT function in helping other parts of the business use Cloud services.

Leading & Mentoring

  • Culture & Collaboration: Lead by example, creating a culture of open, honest feedback, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

Skills & Experience

Core Technical Capabilities

Candidates must demonstrate a hybrid skillset, balancing Software Engineering (30%), Platform/SRE (40%), and Data Engineering (30%), with a core focus on Security, Governance, and Cost Management.

  • Cloud & Infrastructure (40%): Advanced Infrastructure as Code (IaC) via Terraform, advanced Kubernetes administration (clusters, nodes, pods), hardcore networking (VPC peering, Service Mesh, Zero Trust security), and solution architecture experience, with a cost-optimisation mindset.
  • Software Engineering, Agentic & AI Development (30%): Solid software engineer principles (pipelines, toolsets, testing, linting, vulnerability scanning, etc.) Production-level experience with tools such as Amazon Bedrock, AWS AgentCore, Azure AI Studio, LangChain, and writing automation scripts or custom AI agents using node or python.
  • Data Engineering (30%): Experience deploying and maintaining data orchestration toolsets (e.g., dbt, Apache Airflow), ETL/ELT methodologies, real-time streaming (e.g., AWS Kinesis, Apache Kafka), Vector databases, and RAG architectures.
  • Observability & FinOps: Experience implementing modern observability tooling (OpenTelemetry) alongside automated cost-control systems (such as Karpenter, Infracost, OpenCost, or Cloud Custodian).

Domain & Sector Experience

  • Regulated Industries: Experience working in highly regulated sectors such as Financial Services or iGaming is helpful, demonstrating an understanding of strict compliance, data privacy risks, and governance guardrails.
  • Consulting: Proven background in a client-facing consulting capacity, managing stakeholders, handling commercial realities, and meeting strict SLAs, timescales, and budgets.

Preferred Knowledge-level & Certifications

  • Multiple professional-level certifications (AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional or Azure Architect AZ-305.)
  • Beneficial for AWS GenAI Developer Professional, AWS ML Engineer Associate, or Azure AI Engineer Associate.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:

At Pandoblox, the Data Project Manager plays a central role in coordinating both client and internal projects, with particular emphasis on data-centric engagements — including data architecture, migration, ETL/pipeline builds, and BI/dashboarding delivery. This role sits at the intersection of structured project delivery and technical data work, requiring someone who can speak fluently to data architects and engineers while still owning the project plan, budget, and client communication. You will manage multiple concurrent projects in a well-organized, efficient, and professional manner, acting as a primary liaison between the Organization's delivery teams and its client stakeholders.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

In this role, you'll get to...

  • manage the people, tasks, and external resources for assigned data projects within the defined tolerances
  • ensure the project team is defined and staffed appropriately, and that the appropriate internal and external services (data engineers, architects, analysts) are obtained to meet project objectives
  • coordinate data architecture, migration, and ETL/pipeline workstreams, translating technical scope into a clear project plan and timeline
  • support the delivery of BI/dashboarding engagements alongside data infrastructure work, coordinating between engineering, design, and client stakeholders
  • comply with all System Development/Project Life Cycle, Change Management, Regulatory, and applicable data privacy/security requirements
  • provide oversight of the analysis, development, implementation, and maintenance of data systems and applications
  • communicate with users, IT, and senior-level management concerning project progress, concerns, and issues, and manage stakeholders' expectations
  • ensure all project requirements and/or objectives — including data quality, validation, and governance checkpoints — are properly defined and documented
  • establish, build, and update project plans with actuals and forecasts; manage deviations from the plan and identify and manage project risk
  • act as a primary liaison between the data/engineering division and the various stakeholders
  • maintain project and task tracking in the Organization's core PM tools (e.g., ClickUp for tasks, Harvest/Forecast for time-tracking and burndown reporting)
  • express information effectively through clear and convincing oral and written presentations, including translating technical data concepts for non-technical stakeholders
  • perform other duties as needed by the role

REQUIREMENTS:

On day one, we'll expect you to...

  • have a bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience
  • have a minimum of 5 years of Project Management experience, including exposure to data, analytics, or BI/dashboarding engagements
  • possess solid knowledge of project management frameworks, tools, and practices
  • have working knowledge of data architecture, ETL/pipeline concepts, and data warehouse or migration project fundamentals — enough to scope, sequence, and de-risk technical workstreams
  • have exposure to SQL and relational databases sufficient to understand data models and ask informed technical questions
  • have familiarity with BI/dashboarding tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar) from a delivery-coordination standpoint
  • be comfortable working in ClickUp (or a comparable task-tracking tool) and Harvest/Forecast (or a comparable time-tracking and forecasting platform)
  • be experienced in project budgeting, design, scheduling, and documentation
  • have good business analysis skills
  • have excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • have strong management skills and the ability to lead and motivate project teams
  • demonstrate the ability to build and manage relationships with customers and all stakeholders across business units
  • be experienced in supervising a matrix team of associates, contractors, and vendors with various skills and disciplines
  • have the ability to coordinate/participate on multiple projects in a well-organized, efficient, and professional manner
  • be able to work independently, multi-task, and prioritize responsibilities, leveraging time management and problem-solving skills to perform assigned tasks with reasonable levels of self-direction
  • have keen attention to detail and focus on task completion, particularly around data accuracy and validation
  • have a fully functional and up-to-date computer with which to perform duties
  • be willing to install next-generation endpoint protection on the computer
  • be a current resident of the Philippines and able to perform work from there
  • be willing to work within US Pacific business hours (8am–5pm PT, which corresponds to Philippine hours per the Organization's seasonal schedule)

What separate the best from the rest...

  • multiple industry exposure
  • PMP certification
  • agile experience and certification
  • Six Sigma certification
  • experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar)
  • prior hands-on data engineering or data analyst background before moving into project management
  • experience with data governance frameworks and data privacy/compliance considerations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA)
  • experience delivering dashboarding/observability engagements
  • experience supporting both waterfall data projects (e.g., migrations, assessments) and recurring/managed data services within the same portfolio

NOTES:

  • Benefits await full-time contractors.
  • This is a remote (work from home) position.

About WindshieldHUB

WindshieldHUB is a fast-growing nationwide auto glass company serving customers in more than 100 cities across the United States.

We combine outstanding customer service with technology to make scheduling auto glass replacement and repair simple, fast, and convenient.

Our team is built around high standards, accountability, strong communication, teamwork, and continuous improvement. As we continue expanding our operations, we are looking for talented professionals who want to grow with an international company.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated Customer Retention & Cancellation Specialist to join our growing remote team.

This is a full-time remote position.

This is not a traditional customer service role.

Your primary responsibility will be to work directly with customers who are considering canceling their scheduled auto glass service, understand the reason behind the cancellation, resolve concerns whenever possible, and retain the order while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

The ideal candidate is confident, persuasive, fluent in English, comfortable handling objections, and able to take ownership of difficult customer conversations.

You should know how to actively listen, identify the customer's real concerns, present effective solutions, negotiate when appropriate, rebuild customer confidence, and turn potential cancellations into completed services.

What We're Looking For

Minimum Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of experience in Customer Service, Customer Retention, Sales, Collections, Call Center Operations, or another customer-facing role.
  • Fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection.
  • Quiet, professional home office suitable for handling customer calls.
  • Noise-canceling headset (preferred).

Candidates should also demonstrate:

  • Strong sales, retention, negotiation, and objection-handling skills
  • Excellent verbal communication and active listening
  • Confidence handling frustrated or dissatisfied customers
  • Ability to remain calm and professional during difficult conversations
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills
  • Ability to quickly build customer trust
  • Results-driven mindset with strong accountability
  • Excellent organizational and follow-up skills
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong collaboration with cross-functional teams
  • Experience using CRM, call center, or sales software is a plus

Key Responsibilities

  • Contact customers requesting to cancel their scheduled auto glass service.
  • Identify the true reason behind each cancellation request.
  • Make every reasonable effort to retain and save the customer's order.
  • Handle objections professionally while providing appropriate solutions.
  • Build customer confidence by explaining available service options, scheduling alternatives, and next steps.
  • Collaborate with Dispatch, Customer Service, and other departments to resolve customer concerns.
  • Follow up with customers when additional information or action is required.
  • Accurately document customer conversations, cancellation reasons, retention attempts, and outcomes within the CRM.
  • Identify recurring cancellation trends and communicate findings to management.
  • Deliver a positive customer experience even when an order cannot be retained.
  • Meet individual and team KPIs related to customer retention, saved orders, follow-up, and service quality.
  • Follow WindshieldHUB policies while exercising sound judgment to resolve customer concerns.
  • Take full ownership of assigned cases from initial contact through final resolution.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Customer Retention & Cancellation Specialist does much more than process cancellations.

Successful team members:

  • Understand why customers want to cancel.
  • Find solutions whenever possible.
  • Protect customer relationships.
  • Successfully retain qualified orders.
  • Maintain accurate documentation.
  • Help identify trends that reduce future cancellations.
  • Consistently meet retention and quality goals.

Why Join WindshieldHUB?

  • 100% Remote Position
  • Competitive salary and performance incentives
  • Opportunity to work directly with customers across the United States
  • Supportive, growth-oriented work environment
  • Comprehensive training and career advancement opportunities
  • Join a rapidly growing international company serving over 100 U.S. cities
  • Be recognized for your performance, ideas, and contributions

Apply Now

If you have at least 2 years of customer service, retention, collections, or sales experience, speak fluent English, and enjoy overcoming objections while helping customers make informed decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

We're looking for professionals who take ownership, solve problems, build customer confidence, and turn cancellation requests into successful customer experiences.

jobs.description:
Nofence has built the world’s firstprecision livestock management platform for livestock. The technology consists of a solar-powered collar that communicates with an app over the cellular network. Through the app, livestock producers can set up a new grazing area in seconds, and the long days of installing and moving fences are officially over! Livestock can graze longer and in more areas, and the owner will always have visibility of their location. This means better profitability and more free time for producers as well as improved animal welfare.

With a strong foundation of 10,000+ customers globally, we are expanding in the US. To support this growth, we’re looking for a Sales Specialist to join our dynamic team.

We’re building a remote-friendly team across the country and currently hiring across the US.

This position will be located in the state of California.

Join us on the journey to revolutionize agriculture and create a better everyday life for livestock producers and their animals!

About the role

Your mission will be to sell Nofence, a precision livestock management platform to US producers.

You will reach out to and follow up with potential and existing customers, coming from inbound inquiries and face to face producer outreach. However, we’re looking for someone adaptable, proactive, and ready to take on new challenges as our company evolves. If future needs require cold calling, you should be comfortable stepping into that role.

Above all, we prioritize building strong customer relationships. This means understanding our customers' needs and guiding them to make the most of our product. While we provide full product training, previous experience working with livestock producers is a great advantage.

The right candidate is self-motivated, energetic, and hardworking, preferably with a background from agriculture. As a part of our team you will have the opportunity to grow together with the company, as the opportunities for development are endless both for our product and our employees!

Title: Sales Specialist

Status: Full-time, exempt (not subject to overtime), 40 hours per week

Supervisor: National Sales Director- US

Location: US-Remote -California

The main responsibilities for this role will be:

  • Close sales through phone, email and face to face

  • Respond to inbound sales via phone and email, ticketing system, and other tools

  • Document and update customer records and support cases in our CRM system.

  • Work alongside our customer support team

  • Travel expected to relevant events and to potential and current customers

In the current phase of growing our team we will need someone who is adaptable and willing to contribute to non-sales and non-support related tasks like;

  • Contributing to projects across the organization

  • Contributing to developing the Sales team and shaping our structure

  • Contributing to developing the Support team and shaping our structure

About you

We are looking for someone who has:

  • A degree or equivalent in a field relevant to the position. Practical experience and engagement can compensate for a lack of formal qualifications

  • Proven experience as a sales consultant or similar role in a tech company or industry

  • A background which makes you able to answer questions related to agriculture, pasture management, or animal husbandry

  • Keen interest in our market and ability to gain competence in our technology

  • Excellent English oral and writing skills

  • Strong communication skills

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Independent and self-driven

  • Ambitious and result-oriented

  • Genuinely interested in livestock production

  • A team player with a heart for the greater good

About Nofence

Managing livestock has always been a challenge. Humanity has tried everything from herding with dogs to walling the animals in with barbed wire, electric, and wooden fences, but these are costly and time-consuming solutions and often in conflict with the local wildlife. It has also left vast areas of potential pasture overgrown and underutilized.

Until now.

Enter virtual fences. What started as a small group of farmers and engineers with a big idea has become Nofence – the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. Curious about how it works?Find out more here.What can we offer?

Our way of working is continuously evolving, and you will have the opportunity to make an impact on how we do things. We are passionate about product development, animal welfare, producer welfare, and sustainable agriculture. As our colleague, you will be part of an exciting company with enormous ambitions for growth in the US. We genuinely believe our grazing technology can be the biggest technological change in agriculture since the tractor!

The right candidate will receive a competitive benefits package, including 100% employer-paid health insurance, 25 days of paid time off (PTO) plus all federal holidays, an additional 5 days of company-wide leave during quieter periods, 401(k) retirement contributions (4%, Nofence contributes 4% of your salary automatically, with absolutely no matching contribution required from you). 8 weeks of paid parental leave, and a vehicle stipend: all within a supportive, rewarding environment designed to help you thrive.

Salary & Compensation:

The base salary for this role is $60,000 – $90,000 per year, with an annual performance bonus of up to 20% of base salary.

We are open to considering candidates at a more senior level. Should a more experienced candidate be selected, this position may be filled at the Senior Sales Specialist level, with a corresponding base salary of $90,000 – $130,000 per year and the same 20% bonus opportunity.

When determining salary ranges for our roles, we look at external market data and the salaries of Nofencers holding the same or similar roles. Our pay bands reflect the broad range of skills and experience levels great candidates bring to us. When making individual pay decisions, we take into account the candidate's depth of relevant experience, their skills relative to the role, and their location.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Rewards
jobs.excerpt: Who we areMoniepoint Inc.  is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About The Role

Rewards is one of the most strategically important platforms at Moniepoint, and it is being built into a dedicated charter with its own engineering and product leadership. The platform sits at the centre of our retention strategy across a user base of approximately 23 million people.

Today the platform does one thing: cashback. It works, but it has barely scratched the surface of what rewards can be, and the cashback product itself is not yet built to the depth it deserves. The ambition is to evolve it into a full rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform — and to do that across the full 360 degrees of our network. That means rewards for our business customers, rewards for our consumer customers, and rewards for the sales agents who drive our distribution. Very few companies get to design this from close to a blank page at this scale.

The Head of Engineering owns that platform end to end. You will inherit a team of nine engineers, including an Engineering Manager, and build the organisation out from there — the current expectation is a minimum of three product units and upwards of 25 people, though the eventual shape is genuinely yours to define. Your first objective is to get the best possible performance out of the cashback product we already have. From there, you will work with Growth, Sales and Marketing to determine what we build for acquisition and retention, and roll it out across every customer we serve.

This is a consumer-facing product engineering role, and that is the most important thing to understand about it. Rewards is won or lost on experimentation, personalisation, and the quality of the experience in a customer's hands. We are looking for a leader who has built and shipped direct-to-consumer products at scale, who is fluent in experimentation and A/B testing, and who has real depth in front-end and mobile engineering — not a purely backend platform leader.

Moniepoint runs a Domain CTO model. We view our Heads of Engineering as the CTO of their domain: you own the technical roadmap, the architecture, the delivery, and the organisation beneath you. You will have full autonomy over engineering strategy, architecture, hiring, operating cadence and roadmap trade-offs.

You will report functionally to our Group CTO, with a dual reporting line into the Product leader for Rewards. That second line is a delivery relationship rather than a seniority one — engineering and product are peers here, and you will build the team to full capacity together. Your responsibilities as Head of Engineering, Rewards includes:

  • Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Rewards Platform end to end.
  • Improving the performance, reliability and depth of the existing cashback product as an immediate first priority.
  • Evolving cashback into a broader rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform serving business customers, consumer customers and sales agents.
  • Building the engineering organisation from its current base - structuring product units, hiring engineers and Engineering Managers, and leading through those managers as the team scales.
  • Establishing a strong experimentation culture: A/B testing, cohort analysis, and measurement that lets the team learn quickly what actually changes customer behaviour.
  • Working closely with Growth, Sales and Marketing to translate acquisition and retention objectives into product and engineering initiatives.
  • Owning the customer-facing experience of rewards across mobile and web, including how quickly and reliably customers receive what they have earned.
  • Define architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and own the engineering health of the domain — incidents, production defects, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and developer experience.
  • Build the platform to serve customers across multiple geographies as Moniepoint expands.
  • Partner with Product to define the rewards-specific metrics and OKRs that do not yet exist, and hold the team to them.

Who You Are

  • Direct-to-consumer product engineering at scale. You have built and shipped products used directly by large consumer audiences, and you understand what moves engagement and retention. This is the defining requirement of the role.
  • Genuine front-end and mobile depth. You have led or personally built consumer-facing mobile and web experiences. A backend-only background, however strong, is not what this role needs.
  • Experimentation and growth engineering. Hands-on experience running A/B tests, feature flagging, and measurement frameworks, and using the results to drive product decisions rather than to justify them.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, not a single team.
  • Hands-on technical leadership. You are still close to the code. We expect a meaningful proportion of hands-on engineering time and technical credibility with the engineers you lead.
  • 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
  • Comfort with our backend environment — Java and Spring Boot — and the ability to lead backend engineers credibly, even if it is not where your own depth sits.
  • Experience building and scaling an engineering organisation from a small base, including hiring and developing Engineering Managers.
  • Strong collaboration with commercial stakeholders — growth, marketing and sales — and the ability to translate business objectives into engineering work.
  • Rewards, loyalty, gamification, personalisation or growth platform experience is a strong advantage but is not required.
  • Fintech or payments experience is an advantage, not a requirement.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like In The Role

  • The existing cashback product performing measurably better — faster, more reliable, and more compelling to customers.
  • A credible rewards platform roadmap defined with Product, and the first initiatives beyond cashback shipped.
  • A functioning experimentation practice, where the team ships, measures and learns on a short cycle.
  • An engineering organisation built out from its current base, with a strong bench of Engineering Managers and senior engineers.
  • Rewards established as a measurable contributor to retention and engagement across the customer base.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Team

The Marketing OS – LeadGen Covert Team owns the products and platform capabilities that help agencies attract, engage, capture, qualify, and understand leads across digital and offline customer journeys.

The team is responsible for:

  • Forms and form-building experiences

  • Surveys and customer data-collection workflows

  • Quizzes, assessments, and interactive lead-generation experiences

  • QR Codes and offline-to-online lead acquisition

  • Chat Widget and conversational lead capture

  • External Tracking across third-party websites and digital properties

  • Lead capture, submission, attribution, and behavioral analytics

  • Templates, integrations, embeddable experiences, and extensibility

These products are critical entry points into the HighLevel Marketing OS. They connect customer interactions across websites, landing pages, physical locations, campaigns, and external properties with HighLevel’s CRM, automation, analytics, and communication capabilities.

Why Join HighLevel?

  • Ownership: It is never somebody else’s job.

  • Customer focus: We are passionately focused on adding value for our users.

  • Speed: We use lean principles and go to market in weeks rather than quarters.

  • Experimentation: Good ideas are tested quickly, measured, and improved iteratively.

  • Growth: You will help scale a global B2B SaaS platform and build products used by millions of businesses.

  • People: We take care of our team so our team can take care of our users.

Role Overview

As Staff Product Manager – Marketing OS, LeadGen Covert Team, you will shape the future of lead generation at HighLevel.

You will own product vision, strategy, and execution across a portfolio that includes Forms, Surveys, Quizzes, QR Codes, Chat Widget, External Tracking, and adjacent lead capture and attribution capabilities.

Your mandate will be to transform these products into a cohesive LeadGen platform that enables agencies and SMBs to create high-converting acquisition experiences, collect better-quality data, understand visitor behavior, and activate every lead through HighLevel’s CRM and automation ecosystem.

This is a senior individual contributor role with organization-wide influence. You will work across multiple product and engineering teams, establish shared platform foundations, and influence how HighLevel competes in lead generation, conversational engagement, behavioral tracking, and marketing attribution.

Your work will directly impact product adoption, lead volume, lead quality, engagement, conversion, retention, and overall platform growth.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the LeadGen strategy: Define the long-term vision, product strategy, and roadmap across Forms, Surveys, Quizzes, QR Codes, Chat Widget, and External Tracking.

  • Build a unified platform: Create shared experiences and foundations across builders, templates, publishing, data models, integrations, analytics, and reporting.

  • Improve lead capture: Drive capabilities that increase visitor engagement, completion rates, lead quality, qualification, routing, and follow-up.

  • Connect the customer journey: Partner with CRM, Workflows, Conversations, Analytics, and Payments teams to connect interactions with downstream business outcomes.

  • Lead External Tracking: Define how HighLevel captures visitor behavior, conversions, identity, attribution, and campaign activity across third-party websites.

  • Establish analytics foundations: Create consistent event taxonomies, instrumentation standards, and reporting across the LeadGen portfolio.

  • Drive AI-assisted creation: Deliver AI-powered creation, copy generation, logic recommendations, qualification, insights, and conversion optimization.

  • Improve cross-device experiences: Ensure creation and consumption experiences are intuitive, responsive, accessible, and performant across desktop, mobile, and tablet.

  • Influence technical architecture: Partner with Engineering on builders, embeddable widgets, APIs, submission pipelines, tracking scripts, identity resolution, and event infrastructure.

  • Lead cross-functional execution: Align Product, Engineering, Design, Data, AI, Security, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships around shared outcomes.

  • Shape go-to-market strategy: Influence product positioning, pricing, packaging, messaging, launches, enablement, onboarding, and customer education.

  • Operate hands-on: Write strategy documents and PRDs, conduct discovery, analyze data, validate concepts, prioritize initiatives, and resolve ambiguity.

  • Own measurable outcomes: Drive improvements in adoption, activation, publishing, engagement, completion, conversion, attribution coverage, and retention.

Experience

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, MarTech, CRM, analytics, growth, or customer-engagement platforms.

  • Proven experience owning a large-scale customer-facing product, product suite, or platform.

  • Experience defining multi-year product strategies across multiple interconnected product areas.

  • Strong understanding of lead generation, customer acquisition, conversion optimization, qualification, and growth loops.

  • Experience with products such as forms, surveys, quizzes, chat widgets, analytics, attribution, tracking, or interactive content.

  • Familiarity with behavioral tracking, including page views, clicks, scrolls, field interactions, submissions, abandonment, and conversion events.

  • Understanding of event taxonomies, analytics instrumentation, data pipelines, experimentation, and marketing attribution.

  • Experience building embeddable products such as widgets, scripts, SDKs, forms, or externally hosted experiences.

  • Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, CRM integrations, field mapping, workflow automation, and identity resolution.

  • Experience partnering with Engineering on complex frontend, backend, data, and infrastructure systems.

  • Strong product judgment, analytical ability, and UI/UX sensibility.

  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across teams without direct authority.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, decision-making, and stakeholder leadership skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI- or LLM-powered creation, conversational, or optimization products.

  • Experience building form builders, survey platforms, chat products, interactive content, or behavioral analytics tools.

  • Experience with first-party tracking, customer identity, attribution, consent management, or data governance.

  • Background in high-volume event ingestion, real-time analytics, experimentation, or personalization systems.

  • Experience building products for marketing agencies, SMBs, creators, or multi-location businesses.

  • Prior experience working in a remote, globally distributed product organization.

We are looking for someone who can join the team full-time feeling like it is its own company he/she is working in. This is a fully remote role

It is a fast-growing brand developing several new green and sustainable products for eco-conscious consumers. Currently, the company sells mostly on Amazon, but it also operates on Shopify and Walmart. It has over 200,000 customers in 7 countries (USA, Canada, Mexico, UK, Germany, Japan, China). The company just partnered up with a sales team in the US who will work on getting its products in physical retail stores.

This work is changing the world here because his e-commerce brand is set to positively impact the lives of thousands of eco-conscious people who choose to use the companys eco-friendly products, saving tons of plastic waste and CO2 every year. The company is also committed to environmental and social causes, having planted 10,000 trees and financing plastic waste collection from the oceans through our partners at Clean Hub.

Here are some specific things you'll get to do in this role:

- Consistently achieve or exceed sales targets for the Amazon business
- Be responsible for Amazon store end-to-end management, increasing ranking, conversion, and overall sales
- Launch new products: keywords research, funnels, listing preparations, backend settings, review generation, etc.
- Drive the success of product launches that include delivering on key factors that support this critical phase of the Amazon product lifecycle
- Monitor operational health, sales metrics, and Amazon advertising trends to ensure target metrics are achieved.
- Report (daily, weekly, monthly) on overall operations health and provide recommendations to enhance performance
- Resolution and follow-up of problems through the creation of seller support cases

  • Excellent communication skills
  • Excellent English level

Our benefits

  • Work for a market-proven, fast-growing company.
  • Competitive and timely salary. Additional benefits.
  • Supportive and friendly work environment.
  • Be a part of something bigger, where you can have autonomy over your work.
  • Fully remote work and flexible working hours (work from whatever place).

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.excerpt: At MyFitnessPal, we believe good health starts with what you eat.
jobs.description:
At MyFitnessPal, we believe good health starts with what you eat. We provide tools, resources and support to enable users to reach their health goals.

We are looking for a Staff Data Engineer to join the MyFitnessPal Data Engineering team. Our users rely on MyFitnessPal to power their health and fitness journeys every day. As a member of our MyFitnessPal Engineering team, you’ll have the opportunity to positively impact those users with your expertise in the backend systems that drive the MyFitnessPal ecosystem. In addition to technical expertise, you’ll find that your teammates value collaboration, mentorship, and inclusive environments.

About the team:

MyFitnessPal encourages innovation and adoption of the latest technologies available to deliver an amazing experience for our members. Our diverse team of brilliant technologists builds and maintains native mobile applications, a web application, the world’s largest nutrition database, constantly evolving data science and AI/ML assets, the backend infrastructure and data platform required to support these applications and databases, as well as the business systems and data required to manage an awesome company. Technologies and languages we work with include: Airflow, Snowflake, dbt, Git Hub, PlanetScale, Elasticsearch, Scala, Python, SQL, Amplitude, Appsflyer, Kubernetes, Kafka, Docker, Okta and Claude Code. We care more about your general engineering skills and technical leadership than your knowledge of a specific language and or framework.

What you'll be doing:

  • Design, build, and maintain high-throughput, event-driven data services and orchestration pipelines using Python, Airflow, and Snowflake, enabling reliable analytics and product insights at scale
  • Architect and evolve core platform components to ensure scalable, secure, and extensible data pipelines to support the organization, including updating ingestion patterns (CDC, Kafka event streaming) to modernize legacy pipelines.
  • Collaborate with team on development and adoption of DataOps best practices — data modeling, CI/CD, unit testing, and validation frameworks — ensuring quality and consistency across the data platform
  • Define and evangelize data engineering standards and best practices for the broader organization, reviewing work for other engineers and providing implementation guidance
  • Further our team's agentic development maturity — increasing the volume of recurring engineering work handled by agents, while prioritizing guardrails and safe AI usage as the foundation of that progress, and bringing the rest of the team along through hands-on collaboration and fostering a culture of learning
  • Help shape our data governance strategy, including how tools and AI assistants access and query our data safely and consistently
  • Own cost efficiency and stewardship for Snowflake and pipeline infrastructure, balancing performance and reliability against spend
  • Mentor data engineers and data analytics engineers, fostering technical growth and driving alignment on architectural patterns, tooling, and resilient system design
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives that span infrastructure, data services, and observability, to ensure operational excellence
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to proactively identify and solve complex user-facing and system-level challenges across data domains
  • Develop and maintain secure, compliant, and well-governed data systems, leveraging role-based access controls and data lifecycle management in alignment with legal, security, and data governance needs

Qualifications to be successful in this role:

  • 8 -12+ years in engineering roles, including 3 - 5+ years in data engineering at senior / architect / staff level working end-to-end data platforms
  • Extensive experience in Snowflake or similar data store
  • Experience with a variety of distributed and non-distributed, structured and unstructured data stores (e.g. RDS, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, S3)
  • Advanced SQL skills, including experience writing and optimizing complex queries against large-scale, high-cardinality datasets
  • Extensive experience with Airflow or similar orchestration tool
  • Experience writing high throughput services in Python
  • Experience with high-volume, event-driven architecture, including CDC (change-data-capture) and distributed event streaming (e.g. Kafka)
  • Experience with a variety of API design patterns ( REST, SOAP, etc)
  • Strong data ops skills including modeling, CI/CD pipelines, source control, unit testing frameworks, and data validation frameworks
  • Experience implementing observability via monitoring and alerting
  • Strong familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform)
  • Experience designing or driving adoption of agentic or AI-assisted development workflows (e.g. structured specs consumed by agents, automated test generation, agent-driven PR pipelines, skill development, AI code review)
  • Demonstrated experience defining engineering standards or best practices adopted across a team or organization, and cost-conscious ownership of infrastructure/systems

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with modular modeling via dbt, including deploying semantic layer best practices
  • Experience with dataset versioning and CI enforcement
  • Experience with scaling and resilience in data pipelines
  • Experience in high velocity experimentation organizations
  • Experience with data cataloging/governance tools (e.g. Secoda, Snowflake Horizon) and metadata stewardship programs
  • Experience building or evaluating AI-assisted internal tools with deterministic, code-level business-rule enforcement (vs. purely prompt-based vendor AI tools)
  • Experience with multi-agent orchestration or coordination patterns

Values you’ll model

  • Be Kind and Care — build with empathy; assume positive intent; support teammates and members.
  • Live Good Health — champion healthy habits and balance in how we work and what we ship.
  • Be Data-Inspired — ground decisions in research and data; measure what matters.
  • Champion Change — lean into ambiguity; iterate, learn, and improve continuously.
  • Leave it Better than You Found It — raise quality, clarify systems, and document as you go.
  • Make It Happen — bias to action; deliver impact with craft and accountability.

The reasonably estimated salary for this role at MyFitnessPal ranges from $170,000 - $230,000. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, MyFitnessPal offers a wide range of comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, parental planning, mental health benefits, annual performance bonus, a 401(k) plan and match, responsible time off, monthly wellness and technology allowances, and others.

Exciting Full-Time Employee Benefits, Perks and Culture

Face-to-Face Connections: We value personal connections. Enjoy opportunities to meet and connect with your team members in person to help forge meaningful relationships that extend beyond the virtual realm. Teams meet as often as needed and all of MyFitnessPal gathers annually.

Flexibility At Its Best: Achieve the work-life balance you deserve. Enjoy a flexible time-off policy with our Responsible Time Off benefit.

Give Back: Use your volunteer days off to support what matters most to you. Each full time teammate receives 2 days per calendar year to give back to their community through service.

Mentorship Program: Take control of your career through our mentorship program where, if you’d like, you will be matched with a teammate who can help you scale your skills and propel your growth.

Family-Friendly Support: Embrace the journey with confidence and care. Enjoy our paid maternity and paternity leave, to provide time to balance family responsibilities with your career and take the time needed to strengthen family relationships. We understand the complexities of starting or expanding a family, which is why we provide best-in-class comprehensive assistance for fertility-related matters.

Wellness Comes First: Live Good Health is one of our core values. Receive a monthly Wellness Allowance, empowering you to focus on your physical and mental well-being by choosing from a range of wellness initiatives, including dedicated mental health days.

Celebrate Greatness:Your hard work deserves recognition! Our reward and recognition platform empowers peers to acknowledge and reward each other for the exceptional contributions they make.

Elevate Your Health & Fitness: Get access to MyFitnessPal Premium, allowing you to take your fitness, health and wellness journey to new heights.

Unlock Your Potential: Access our virtual learning and development library, and participate in training opportunities to continuously grow and enhance your skills.

Championing Inclusion: Our dedicated DEI Committee actively fosters a diverse and inclusive workplace by setting actionable goals and evaluating progress across the organization.

Healthcare Matters: Your well-being is our priority. Take advantage of our competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits that cater to your holistic healthcare needs. Feel secure and supported on your wellness journey.

Secure Your Future: Benefit from our retirement savings program, giving you peace of mind for your financial goals. Reach them sooner with MyFitnessPal’s competitive employer match.

At MyFitnessPal, our mission is to enable people to make healthy choices. And it wouldn't be possible without our team. We celebrate the unique POV that each person brings to the table and believe in a collaborative and inclusive environment. As an equal opportunity employer, we prohibit any unlawful discrimination on the basis of race, religion, military or veteran status, sex, gender, marital status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or disability. jobs.excerpt: The Operations Specialist is responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, and execution of AT-RISK International’s clients and internal security and protection operations.
jobs.description:
The Operations Specialist is responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, and execution of AT-RISK International’s clients and internal security and protection operations. Reporting to the Director of Operations, this position provides operational coordination, project support, research, logistics, compliance tracking, and administrative support across the Operations department. The role serves as a flexible resource to increase departmental capacity and support effective delivery of client engagements.

The Operations Specialist will assist with partner management, protective personnel sourcing, travel and operational logistics, credentialing and vetting, special projects, and general Operations and Executive Protection support. The position will work closely with Operations Managers, department leadership, protective personnel, partners, clients, and internal stakeholders to verify operational requirements are organized, communicated, and executed effectively. The role may also provide remote, on-call, and in-person support for client engagements, events, and other operational requirements, with domestic and international travel anticipated.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, adaptable, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic environment with competing priorities. The position requires strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, initiative, and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams. The Operations Specialist should bring a solutions-oriented and transformational mindset, with a willingness to identify opportunities for process improvement, support innovation, and contribute to the continued development and scalability of AT-RISK International’s Operations function.

* While this position is remote, the ideal candidate would be located in Washington, California, or New York.*

DUTIES

OPERATIONS & PROTECTIVE SUPPORT

  • Provide operational, protective, logistical, and risk mitigation support for AT-RISK International client engagements and internal operations as assigned.
  • Support the planning, coordination, and execution of Executive Protection, secure transportation, and other protective operations.
  • Conduct, monitor, and participate in protective assignments as required.
  • Coordinate staffing requirements for protective operations, including research, sourcing, scheduling, and coordination of protection personnel and operational partners.
  • Manage and maintain the company’s partner roster, including capabilities, geographic coverage, availability, credentials, and other relevant operational information.
  • Conduct ongoing partner outreach and support the development and maintenance of operational relationships with partners and vendors.
  • Support the research, sourcing, vetting, hiring, and onboarding of protective personnel and operational resources.
  • Conduct and support advance work and prepare operational briefings, materials, and recommendations for protective teams and clients.
  • Coordinate and communicate operational requirements with clients, partners, protective personnel, and internal stakeholders before, during, and after assignments.
  • Provide remote operational support outside of normal business hours, including nights and weekends, as required to monitor active operations, address issues, and coordinate resources.
  • Participate in AT-RISK International’s on-call rotation as required.
  • Provide general Operations and Executive Protection ad-hoc and overflow support during periods of increased operational demand.
  • Support surveillance or other investigative-related operations when required by client or operational needs.
  • Assist with security assessments, risk mitigation activities, and other consulting or operational projects as assigned.
  • Conduct operational research and support process improvement initiatives.
  • Assist with the development and implementation of operational processes, procedures, resources, and documentation.
  • Support special projects and other initiatives as assigned by Operations leadership.

TRAVEL & OPERATIONAL LOGISTICS

  • Support travel planning and associated operational logistics for clients, protective personnel, and Operations staff.
  • Coordinate transportation, lodging, itineraries, staffing, equipment, and other logistical requirements.
  • Assist with domestic and international advance planning and operational preparation.
  • Provide in-person operational and client-facing support at events, meetings, and client engagements as required.
  • Coordinate with internal departments, clients, partners, vendors, and field personnel to verify operational requirements are communicated and executed effectively.
  • Prepare cost estimates, operational documentation, expense information, and invoice-related support as part of operational management.

LICENSING, CREDENTIALING & COMPLIANCE

  • Support the management of AT-RISK International’s multi-state security licensing requirements and compliance obligations.
  • Assist with the collection, verification, and maintenance of required documentation and credentials.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external partners to support continued compliance with applicable licensing and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential records related to licensing, credentialing, vetting, and compliance.

COMMUNICATIONS & CLIENT SUPPORT

  • Establish and maintain productive working relationships with clients, protective personnel, partners, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Support client satisfaction by ensuring operational requirements are understood, communicated, and addressed in a timely manner.
  • Maintain appropriate liaison with client security teams, local officials, law enforcement, public safety agencies, and other external stakeholders when directed.
  • Assist with client meetings, operational briefings, after-action discussions, and other client-facing activities.
  • Support business development initiatives and assist with identifying opportunities for future operational support when appropriate.

ADMINISTRATIVE & OPERATIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Perform administrative and operational functions in accordance with company policies, procedures, and established standards.
  • Assist Operations Managers and department leadership with administrative and project-based workload as needed.
  • Maintain accurate project records, operational documentation, timekeeping, expenses, and files.
  • Assist with project tracking, deliverables, follow-up, and other administrative requirements.
  • Support the development of presentations, reports, proposals, briefing materials, and other internal and external deliverables.
  • Utilize company-designated systems for project, partner, personnel, and information management.
  • Safeguard sensitive, confidential, and client-specific information.
  • Provide administrative and logistical support to Operations leadership and other company leaders as assigned.
  • Attend industry-related training events, conferences, seminars, and meetings as appropriate to maintain and develop professional knowledge and operational expertise.

SKILL SETS

  • Exceptional organizational and time-management skills with the ability to prioritize competing demands and meet deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Strong judgment, discretion, and commitment to the highest ethical and professional standards.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain effective professional relationships across clients, partners, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Strong analytical reasoning, research, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to synthesize information and develop clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Ability to operate effectively in dynamic, fast-paced environments and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Demonstrated initiative and a proactive, solutions-oriented approach to operational challenges.
  • Familiarity with Executive Protection operations, advance planning, secure transportation, protective staffing, and security logistics.
  • Ability to maintain situational awareness and exercise sound judgment during active operations.
  • Familiarity with security operations, risk mitigation, and applicable compliance requirements.
  • Ability to identify opportunities for process improvement and contribute to efficient, scalable operational practices.
  • Demonstrated professionalism and strong client-service orientation.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and appropriately handle sensitive client, personnel, and operational information.
  • Working knowledge of project management platforms preferred.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • Minimum of five years of relevant experience in Executive Protection, protective operations, corporate security, law enforcement, military operations, security operations, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting protective operations, advance work, secure transportation, protective staffing, or security logistics.
  • Experience coordinating personnel, partners, vendors, or operational resources.
  • Experience in a client-facing security or protective services environment is highly preferred.
  • Experience with security licensing, credentialing, regulatory compliance, or operational recordkeeping is preferred.

Additional Responsibilities 10%

  • Preferred: Masters in STEM (Science, Technical, Engineering, Math) or related scientific areas
