Who We Are

At Yuno, we are building the payment infrastructure that allows all companies to participate in the global market. Founded by veterans from payments and technology, including people who previously built Rappi, Yuno connects companies like InDrive, McDonald's, Rappi and Viva Aerobus with 300+ payment methods worldwide via a single API. We use AI and modern technology for intelligent transaction routing and fraud prevention across more than 80 countries.

About The Role

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer (mid level, 5 to 8 years of experience) based in Europe to build and scale the infrastructure that takes machine learning models from notebook to production. You will own the MLOps foundation, automate the model lifecycle, integrate streaming data pipelines and bring agentic capabilities into our ML systems. This is a hands on role for someone who cares as much about reliability and observability as about model performance. You will join the Data, AI and ML team and work closely with data science, platform and product teams.

Your Contribution Will Be

  • MLOps framework: design, build and maintain the MLOps platform (experiment tracking, model registry, versioning and reproducible training pipelines); establish CI/CD practices for ML with automated testing, validation gates and promotion workflows from dev to production; define standards and tooling for feature stores, model artifacts and environment reproducibility across teams.
  • ML productionizing: take models from research or prototype stage to robust, scalable production services; build low latency, high availability serving infrastructure (batch, online and real time inference); implement monitoring for model performance, data drift and concept drift, with clear alerting and rollback paths; partner with data science teams to harden models for production constraints (latency, cost, scale).
  • Automation of ML models: automate retraining, evaluation and deployment pipelines to reduce manual intervention; build self healing and auto rollback mechanisms triggered by performance or drift thresholds; create tooling that lets ML practitioners ship models without needing deep infra expertise.
  • Streaming integration: integrate ML models with streaming data platforms (Kafka, Kinesis, Flink) for real time feature computation and inference; design low latency feature pipelines that bridge batch and streaming data sources; ensure consistency between offline (training) and online (serving) feature computation.
  • Agentic integration for ML: design and integrate agentic workflows (LLM based agents, tool calling pipelines) alongside traditional ML models; build the observability, guardrails and evaluation frameworks needed to run agentic systems reliably in production; explore how agents can automate parts of the ML lifecycle itself (monitoring, triage, retraining decisions).

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals; comfortable owning services end to end.

Where You will Work:

Remote role open to candidates residing in Washington (WA) or Oregon (OR). (Branches).

When You'll Be Working:

Monday to Friday: 8:00am - 5:00pm.

Pay Range:

  • The target hourly pay range for this position is $104,632 to 118,900. The full hourly pay range is $95,120 to $142,680.
  • Compensation decisions are determined using factors such as relevant job-related skills, experience, and education or training. Should an offer of employment be made, we will consider individual qualifications. In addition to your salary, compensation incentives are available for the hired applicant. Incentives are performance based and targets vary by role.

What You’ll Do:

  • Leads the credit union’s Fraud Investigators and ensures that alerts and cases are being handled in a timely manner.
  • Leads the credit union’s Fraud and Dispute Specialists and ensures compliance with card network rules (e.g., Visa, MasterCard) and regulatory requirements (e.g., Reg E, the Electronic Fund Transfer Act).
  • Assists direct reports with complex transactions and escalated member service issues. Resolves or makes decisions related to the service and operational functions.
  • Stays up to date with emerging fraud trends, including but not limited to online fraud, phishing schemes, and identity theft; works within the credit union’s governance framework to develop strategies to protect the credit union and its members.
  • Reports on fraud and card claim losses, trends, and results of mitigation strategies to the Compliance/BSA Officer and prepares recommendations aimed at controlling and reducing fraud loss to the credit union.
  • Ensures the credit union’s fraud management practices comply with federal, state, and industry regulations, including card network regulations and consumer protection laws.
  • Collaborates with Employee Development to ensure fraud training remains current and aligns with the latest trends and best practices.
  • Communicates with staff across the organization through interactive training designed to promote and encourage employees to identify, prevent, and report attempted fraud.
  • Investigates and prepares responses to inquiries from regulatory agencies, the credit union’s internal audit department and outside auditors/consultants.
  • Collaborates with business units and product owners to assess fraud risks and implement mitigation strategies appropriate to the organization’s risk tolerance.
  • Collaborates with law enforcement and external vendors to resolve fraud cases and recover losses.
  • Assists in the preparation and coordination of audits, examinations, and regulatory reviews.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School.
  • A minimum of five (5) years' experience in BSA/AML, privacy, identity theft prevention, OFAC and a minimum of three (3) years in a supervisory role including experience maintaining strategic direction at a department level. 
  • Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) and Bank Secrecy Act Compliance Specialist (BSACS) or comparable certifications.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's.
  • Experience in fraud prevention and detection in a financial institution preferred.
  • Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) and Certified AML and Fraud Professional (CAFP).

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • In-depth understanding of fraud types and fraud prevention strategies, including emerging fraud trends (e.g., online fraud, phishing schemes, identity theft).
  • Knowledge of card fraud types, particularly in the context of Visa, MasterCard, and other card networks, and familiarity with chargeback processes and card dispute resolutions.
  • Strong knowledge of federal, state, and industry regulations, including Reg E (Electronic Fund Transfer Act), consumer protection laws, and card network rules (e.g., Visa, MasterCard, etc.).
  • Understanding of the governance framework within the credit union and how to ensure compliance with laws and regulations affecting fraud management.
  • Familiarity with fraud investigation techniques, including how to analyze financial transactions, identify suspicious patterns, and recover losses.
  • Knowledge of assessing and managing fraud risks within a financial institution, and how to implement mitigation strategies according to the organization’s risk tolerance.
  • Strong analytical skills to assess fraud-related data, identify suspicious activity, and evaluate the effectiveness of fraud mitigation strategies.
  • Ability to analyze fraud and card claim loss trends and make recommendations for improving fraud prevention strategies.
  • Skilled in resolving escalated member service issues related to fraud and fraud claims, using sound judgment and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to make critical decisions quickly and effectively regarding fraud resolution and mitigating potential losses.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to convey complex fraud-related issues to internal and external stakeholders, including regulatory agencies, auditors, and law enforcement.
  • Ability to foster an environment of continuous learning, providing coaching and feedback to ensure team members are well-trained and compliant with current regulations.
  • Ability to stay up to date with emerging fraud trends, fraud detection technologies, and changes in laws and regulations.
  • Ability to continually assess, refine, and improve fraud management strategies to ensure the credit union’s resilience against evolving fraud risks.

Total Rewards:

This position is eligible for Full-Time Regular benefits. Employees and their eligible family members have access to a wide array of employee benefits, such as medical, dental, vision and life insurance coverage.

  • Includes an option for Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance to be paid at a 100% by company for the employee only coverage.
  • We also offer Health Care FSA (HCFSA), Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions, and Dependent Care FSA (DCFSA).
  • Employees also have access to Life and AD&D insurance.
  • Employees are able to enroll in our 401k plan.
  • Full-Time Regular employees accrue 8 hours of vacation and 8 hours of sick leave, on a monthly basis.
  • Full-Time Regular hired employees also receive 11 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 1 floating holiday, 16 hours of self-care time, and 16 hours of volunteer time.

All benefits except 401k start the first of the month following date of hire. Employees become eligible to contribute to 401k on the first of the month following 60 days of employment.

jobs.title: Financial Planning + Analysis (FP&A) Manager
jobs.excerpt: The OrganizationWhat if K-12 education were designed to help all students develop lives of meaning and purpose?
jobs.description:
The Organization

What if K-12 education were designed to help all students develop lives of meaning and purpose? Wayfinder, a division of Lemnis, was founded at the Stanford d.school to answer this question. Our goal is to double our impact each year for the coming years. Our vision is to become the preeminent future-readiness curriculum company in the world — leading the global movement of purpose, meaning, and belonging-based education worldwide.

Wayfinder joined the Lemnis Collective as a nonprofit division in 2026. As a public charity, Lemnis is dedicated to the concept of the unlimited learner. Their mission is to create more accessible, flexible, learner-centered systems that help young people navigate the challenges and opportunities of the future. Wayfinder and Lemnis share that vision, especially when it comes to supporting learners in underserved communities and the institutions that serve them.

Wayfinder is the third organization to join the Lemnis Collective. The Collective brings mission-aligned organizations (both for-profit assets and nonprofits with earned revenue) under the Lemnis umbrella through mergers and acquisitions. Lemnis provides long-term, mission-driven investment, stability, freedom from the pressure of constant fundraising, and operational and strategic support, so organizations like Wayfinder can stay focused on our mission, impact, growth, and innovation.

What We Value

You’ll be joining a team of incredibly motivated and dedicated staff members committed to living our organization's values. We work collaboratively across teams, and we feel and act like a purpose-driven organization. To the best of our abilities, each person’s role aligns with their own sense of purpose, which feeds into Wayfinder’s larger sense of purpose.

Read this article about our workplace culture in Conscious Company.

We value equal access, inclusive community, and belonging, and these values are represented in our product, our team, and our school partners.

Product: We develop our learning tools using human-centered design principles. We work with grade-level experts to ensure our curriculum is developmentally appropriate and engaging at all levels. Every Wayfinder lesson is supported by relevant research, prototyped in classrooms, and vetted by teachers over rounds of feedback and iteration. We use Universal Design for Learning principles to give every student an equal opportunity to succeed.

Team: Our team is composed of people from all different backgrounds and walks of life. We intentionally recruit, hire, and work with people of all identities + experiences. We focus on belonging: being connected, accepted, and valued by the people around us.

School Partners: We intentionally target a wide array of educational partners, from traditional to non-traditional, that work with a range of students from different socioeconomic groups. We’ve taught our curriculum in high-need schools in the Bronx, independent schools in Silicon Valley, and after-school programs in San Antonio.

The Role

Wayfinder is looking for a Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Manager. This person will be responsible for leading the planning, forecasting, and analysis functions that support strategic decision-making across the business. This role plays a critical part in translating financial data into actionable insights to drive performance and growth.

Our ideal candidate has experience managing end-to-end financial analysis and forecasting in the startup space, working cross-functionally, and has the ability to translate financial findings to both internal and external stakeholders. This person is detail-oriented, a strong communicator, and advanced in their technical and financial skills. Experience in the tech space, and with SaaS based subscription models preferred.

The FP&A Manager will report to the SVP Strategy, Finance & Operations, Wayfinder Division.

We strongly encourage people from traditionally underrepresented populations in tech - such as women, People of Color, People with Disabilities, and LGBTQ+ people, etc - to apply!

Responsibilities

This person will own the financial function at Wayfinder. Key responsibilities of a Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Manager at Wayfinder include:

  • Leading the budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning processes

  • Providing insightful financial analysis to support commercial and strategic initiatives

  • Managing the preparation of management reports and performance dashboards

  • Partnering across departments to identify trends, risks, and opportunities

  • Developing and maintaining complex financial models and scenario analyses

  • Driving process improvements in planning and reporting functions

  • Presenting financial insights to senior leadership and key stakeholders

  • Ensuring alignment between financial outcomes and business objectives

  • Supporting investment analysis, business cases, and capital planning

  • Ensuring compliance with internal financial governance and corporate policies

  • Monitoring financial performance against KPIs and communicating variance drivers

  • Collaborating with accounting, tax, and revenue teams to ensure data integrity and alignment

Requirements

A degree in finance, accounting, economics, or equivalent professional experience is required. Significant experience in financial planning and analysis within the tech space, focused on SaaS models, is essential.

Key skills and attributes for success in this role include:

  • Five to eight years of proven experience in FP&A, financial modeling, and business analysis

  • Strong command of budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting

  • Advanced Google Sheet/Excel skills

  • Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) is highly regarded

  • Experience with ERP systems and FP&A software

  • Ability to interpret complex financial data and translate it into actionable insights

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present to senior leadership

  • High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy

  • Proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and efficiency

  • Independent, self-starter who takes ownership without waiting to be told

Benefits

    We offer a competitive package that is based on location and experience. We also offer the following benefits:

  • + 403b: We care about your ability to save for your future.

  • + Family Focus: Parental leave and flexibility for families.

  • + Time Off: Unlimited PTO policy to encourage people to get out and see the world.

  • + Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision policies + a monthly wellness stipend.

  • + Goodies: Whatever hardware and software you need to get the job done.

  • + Team Fun: Regularly scheduled events, annual retreat, and celebrations.

  • + Learning: Learning & Development Opportunities to grow your skills and career.

  • + Great team: Working with fun, hard-working, kind people committed to making a difference!

  • + Flexible culture: We are results-focused and entirely remote.

  • + And much more! Lots of other perks make this company an incredible place to work.

Location

Remote work.

Wayfinders’ regular operating hours are Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. The daily work schedule may vary depending on the crew in which you are working.


Next Steps, If Interested

If you are interested, please fill out the job application here.

Applications will close at 5PM PST on September 25, 2026.

EEO Statement

At Wayfinder, we don’t just accept differences — we celebrate them, we support them, and we thrive on them for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community. Wayfinder is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Pay Transparency

Wayfinder compensation is based on various factors including but not limited to job location, a candidate's education, training, experience, expected quality and quantity of work, required travel (if any), external market and internal value analysis including seniority and merit systems, as well as internal pay alignment. Annual salary is just one component of Wayfinder’s total compensation package. Additionally, Wayfinder provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, a monthly stipend, office buildout stipend, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and paid time off. Compensation ranges may differ based on contract value but will be commensurate with job duties and relevant work experience. An applicant's salary history will not be used in determining compensation.

Reasonable Accommodations

Wayfinder is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, contact HR at .

Additional Notice

jobs.title: Solutions Integration Engineer III
jobs.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Solutions Integration Engineer at Samsara, you will be an integral member of the Professional Services Organisation responsible for helping Samsara’s most strategic customers build and implement B2B integrations with our IoT platform. In a given week, you may work with a large long-haul trucking company, an industrial-scale food producer, and a public utility to map a customer’s integration needs to current and future API capabilities, help building custom integrations, provide guidance and technical training to implementation teams to follow best practices, troubleshoot issues and advocate for fixes on behalf of customers (working with our tech support team), and ensure a successful customer relationship. A successful Solutions Integration Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of B2B integrations to ensure the proper technical solution is delivered to our customers.

Your role will be cross-functional, working alongside and connecting product managers, business operations, sales, and systems engineers, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within. Since Samsara is a fast-growing company with emerging IoT technology, you can expect this role to evolve, with opportunities to take on increasing levels of responsibility and impact our growth.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead system integration projects with customer development teams, Samsara’s partners, 3rd-party systems integrators or build your own enterprise-grade scalable solutions using various Samsara’s Web integration technologies (APIs, Webhooks, Connectors, and more.)
  • Design/develop/define complex project scopes, technical specifications and business requirements between Samsara and multiple stakeholders - from design through delivery and beyond
  • Plans complex projects that involve a variety of people, dependencies, uncertainty, risk and impact. Comfortable making delivery commitments for larger projects
  • Accounts for maintainability, portability, scalability, and reliability in technical designs and knows when to trade them for speed of delivery
  • Build robust and scalable integration architecture to help solve use cases like Real-time Data Streaming, Event subscriptions, Batch processing, etc.
  • Build, test, validate, and review code to ensure completeness and highest quality deliverables
  • Advise and document best practices around integrations using Samara APIs and products
  • Test, validate and review code to ensure completeness and highest quality deliverables
  • Leads by example: conducts thorough code reviews and provides feedback that is actionable and insightful
  • Exchange best practices, share knowledge with the Samsara product team, developer community, and advocate for customer experience
  • Collaborate with the Samsara’s Developer EcoSystem team closely to improve our API experience and featureset
  • Contribute to the enhancement of Professional Services methodologies and tools
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience designing and developing Integration solutions using proven architecture methodologies
  • Experience in gathering data integration requirements and translating into good technical data designs
  • Can write, read, and understand code in Python and any one additional programming language (for example, JavaScript, AppScript)
  • Proficient in leveraging LLM-based tools for code generation, prompt engineering, automation, and enhancing developer productivity
  • Experience with agentic workflows, including the design, orchestration, and deployment of multi-agent systems for enterprise use cases
  • 3+ years hands-on experience in developing solutions leveraging any of the modern Cloud Services (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Hands-on experience in building or working with RESTful APIs/Webhooks and modern databases
  • Knowledge of PowerBI/Tableau, SQL, and data visualization concepts is a huge plus
  • Hands-on experience with customer evaluations and deployments, with the ability to juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel
  • Proven ability to effectively manage complex projects with a wide range of stakeholders including C-Level executives
  • Strong written communication and presentation skills, demonstrated ability to work with a diverse set of teams
  • Proficient in using GitHub for version control and collaboration
  • Experience working with Modern Agile tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence)

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline
  • Minimum 3+ years customer facing experience building and supporting Enterprise-scale integrations or API scripting
  • Consistent track record of configuring and deploying complex technical solutions
  • Familiarity with B2B system integration projects and workflows
  • Bias-to-action and hands-on experience delivering business results
  • Tinkering with hardware gadgets, sensors, or vehicles is a plus
  • Familiarity with fleets and logistics is a plus
  • Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems is a plus

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$87,465—$117,600 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: STRIDES Technical Advisor, Outbreak Response
jobs.excerpt: Job Summary The STRIDES Outbreak Response Technical Advisor provides overall leadership, coordination, and operational oversight for STRIDES-supported outbreak preparedness, response, recovery, and transition activities associated with an ongoing outbreak of Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The STRIDES Outbreak Response Technical Advisor provides overall leadership, coordination, and operational oversight for STRIDES-supported outbreak preparedness, response, recovery, and transition activities associated with an ongoing outbreak of Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). This role serves as the central focal point for STRIDES BVD coordination and incident management, ensuring timely implementation of response strategies aligned with national response plans, global gold standards, donor requirements, and organizational emergency management procedures. The Ebola Response Advisor will work closely with project teams, including the Headquarter (HQ) team and country offices teams, to oversee STRIDES technical and operational support, ensuring that STRIDES-supported interventions effectively reduce transmission, morbidity, and mortality associated with Ebola disease.

Accountabilities

Technical Requirements:

  • Lead and manage all aspects of STRIDES Ebola outbreak preparedness and response activities.

  • Activate, coordinate, and oversee Incident Management System (IMS) structures and emergency operations functions.

  • Serve as the primary technical and operational focal point for STRIDES Ebola response implementation.

  • Provide strategic leadership and guidance to response teams, government counterparts, and implementing partners.

  • Facilitate daily incident management meetings, situation reviews, and operational planning sessions.

  • Ensure alignment of response activities with national and international Ebola response protocols and guidelines.

  • Coordinate surge staffing, deployment planning, and cross-functional response activities.

  • Monitor epidemiological trends and use data to guide operational decision-making.

  • Review surveillance reports and provide recommendations for response adjustments.

  • Provides project staff with overall technical direction and guidance in line with the project expected outcomes.

  • Supports technical aspects of projects including staff and partner capacity building.

  • Monitors and maintains project protocols, instruments, data sets, manuals, training materials and reports related to technical area of expertise.

  • Works closely with the team to ensure project implementation remains technically sound and adheres to company strategy and standard operating procedures (SOP’s).

  • Develops or writes technical briefs, reports, or other necessary materials to facilitate research, best practices, policies, and procedures.

  • Conducts analysis of project implementation to identify areas for improvement and propose appropriate technical strategy and guidelines.

  • Provides mentorship and team building at the task level.

  • Support transition planning from emergency response to recovery and resilience-building activities.

  • Provides technical support in the development and dissemination of tools, materials, reports, papers, and intervention for research projects.

  • Provides technical input on subject matter best practices to outbreak response

  • Develops and monitors technical work plans and budgets.

  • Participate in client / funder meetings and draft reports / presentations.

Project Design Implementation:

  • Produce situation reports, technical updates, donor reports, and executive briefings.

  • Analyze operational and epidemiological data to inform strategic decision making.

  • Maintain accurate incident documentation and record management.

  • Lead preparation of lessons learned reports and after-action reviews.

  • Monitors project deliverables and reports to supervisors.

  • Leads technical project activities and sub activities and assists with project implementation.

  • May implement components of the technical portions of the project plan.

  • Identifies and raises issues to senior technical staff.

  • Functions as the technical lead with oversight of project technical administrative and finance compliance, technical deliverables, and team management, (includes projects and consultants).

Business Development and Client/Funder Support:

  • Successfully contributes to new business development initiatives including project design, budgeting, and recruitment efforts, specific to outbreak preparedness and response.

  • Provides final authorization and approval of the technical portions of proposals and project design, based on the design and direction set by technical leadership.

  • Builds productive working relationships internally and externally.

  • Draft proposals, budgets, and work plans.

  • Participate in business development meetings with partners and clients. Partner/Sub-Award Management:

  • May be daily POC (Point of Contact) with clients for some projects on technical matters.

Operations Management (Finance, HR, etc.):

  • Develop and manage Ebola response work plans, operational objectives, and performance indicators.

  • Monitor program budgets, expenditures, and resource utilization.

  • Coordinate procurement and deployment of outbreak response commodities and equipment.

  • Ensure availability and appropriate use of personal protective equipment (PPE), laboratory supplies, and emergency response materials.

jobs.description:
Title: Senior Account Manager – Technical Lead

Location: Remote

Reports to: 3(16) Administration Manager

FLSA Status:Exempt

Job Summary:

The Senior Account Manager – Technical Lead maintains client relationships and independently manages assigned accounts under supervision. This role performs compliance testing, calculates contributions, prepares Form 5500 filings, and works with auditors to support accurate, timely, and compliant plan administration.

Technical Leadership and Team Support

  • Serves as a subject matter expert and technical resource for complex plan administration, compliance, testing, correction, and client service matters.
  • Provides guidance, support, and mentoring to team members, helping strengthen knowledge-sharing and consistent service delivery.

Client Service and Collaboration

The position requires excellent communication skills, a strong understanding of customer service, and the ability to work effectively with clients, auditors, advisors, and internal team members. The role also requires a high level of confidentiality and sound judgment when handling sensitive client and plan information.

Experience Expectations

This position is intended for experienced account managers who have mastered the role and are willing and able to mentor others and serve as a significant team resource.

Responsibilities:

Plan Administration, Compliance, and Technical Expertise

  • Interpret plan documents and identify opportunities to improve plan administration, communication, and service delivery for clients and partners.
  • Apply extensive knowledge of ERISA, IRS, and DOL regulations for qualified plans, including 403(b) plans; remain current on industry changes and communicate relevant updates to clients and team members.
  • Analyze census data to determine eligibility and work with clients and payroll teams to confirm eligibility for each entry date.
  • Calculate employer contributions based on plan provisions and confirm annual funding amounts with clients when requested.
  • Perform plan redesign and projection testing to support client planning and compliance needs.

Testing, Corrections, and Year-End Deliverables

  • Perform annual nondiscrimination testing, including ADP/ACP, 415, 402(g), 416, and 410(b), and explain testing results to clients.
  • Apply advanced testing and correction techniques, including self-correction, VCP, DFVCP, and other appropriate correction methods.
  • Determine and calculate plan corrections needed to maintain compliance, and work with clients to ensure corrections are properly completed.
  • Identify missed deferral opportunities and coordinate with clients to complete required corrections.
  • Review the timeliness of employee deferral remittances, notify employers of late deposits, outline applicable corrections, confirm deposits are made, and report corrections on Form 5500 as required.
  • Conduct annual year-end cleanup, including follow-up on forfeiture reallocations and source transfers identified during compliance review.
  • Identify required minimum distribution needs and ensure communications are sent to eligible participants.
  • Post year-end client deliverables to Salesforce.

Government Filings, Audits, and Plan Documents

  • Prepare government filings, including Form 5500 and related schedules, Forms 5558, 5330, and 8955, and discuss filings with clients as needed.
  • Prepare filings for complex circumstances, such as short-form to long-form transitions, first-year filings, plan termination filings, and 403(b) pre-2009 carve-outs.
  • Work directly with the plan’s Form 5500 auditor, including discussing corrections, resolving plan issues, and supporting audit-related requests.
  • Submit amendment requests to Legal; update Relius specifications and platform specifications; obtain signatures; and follow up with clients through completion.

Team Leadership and Process Improvement

  • Serve as a technical lead by providing subject matter expertise, guidance, and support to team members on complex plan administration, compliance, testing, correction, and client service matters.
  • Work with administrators to ensure deadlines are met in a timely manner.
  • Mentor and train new account managers.
  • Participate in special projects that improve processes, consistency, and service delivery.
  • Present and teach technical concepts in internal team meetings.

Client Service and Relationship Management

  • Deliver timely, high-quality customer service and issue resolution to clients and advisors.
  • Maintain strong client relationships and support a high client-retention rate.
  • Attend client and advisor calls and meetings; lead meetings and present information professionally when appropriate.
  • Support onboarding by participating in client document calls and assisting the client transition team in obtaining prior-year or prior-platform information.
  • Work with clients to complete plan termination activities when needed.
  • Manage more complex, sensitive, or high-priority client relationships as assigned.

Requirements: (including specific education requirements)

  • College degree and 8+ years of retirement experience
  • Minimum of 8years in account manager or similar role in retirement administration
  • QKA designation required
  • Mastery of administrator functions and skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Knowledge of Excel and other Microsoft applications/software
  • Excellent math skills
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability and willingness to provide a high level of service to clients
  • Experience with Relius required
  • Experience with Salesforce strongly desired
  • Experience with FT Williams required

jobs.excerpt: The RoleAlkira is transforming networking through its Network Infrastructure as a Service (NIaaS) platform, enabling enterprises to build and operate global cloud networks with simplicity, scale, and agility.
jobs.description:
The Role

Alkira is transforming networking through its Network Infrastructure as a Service (NIaaS) platform, enabling enterprises to build and operate global cloud networks with simplicity, scale, and agility. We are seeking a Senior Platform Infrastructure Software Engineer to own the foundational layer every other engineering team at Alkira depends on, including Platform Services.

Platform Infrastructure does not own customer-facing features. We build the primitives other engineering teams need in order to work at all: the global Kubernetes cluster footprint, the internal cluster running our CI/CD runners and build platforms, the shared infrastructure teams consume (databases, object storage, container registries), and the lifecycle of the shared services everything else is built on. We also build the Terraform modules other teams use to ship their own infrastructure quickly and safely.

Our customers are engineers, and the output is code, Terraform configuration/modules, Go and Python tooling, cluster and service automation. You will own complex projects, drive architectural decisions, and set the standards other engineers work within.

Responsibilities

  • Own the global Kubernetes cluster footprint across regions and cloud providers: provisioning, upgrades, multi-tenancy, resource and network policy, and failure isolation.
  • Own the internal cluster running CI/CD runners and build platforms: capacity, isolation, scaling, and the build performance every team feels daily.
  • Own the shared infrastructure other teams consume - managed databases, object storage buckets, container registries, and build platforms including provisioning paths, access model, and cost.
  • Own the full lifecycle of shared platform services such as internal PKI, vaults, Kubernetes operators.
  • Own disaster recovery for the platform: backup and restore, replication and failover design, documented RTO and RPO targets, and regular DR exercises that prove recovery works.
  • Design and publish reusable Terraform/OpenTofu modules that let other teams deliver their own infrastructure faster, with correctness and policy built in rather than reviewed in. Treat adoption by other teams as the measure of whether a module succeeded.
  • Own the observability stack and set the standard other teams instrument against.
  • Build production tooling in Go or Python. A significant share of this role is software engineering, not configuration
  • Mentor engineers through code review, design review, and technical guidance
  • Drive down cost and eliminate drift: orphaned resources, stale state, pipelines outliving the services they built.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation for the Platform Infrastructure

MinimumQualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in infrastructure, platform, DevOps, or SRE engineering, including production ownership.
  • Deep production Kubernetes experience operating clusters, not only deploying to them.
  • Strong Terraform or OpenTofu experience at scale: module design intended for other teams to consume, state management, and policy-as-code.
  • Strong programming ability in Go, Python, or a comparable language.
  • Experience running stateful shared services/infrastructure in production (message broker, databases, certificate authority, etc...) or comparable.
  • Deep Linux fundamentals: process and resource behavior, and system-level debugging under load.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, load balancing, and service-to-service communication.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider and the ability to work across others.
  • Sound judgment about blast radius, and the discipline to make risky changes reversible.
  • Strong technical judgment, problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience on an internal platform or developer platform team, where the users were other engineers.
  • Experience with Scalr or other IaC platforms, including policy-as-code with OPA
  • GitOps with ArgoCD or Flux; Helm, Kustomize, or operator development.
  • Managing self-hosted CI runners
  • Deep understanding of Prometheus/Thanos or equivalent, including writing exporters and instrumentation standards.
  • Experience with observability platforms, telemetry systems, logging, distributed tracing, and monitoring architectures.
  • Experience building highly available, multi-tenant SaaS platforms operating at significant scale.
  • Proven ability to influence engineering strategy across organizations and mentor technical talent.
  • Carrying production on-call for what you built.

About Alkira

Alkira, a Lumen company, is building the future of enterprise networking: one programmable platform to connect, secure, and operate every cloud, site, partner, data center, and AI workload. Founded by Amir and Atif Khan, the creators of Viptela and pioneers of the SD-WAN market, Alkira was built to radically simplify how enterprises deploy and manage network infrastructure. Today, as part of Lumen, we are bringing that cloud-native operating model to a global network foundation trusted by the world’s largest enterprises.

Our platform helps customers move faster without managing hardware, stitching together providers, or operating fragmented cloud networks. Teams can build and scale connectivity on demand, apply consistent security and segmentation, and gain visibility across distributed environments from one place.

At Alkira, you’ll help shape the next chapter of networking: cloud-like consumption, private-network performance, and total control across the enterprise. We move fast, solve hard problems, and build technology that changes how global businesses connect.

Join us and help build the future of networking.

This client-facing role supports multiple client engagements by preparing individual and business tax returns, assisting with tax planning and research, responding to day-to-day tax matters, and participating in client meetings.

The Staff Tax Accountant works closely with clients and internal team members to provide accurate, timely, and responsive service while continuing to build technical tax knowledge and client advisory skills.

While tax season brings periods of increased workload, this role offers a more balanced alternative to the traditional public accounting environment, with an emphasis on sustainable workloads and work-life balance throughout the year.

Essential Functions

As a BELAY Corporate Team member, you will professionally represent the company in all virtual and in-person interactions. You are expected to exemplify our mission, vision, and core values while fostering a collaborative and positive team environment.

Tax Preparation & Compliance

  • Calculate tax extensions and quarterly estimated tax payments accurately and efficiently
  • Conduct tax research to support client needs and tax positions
  • Assist with tax planning projects and identify potential tax-saving opportunities
  • Assist with responses to notices and correspondence from the IRS and state taxing authorities

Client Service & Communication

  • Participate in client meetings and assist with day-to-day tax questions and requests
  • Communicate clearly and proactively with clients and internal team members

  • Escalate complex tax matters or client concerns to appropriate team members as needed

Workflow & Process Management

  • Manage multiple client assignments while meeting established deadlines and quality expectations
  • Maintain accurate time tracking, workflow updates, and documentation within firm systems
  • Communicate proactively regarding deadlines, questions, or potential issues
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflow efficiency and internal processes
  • Collaborate with team members to ensure accurate and timely completion of client work

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 1–2 years of accounting and tax preparation experience
  • Experience preparing individual and business tax returns
  • Foundational knowledge of federal and state tax laws and accounting principles
  • Experience working with financial statements and general accounting concepts
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet established deadlines
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, tax preparation software, and workflow or time-tracking tools

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a public accounting, outsourced accounting, or client-service environment

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication
  • Client service and relationship-building skills
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and competing deadlines
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a remote team
  • Proficiency with accounting, tax preparation, spreadsheet, and workflow management technology

Working Conditions

Occasional travel or flexibility outside standard business hours may be required based on the role.

Responsibilities include ensuring understanding of the reimbursement process particularly in Retail Pharmacy, field reimbursement services, and payer landscape. The Virtual ARM will abide in a compliant manner and will work closely within a defined set Rules of Engagement (ROE). As permitted under the approved program design and ROE, the ARM may support patient-level access and reimbursement issue resolution and may access PHI only as authorized and required to perform the role.

In this role, the Virtual ARM will demonstrate a compliant and consultative approach to help offices obtain insurance authorization and/or reimbursement of products for appropriate patients. The Virtual ARM will have a direct impact on providing a positive experience for both the HCP Customer and Patient.

Additional responsibilities include:

Communicate relevant changes and field insights to appropriate internal stakeholders in a timely and compliant manner. Provide office education and awareness during the entire access process which may include formulary coverage/utilization management criteria, coding, insurance forms & procedures, benefits investigation, prior authorization, appeal, and/or claims resolution.

Sobre a BigDataCorp

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

Sobre a área e a vaga

Customer Success: O time de Customer Success é, como o nome indica, responsável por garantir a satisfação e sucesso dos clientes em sua jornada de uso dos produtos da BigDataCorp. Isso inclui apoiá-los na integração das soluções, entender o negócio dos clientes para sugerir novas soluções ou melhorias nos processos, e ajudar nas interações entre os clientes e os times internos da empresa, construindo relacionamentos duradouros.

Sobre o Estágio na BigDataCorp

O Estágio na BigDataCorp tem como objetivo formar os futuros líderes e especialistas da empresa. Para isso, buscamos atrair e formar pessoas, desenvolvendo seu potencial e apoiando o seu crescimento dentro da organização. Para que isso aconteça, promovemos uma jornada completa de aprendizado: da teoria à experimentação prática, nossas pessoas estagiárias estão a todo momento absorvendo e compartilhando aprendizados e conhecimentos, entendendo, de fato, como a empresa funciona, seus objetivos e desafios reais. A pessoa escolhida trabalhará 4 horas por dia, totalizando a carga horária semanal de 20 horas, por um período de 12 a 24 meses. Como pessoa estagiária, você será conectada a um gestor e terá todo o suporte para o desenvolvimento da sua carreira. Aqui fornecemos todas as ferramentas necessárias para que você se sinta apoiado e se desenvolva em um ambiente real. Além de trabalhar em um projeto que fará diferença para nosso negócio, você terá a oportunidade de se envolver com os Biggers, potencializando seu desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, e expandindo sua rede de contatos.

O que vai fazer no dia a dia:

  • Acompanhar a jornada do cliente desde o onboarding e primeiros passos na plataforma;
  • Entender o objetivo, contexto e caso de uso de cada cliente;
  • Apoiar o cliente na utilização das soluções, orientando sobre funcionalidades e possibilidades aderentes às suas necessidades;
  • Acompanhar integração, utilização e evolução do cliente ao longo da jornada;
  • Realizar follow-ups e manter os registros e etapas atualizados no CRM;
  • Identificar dificuldades, dúvidas, baixa utilização ou oportunidades de maior aproveitamento da plataforma;
  • Apoiar na identificação de novos casos de uso e oportunidades de expansão dentro da base;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com os demais integrantes de CS e Comercial para garantir uma experiência próxima, ágil e orientada à geração de valor;
  • Desenvolver continuamente conhecimento sobre produtos, dados, soluções e possibilidades de aplicação da BigDataCorp.

Requirements

Habilidades necessárias:

  • Estar cursando ensino superior em Administração, Marketing, Comunicação Social, Economia, Ciências Contábeis, Relações Internacionais, Relações Públicas, Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Civil ou áreas correlatas;
  • Previsão de formação entre dez/2027 e out/2028;
  • Disponibilidade para estagiar 4 horas diárias de segunda a sexta-feira;
  • Facilidade e interesse em comunicação com diferentes públicos;
  • Capacidade de elaborar textos claros e objetivos;
  • Afinidade e interesse por tecnologia, soluções digitais, experiência do cliente e dados;
  • Curiosidade e facilidade para aprender novas ferramentas e produtos;
  • Capacidade analítica para compreender necessidades e casos de uso dos clientes;
  • Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de atividades e carteira;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como CRM, Excel/Google Sheets e plataformas digitais será considerada um diferencial.

Benefits

  • Escritório em RJ e SP com ambiente de trabalho descontraído (para quem quiser utilizar)

Nymbus ( isn’t just a leader in fintech; we’re a community of innovators passionate about reimagining banking. Our award-winning modern core platform and cloud-based technology serve as the backbone for financial institutions eager to modernize and excel.

We operate with an AI-first mindset across our business, continuously improving how we work and the value we deliver to our clients. Our culture is grounded in collaboration, accountability, and a strong commitment to execution.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Nymbus is a remote-first company. You will need to be able to travel a few times a year. You may be required at times to visit client sites or attend meetings at designated locations with team members. Working hours primarily align with the Eastern Time Zone; candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones are preferred.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Sr. Manager, Growth Marketing owns one primary outcome: net new member and customer growth for Nymbus Labs launch brands. This is the senior strategic lead responsible for bringing new financial brands to market across the full acquisition funnel, from building brand awareness where none exists, through driving consideration and intent, to converting prospects into members and customers at scale. This role owns the pre-launch and launch customer journey; at the moment a prospect converts, the baton passes to the Lifecycle team. This is a player-coach role.

You architect a go-to-market strategy and build demand from scratch, standing up brand awareness, creating consideration, and driving conversion in markets where the brand has no existing equity and finding new growth for existing brands on their journey to grow deeper awareness and resonance in the markets they're serving. You own the full acquisition strategy for paid, owned and earned, including but not limited to: upper-funnel brand campaigns through lower-funnel direct response, execute with hands-on precision, and apply performance marketing rigor at every stage: CAC/ROAS/LTV analysis, structured optimization, and measurement infrastructure that connects the full funnel to business outcomes. You are equally fluent in B2C and B2B, operate with high autonomy, advise clients at the executive level, and use AI as a core part of how you work.

OBJECTIVES OF THE ROLE

  • Drive net new member and customer growth for Nymbus Labs launch brands —this is the primary mandate.
  • Own full-funnel acquisition strategy: brand awareness, consideration, and conversion, from pre-launch through sustaining growth programs.
  • Serve as the strategic authority on GTM and acquisition investment across the funnel, advising clients at the executive level on channel sequencing, budget allocation, and performance.
  • Translate client business goals into measurable acquisition strategies with defined targets at every funnel stage, from share of voice to net new growth.
  • Develop proactive recommendations that anticipate client needs and identify growth opportunities before they're asked.
  • Navigate B2C and B2B acquisition contexts with equal fluency, adapting full-funnel strategy to each brand's audience and commercial model.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES:

Brand Awareness, Demand Generation & Pre-Launch Strategy

  • Build full-funnel demand strategies from zero — standing up brand awareness and share of voice, creating consideration, and generating conversion-ready intent in markets where the brand has no existing recognition or equity.
  • Develop brand awareness programs that establish credibility and prime audiences for direct response, with a clear point of view on when to invest in upper-funnel brand-building vs. when to shift into performance mode.
  • Develop pre-launch positioning, messaging frameworks, and audience segmentation strategies that differentiate the brand competitively across every funnel stage.
  • Define full-funnel KPIs, growth targets, and measurement architecture, from awareness and consideration metrics to cost-per-acquisition and net new member outcomes.

GTM Strategy & Go-to-Market Planning

  • Architect go-to-market acquisition strategies grounded in competitive positioning, full-funnel audience targeting, channel theory, and launch sequencing, with a clear, defensible point of view at every step.
  • Build launch plans that phase budget, channels, and creative across awareness, consideration, and conversion stages — with decision triggers for when to scale, optimize, or pivot.
  • Translate client business goals into actionable acquisition strategies with clear milestones, success metrics, and accountability structures across the full funnel.

Media Strategy, Implementation & Campaign Management

  • Own media strategy end to end across the full funnel: channel selection, budget allocation, audience targeting, and creative direction from upper-funnel brand campaigns through lower-funnel direct response landing page alignment, with strategic rationale behind every change.
  • Execute and manage campaigns hands-on, build structures, configure targeting and bidding, write briefs, manage creative trafficking, and oversee QA across paid search, paid social, programmatic, and affiliate.
  • Manage media budgets with precision, pacing, reallocation decisions, and scenario planning across brands and channels; hold agency and platform partners accountable to plan commitments and performance targets.

Performance Marketing, Analysis & Optimization

  • Run structured optimization cycles across all programs, bidding, targeting, creative, and landing page, with root-cause analysis that connects full-funnel performance to business outcomes.
  • Apply a performance marketing lens at every funnel stage: CAC, ROAS, LTV, and conversion rate tradeoffs inform decisions from brand awareness investment through direct response efficiency.
  • Govern campaign measurement infrastructure, UTM architecture, pixel/tag management, attribution, and analytics, and translate performance data into executive-ready insights that drive budget and strategy decisions.
  • Use AI tools actively across research, audience insights, creative testing, performance analysis, and optimization, as standard practice, not occasional use.

AI-Driven Innovation

  • Integrate AI tools actively into strategic planning and daily workflow: market research, audience insights, creative testing, performance analysis, and competitive intelligence.
  • Champion new platform capabilities and automation opportunities that create strategic advantage for clients.
  • Share learnings and continuously raise the bar for how the team uses AI to think faster, plan smarter, and deliver more.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 6+ years of experience in acquisition marketing, demand generation, or performance marketing with direct ownership of full-funnel strategy and significant media budgets.
  • Full-funnel expertise: you've built brand awareness for brands launching without equity, created consideration programs that move prospects through the funnel, and driven conversion at scale; you know how to sequence all three.
  • Performance marketing orientation: you think in CAC, ROAS, LTV, and conversion rate tradeoffs; you build programs to be measured, tested, and optimized from day one.
  • GTM strategy depth:you've architected launch plans with competitive positioning, full-funnel audience targeting, channel theory, and measurable net new acquisition outcomes.
  • Hands-on media fluency: paid search (Google, Bing), paid social (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok), and programmatic end to end; strategy through execution through optimization.
  • Strong analytical skills: GA4, Google Tag Manager, Looker/Data Studio, and platform-native analytics; able to govern measurement infrastructure across the full funnel.
  • AI-native operator who uses AI actively in planning, research, analysis, and reporting as standard practice.
  • Client-facing credibility: advising at the executive level, managing multiple brands simultaneously, and proactively bringing strategy rather than waiting to be asked.
  • Equally fluent in B2C and B2B: able to adapt full-funnel strategy, targeting, and channel approach across consumer and commercial audiences.
  • Highly autonomous: sets direction, identifies problems, and drives solutions without waiting for instruction.
  • Financial services or fintech experience is a plus.

The Principal Engineer – Electrical Studies & Modeling, will develop metrics and set objectives related to engineering obligations, and will be a key proponent in the development and implementation of design standards.

STEP INTO THE ROLE

  • Responsible for safe utility scale designs that compliment company, state, and federal safety regulations. Perpetuates designs compliant with applicable electrical codes, standards, and company best practices (NEC, NESC, IEE, NERC, IEC).

Will collaborate across multiple company departments, vendors, and outside firms to explore innovative ideas, methods, materials, equipment, software, and technologies that promote safety, lower cost, increase efficiencies and provide strategic benefits.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Field Evaluation Engineer to join our Field Evaluation team. In this role, you will independently lead complex field evaluation projects, assess electrical equipment for compliance with applicable codes and standards, and provide technical guidance to customers, regulatory authorities, and internal stakeholders.

The ideal candidate combines strong engineering expertise with practical field experience, exceptional customer engagement skills, and a deep understanding of electrical safety requirements, product compliance, and regulatory standards. This position requires frequent travel to customer sites and the ability to evaluate a wide range of industrial, commercial, and emerging technologies.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Project Execution

  • Lead and manage complex field evaluation projects from initiation through final reporting and approval.
  • Determine project scope, evaluation methodology, testing requirements, and documentation needs based on product design, customer requirements, and applicable standards.
  • Conduct on-site evaluations of electrical equipment, industrial machinery, control systems, and specialized products to assess compliance with regulatory and safety requirements.
  • Interpret and apply electrical codes, installation requirements, and product safety standards to unique and non-standard equipment.
  • Develop evaluation plans, test procedures, and acceptance criteria for products that fall outside the scope of existing standards.
  • Perform and oversee electrical testing, measurements, inspections, and hazard assessments using appropriate test equipment and instrumentation.
  • Analyze technical data and engineering documentation to determine product compliance and identify areas requiring corrective action.

Customer & Regulatory Engagement

  • Serve as the primary technical contact for customers throughout the evaluation process.
  • Communicate compliance requirements, technical findings, and recommendations clearly and professionally.
  • Collaborate with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs), inspectors, regulatory officials, and other stakeholders to facilitate project completion.
  • Provide technical consultation regarding product safety, field labeling, equipment modifications, and code compliance.
  • Address customer concerns and resolve complex technical issues with a solutions-oriented approach.

Engineering Expertise & Continuous Improvement

  • Provide subject matter expertise in electrical safety, field evaluations, and regulatory compliance.
  • Support the development and improvement of field evaluation procedures, test methodologies, and engineering tools.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance on complex projects and interpretations.
  • Contribute to industry committees, technical presentations, training programs, and standards development activities as appropriate.
  • Promote a culture of safety, quality, integrity, and continuous improvement in all aspects of work.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Industrial Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.
  • Minimum of 3-8 years of experience in field evaluations, product safety engineering, electrical inspections, certification, compliance engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Expert knowledge of:
    • National Electrical Code (NEC)
    • NFPA standards
    • Building and electrical codes
    • Electrical product safety standards
    • Regulatory and conformity assessment processes
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex technical projects and customer relationships.
  • Extensive experience conducting electrical testing and utilizing industry-standard test equipment.
  • Strong understanding of hazard-based safety engineering principles and risk assessment methodologies.
  • Excellent technical writing, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong presentation and communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Proficiency with engineering software, reporting tools, and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Ability and willingness to travel extensively, including occasional international travel.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel to customer locations on short notice.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.
  • Certified Electrical Inspector or related industry certifications.
  • Experience evaluating industrial machinery, control panels, power distribution equipment, automation systems, or hazardous location equipment.
  • Familiarity with international standards and global compliance requirements.
  • Experience serving as a technical lead, reviewer, mentor, or engineering authority.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Senior Field Evaluation Engineer is a trusted technical expert who can independently evaluate complex equipment, interpret challenging code requirements, build strong customer relationships, and deliver accurate, timely compliance decisions while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and professionalism.

Location: Remote, located within reasonable proximity to a major airport.

Travel: Approximately 60-80% domestic travel with occasional international travel.

This role offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies, influence product safety outcomes, and serve as a recognized technical leader within the field evaluation industry.

Compensation

The expected salary for this position is $40.00 to $50.00 per hour. This range represents the minimum and maximum base salary we reasonably expect to pay for this role. Actual compensation within the range will depend on skills, experience, and qualifications.

Our Benefits

We care about your total well-being and will support you with the following, subject to your location and role.

  • Health: Medical, dental and vision insurance, life insurance, employee assistance programs.

jobs.description:
DBA / Analista de Datos

En este reto profesional el analsita de datos será responsable de analizar la estructura y los componentes de bases de datos existentes con el objetivo de comprender su arquitectura, identificar elementos críticos y generar documentación técnica que facilite su evaluación y evolución.

Responsabilidades

• Analizar la estructura de bases de datos y extraer sus esquemas utilizando herramientas especializadas como SQL Server Management Studio u otros generadores automáticos.
• Generar diagramas entidad–relación (ER) que representen de forma clara la arquitectura de los datos y las relaciones entre tablas.
• Elaborar un inventario completo de stored procedures, incluyendo métricas como número de líneas de código, parámetros y nivel de complejidad.
• Revisar y analizar stored procedures complejos para identificar aquellos que puedan impactar estimaciones técnicas o procesos de modernización.
• Detectar la existencia de lógica de negocio implementada en triggers, jobs programados u otros mecanismos automáticos dentro de la base de datos.
• Documentar los hallazgos técnicos para facilitar el entendimiento del sistema y apoyar procesos de análisis o transformación tecnológica.

Requisitos

Académicos/Capacitación

• Formación Académica Mínima: Universitaria completa o experiencia equivalente demostrable en administración y análisis de bases de datos.
• Área Primaria de Formación: Ingeniería en Sistemas, Informática, Ciencia de Datos o carreras afines.
• Conocimientos Técnicos Clave: SQL Server avanzado, análisis de stored procedures complejos, generación de diagramas ER mediante herramientas de modelado o utilidades automáticas.
• Deseable: Experiencia en análisis estructural de bases de datos legacy y documentación técnica de modelos de datos.

Experiencia

• Experiencia comprobable trabajando con bases de datos SQL Server en entornos empresariales.
• Capacidad para analizar grandes volúmenes de lógica almacenada en stored procedures y otros objetos de base de datos.
• Experiencia en herramientas de modelado o generación automática de diagramas de base de datos será altamente valorada.

Detalles del Puesto

• Tipo de Contrato: Indefinido.
• Horario: Lunes a viernes, de 8:00 a.m. a 5:30 p.m. (GMT-6).
• Modalidad: Trabajo remoto.


Somos una empresa internacional dedicada a la provisión de servicios y soluciones tecnológicas orientadas a mejorar los procesos administrativos y de gestión de organizaciones públicas y privadas. Contamos con presencia en España, Estados Unidos, México, Centroamérica y Sudamérica.

Job type: Part-Time (less than 20hrs/week)

Location: Remote within the United States (US-Based, Fully Remote)

Intended Start Date: As soon as possible

Pay Range: $20–25/hr

Who we are:

Think Academy US (), a 100% owned subsidiary of TAL Education Group(NYSE: TAL), is recently established education technology (Ed-Tech) company to provide K-12 extra-curricular learning services through science and technology. At Think Academy, we provide full cycle service to foster local children’s ability to think critically, to strengthen their logic skills, and to help them fulfill their goals through innovative teaching techniques. We believe Love and Technology can make education better. Each week, more than 6 million students are enrolled in TAL's online and offline education platform.

Whom we are looking for:

Think Academy is expanding its competition math programs for students in North America. We are currently looking for Remote Math Competition Tutors to teach and support students preparing for AMC 8 and AMC 10 mathematics competitions. Our program focuses on developing students’ problem-solving abilities, mathematical reasoning, and competition strategies to help them succeed in national math contests.

What You Will Do:

  • Deliver online one-on-one math lessons focused on AMC 8 and AMC 10 competition preparation.
  • Teach in English using interactive and problem-solving based methods to help students develop strong analytical and logical thinking skills.
  • Guide students through competition-style problems and explain key concepts and strategies used in math competitions.
  • Help students build systematic approaches to common competition math topics such as number theory, algebra, counting, probability, and geometry.
  • Support students in developing confidence and effective test-taking strategies for math competitions.
  • Provide timely feedback and targeted guidance to support student understanding and continuous improvement

How You Can Be Qualified:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above; majors in Math, Economics, Finance, or related fields are preferred
  • Experience in math competitions or relevant competition teaching/tutoring experience is highly preferred
  • Strong math foundation; familiarity with competitions such as AMC, AIME, or MathCounts is preferred
  • Available to work during weekday evenings and weekends
  • Bilingual proficiency in Mandarin is preferred

Pay:

Pay starts from $20–25/hr, with opportunities for promotion and salary increases twice a year.

  • Think Academy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

jobs.description:

As the largest ticketing provider in the GCC, we proudly serve an extensive array of events across the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Bahrain, Qatar, and Kuwait from our Dubai-based headquarters.

  • Large and Small Entertainment Events

  • Diverse Sports Event Ticketing
  • Tourism Attraction Ticketing
  • Advanced Box Office Solutions for Venues including Stadiums, Theatres, and Cinemas
